arXiv:2610.18622v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Long legal documents are often represented as single retrieval units, which can dilute relevant content and limit retrieval effectiveness. This study investigates structural segmentation as a document representation strategy to improve Brazilian legal document retrieval. Using the hierarchical structure of legal acts, we represent each document as a collection of chunks. We evaluate four representation strategies: a multi-layered hierarchy representation and three simplified versions based on core chunks (articles and non-normative document components), with varying contextual details. We test these strategies on two publicly available Brazilian legal datasets containing normative acts and legislative proposals, using both lexical and dense retrieval models. Results show that structural segmentation improves dense retrieval compared with whole-document indexing, despite substantially increasing the number of indexed units. However, it does not consistently benefit lexical retrieval. Finally, we find that full hierarchicy representation is not necessary: core chunks enriched with document metadata yield comparable or better results.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于巴西法律文档的结构化分割检索，采用了当前主流的密集检索模型进行实验验证，技术方法较为前沿。研究针对特定领域（法律文档）提出了实用的文档表示策略，并基于公开数据集进行了系统评估，具有较好的实践指导意义。然而，实验主要基于两个特定数据集，其结论的普适性有待在更广泛的法律文档类型和语种中进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，对巴西法律文档进行结构化分割能有效提升密集检索效果，且仅使用核心段落与元数据的简化策略即可达到与完整层次表示相当的效果。

title: PsyBer-Agent: A Psychology-Driven User Agent for Recommender Systems
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13989v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Evaluating recommender systems before deployment requires simulators that remain realistic over long, closed-loop interaction cycles. Current LLM-based agents generally function as surface imitators that generate realistic short-term responses but fail to capture the underlying user dynamics such as fatigue, affect, and shifting preferences. We propose PsyBer-Agent, a psychology-inspired simulator that models these dynamics through its Psy-Engine. This engine represents each user with three evolving, model-defined latent states. To calibrate simulated behavior against real interaction logs, we align log-conditioned reference trajectories with simulator-generated latent-state trajectories via Unbalanced Gromov--Wasserstein optimal transport. This approach provides structured supervision for a lightweight policy without the computational burden of fine-tuning the backbone LLM. We also introduce WebSim and the PsyBer Benchmark, which encompass multimodal scenarios and seven recommender backbones. Our framework evaluates behavioral fidelity, latent-state consistency, robustness, and responses to social-cue perturbations. On the tested horizons, PsyBer-Agent shows lower behavioral discrepancy than the prompt-only simulators while maintaining stable performance under large-scale concurrent simulation for up to 5M queued simulation tasks under bounded concurrency. Code is available in the supplementary material and at: PsyBer-Agent: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CC66F/, WebSim Platform: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/D8EAX/.
thinking: 该论文通过引入心理学启发的动态用户状态建模和最优传输校准方法，提升了推荐系统模拟器的长期行为保真度，在方法上具有创新性。其提出的评估框架和开源平台增强了研究的可复现性和潜在应用价值，但作为预印本，其方法在真实场景中的最终落地效果仍需进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种融合心理学动态模型和最优传输校准的智能体，用于更真实地模拟用户在推荐系统中的长期交互行为。

title: An Edge-First Multimodal Asset Management Studio and Retrieval Engine for Heterogeneous AI-Generated Media
abstract:
arXiv:2610.14046v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: AI-generated image collections combine visual content with heterogeneous provenance such as prompts, model parameters, and workflow graphs. Managing these collections locally requires coordinated metadata extraction, responsive browsing, and retrieval without mandatory remote inference. We present Berry AI Studio, an edge-first asset management system built with Vue, Tauri, Rust, SQLite, and ONNX Runtime. Berry integrates format-specific metadata parsing with raw-payload retention, generation-aware cancellation of queued thumbnail work, a persistent multi-tier thumbnail manifest, cursor pagination, and local image-text retrieval. We evaluate these mechanisms in five independent repetitions on a pinned source revision. With 50,000 catalog records, the median warm first-page database call was 285.3 ms; at offset 40,000, keyset pagination reduced median raw-query latency from 57.9 to 0.46 ms. A controlled browser harness recorded a 0.3 ms median-of-run P95 update time during virtualized scrolling, while cancellation prevented all 1,200 stale speculative decodes in the tested trace. A versioned 10-case corpus produced 53/53 exact metadata-field matches, and controlled retrieval and grouping tests exercised the authentic storage and clustering paths. The implementation, benchmark scripts, raw logs, and checksummed result packages are publicly available.
thinking: 该论文提出并实现了一个面向AI生成媒体的边缘优先资产管理系统，在技术实现上结合了现代前端与后端技术栈，并针对AI生成媒体的异构元数据进行了专门处理，技术方案具有前沿性。系统性能评估方法规范，通过多次重复实验和具体指标验证了系统的有效性，但研究场景偏向技术实现，与图书馆、信息机构等传统图情业务的直接关联性较弱。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一个本地优先的AI生成媒体资产管理系统，有效整合了异构元数据并实现了高效的浏览与检索性能。

title: RES-MR: Risk-Aware Reasoning for Explainable and Safe Medication Recommendation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.14474v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Medication recommendations seek to deliver personalized drug combinations based on patients' clinical information, where ensuring transparent decision-making and personalized safety are of paramount importance. However, existing approaches predominantly operate as ``black boxes'', offering limited interpretability and hindering clinician trust. Furthermore, they typically rely on fixed, patient-agnostic safety constraints, neglecting the heterogeneity of risk tolerance across individuals, which poses significant risks to vulnerable populations. To address these gaps, we propose \textbf{RES-MR}, a novel Risk-aware Reasoning framework for Explainable and Safe Medication Recommendation using LLMs. RES-MR follows a two-stage training paradigm: (1) an explainable clinical reasoning distillation stage to elicit diagnostic capabilities by fine-tuning on synthesized reasoning trajectories, grounded in patient-specific knowledge from graph retrieval; and (2) a risk-aware policy optimization stage to dynamically balance therapeutic efficacy with personalized safety. This stage employs disentangled drug factors to construct patient-specific reference prototypes that capture desired therapeutic drug features and risk features to avoid. These prototypes enable risk boundary calibration and guide the model toward safe recommendations via reward shaping and clipping. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that RES-MR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in terms of accuracy, safety, and explainability. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/wangcong2001/RES-MR.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型的风险感知药物推荐框架，在可解释性和个性化安全性方面有显著创新，技术前沿性突出。研究通过两阶段训练和实验验证，方法较为严谨，但作为预印本，其实际在临床环境中的落地应用价值仍有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种结合大语言模型与风险感知推理的新框架，旨在为临床药物推荐提供更安全、可解释的个性化方案。

title: Decoupling Knowledge Forgetting and Refusal Learning in MLLM Unlearning
abstract:
arXiv:2610.14605v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Current evaluations of multimodal unlearning typically focus on whether a model stops outputting target information. This surface-level criterion, however, masks two critical failure modes. First, knowledge suppression techniques often induce confabulation, leading the model to hallucinate facts about the unlearned subject. Second, refusal training merely alters observable behavior without erasing the underlying knowledge; such models might decline open queries but still identify correct answers under multiple-choice probing. To overcome these limitations, we propose Forget-Aware Self-Distillation (FASD). This method is designed to achieve honest ignorance, a state where the model genuinely loses the target knowledge and learns to acknowledge its absence. FASD separates these goals into two complementary channels. The behavior channel distills appropriate refusals from an ignorance-prompted copy of the model itself. Crucially, target tokens are masked from the teacher distribution to avoid accidentally reteaching the forgotten concepts. Simultaneously, the knowledge channel directly suppresses ground-truth answer spans independently of the model's generated responses. Experiments demonstrate that FASD successfully unlearns target knowledge, prevents information leakage in open-ended tasks, and preserves performance on retained data. The resulting model not only forgets the specified information but accurately recognizes the boundaries of its own knowledge. Code and data will be released upon publication.
thinking: 该论文针对多模态大语言模型遗忘学习中的关键问题，提出了创新的 Forget-Aware Self-Distillation (FASD) 方法，技术前沿性突出。其方法设计严谨，通过分离知识遗忘与拒绝学习两个通道并进行实验验证，具有较好的方法严谨性。然而，作为一项前沿技术探索，其具体在图书馆或信息机构中的直接落地应用场景和路径尚不明确，实践应用价值有待进一步转化。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种新方法，让多模态大模型既能真正“忘记”指定知识，又能学会承认自己不知道，从而避免产生幻觉或信息泄露。

title: MoSAIC: Learning DAG Scheduling Heuristics from Optimal Schedules through Motif-Aware Recovery and LLM-Guided Reasoning
abstract:
arXiv:2610.15205v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Efficient task scheduling in heterogeneous computing systems remains a fundamental challenge in embedded and high-level synthesis flows. This paper presents MoSAIC (Motif-aware Scheduling with AI-driven Cognition), a learning-based framework that bridges the gap between exact and heuristic scheduling approaches for DAG-based applications. The system uses the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to learn the relationships between DAG structures and scheduling priority functions. The framework first leverages the OR-Tools CP-SAT solver [4] to generate optimal schedules, which are then used to supervise the learning of compact priority-based scheduling functions through Bayesian Optimization. These learned heuristics capture relationships between scheduling decisions and structural graph features such as rank, depth, and fanout, enabling the construction of a reusable knowledge base across diverse DAG instances. Experimental results across synthetic graph families and real-world benchmarks, including PolyBench and MachSuite, show that the learned heuristics consistently improve over classical approaches such as HEFT [2], while maintaining low runtime overhead. The results indicate that combining optimal supervision with learning-based generalization provides a practical approach for scalable and adaptive task scheduling.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合大语言模型和贝叶斯优化学习DAG调度启发式的方法，技术前沿性较强，但属于计算机系统调度领域，与图情核心业务关联较弱，实践应用价值有限。方法上虽结合了优化求解器和机器学习，但未详细说明样本规模与验证的严谨性。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究利用大语言模型从最优调度方案中学习任务图的调度规则，提升了异构计算系统中任务调度的效率。

title: PANINI-DR: Controlled Deep Research through Generative Semantic Workspaces
abstract:
arXiv:2610.15208v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Deep research requires connecting multiple steps of search, reasoning, and computation, with intermediate findings guiding what to investigate next. As investigations grow, agents must maintain research state across model calls and check findings before errors propagate into subsequent work. We introduce PANINI-DR, a multi-agent harness that separates coordination of the overall investigation from the research and verification of individual subquestions. A shared workspace, built on the Generative Semantic Workspace representation, records subquestions, their dependencies, findings, and supporting evidence. Researchers investigate individual subquestions, while a separate verification agent checks proposed answers against those subquestions and their evidence. Verification feedback guides further investigation, and recorded findings inform subsequent assignments. We evaluate PANINI-DR on BrowseComp-Plus, FRAMES, and MoNaCo against seven state-of-the-art deep-research harnesses, all using a shared language-model backbone and frozen corpora. PANINI-DR achieves the strongest average performance across the three benchmarks. On BrowseComp-Plus, it achieves 73.3% accuracy, outperforming the next-best harness by 16.0 points. Its advantage is strongest on hard questions, where it answers nearly twice as many as the next-best harness. Ablations further show that structured planning and persistent state improve performance, as does checking each finding against its cited evidence before it is reused. Because a model can answer correctly from memory alone, we also analyze the evidence retained by each harness. PANINI-DR achieves the highest answer recoverability from saved evidence on all three benchmarks, while complementary claim-support audits show stronger evidence-backed answers. Accounting for this evidence changes how harnesses compare and further strengthens PANINI-DR's advantage.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于生成式语义工作空间的多智能体深度研究框架，通过分离研究协调与子问题验证来提升研究过程的可靠性与可追溯性。其方法在多个基准测试中表现优异，尤其在复杂问题上优势明显，但研究场景仍以封闭语料库的模拟环境为主，在真实、动态的学术研究场景中的落地潜力有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一个多智能体框架，通过结构化规划、状态保持和证据核查，显著提升了自动深度研究任务的准确性和可靠性。

title: ARMED: Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Medication Recommendation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.16440v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Medication recommendation requires jointly considering diagnoses, comorbidities, longitudinal patient history, and treatment interactions. Although recent retrieval-augmented generation approaches using language models have shown promise for clinical recommendation, most existing systems rely on fixed retrieval pipelines that cannot adapt to diverse clinical retrieval scenarios and may introduce noisy or irrelevant evidence. We propose ARMED, an adaptive clinical RAG framework that dynamically expands retrieval according to retrieval sufficiency and current-admission relevance. ARMED first observes the initial retrieval outcome and selectively performs supplementary or fallback multi-query retrieval when additional evidence is needed. The framework also incorporates a relevance gate that activates only clinically relevant same-patient history and organizes retrieved evidence into structured query-level clinical evidence. Experiments on MIMIC-IV demonstrate that ARMED consistently outperforms previous static retrieval baselines and improves overall medication recommendation quality. By combining locally runnable small language models with adaptive retrieval, ARMED supports medication recommendation without relying on external language model APIs or task-specific fine-tuning.
thinking: 论文提出了一种自适应的临床检索增强生成框架，通过动态扩展检索策略来提升药物推荐的准确性，方法设计具有创新性。然而，研究基于公开数据集MIMIC-IV进行验证，其在实际临床工作流中的部署复杂性和数据隐私等落地挑战未充分讨论，方法严谨性受限于单一数据源。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种能动态调整检索策略的智能框架，用于提升临床药物推荐的准确性和适应性。

title: EHR-Bench: A Chinese Multi-Task Benchmark for Recruitment AI
abstract:
arXiv:2610.16689v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Recruitment applications span diverse operations, from drafting job descriptions and interpreting queries to organizing profiles, assessing fit, and recommending candidates and jobs. Systematic LLM evaluation therefore requires task coverage that reflects this range of business needs. We introduce EHR-Bench, an open Chinese benchmark comprising twelve tasks across six capability families and five recruitment scenarios. The tasks cover generation, extraction, classification, retrieval, semantic similarity, and reciprocal ranking within one evaluation framework. An internal recruitment dataset guides task definitions, the occupation taxonomy and sampling targets, output requirements, and scoring protocols. Following these specifications, we construct 8,336 task instances from public materials and controlled augmentation, with source-aware expert review and documented provenance. We evaluate twelve LLMs through task-level, capability-level, and aggregate comparisons. Closely ranked models exhibit distinct task strengths, and performance varies across input sources, reference evidence, and candidate pools. Five shared models retain the same observed Overall ordering on a private operational reference, with variation in capability and task correspondence. EHR-Bench provides a reproducible foundation for systematic model assessment, task-specific model selection, and further research on LLMs for recruitment. The project repository is available at https://github.com/EhrBench/EHR-Bench.
thinking: 该论文构建了一个面向招聘领域的中文多任务基准测试集，涉及生成、抽取、分类、检索等多种任务，技术方法较为前沿；但由于其研究场景聚焦于招聘AI，与图书馆、信息机构等传统图情业务场景的直接关联较弱，实践应用价值有限；研究方法上，基于内部数据集定义任务并构建大规模实例，且进行了专家评审和模型评估，严谨性较好。
one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一个用于系统评估大语言模型在中文招聘场景下多任务表现的开源基准测试集。

title: Separating Prompt Harmfulness from Interaction Safety via Partial Generation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.16761v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: LLM-based information systems need safety guardrails. Most guardrails classify the prompt alone. If the prompt looks harmful, the system rejects it before any answer is generated. This is costly. Many rejected prompts would have received a safe response. Users lose help they should have received from the information system. This cost grows as conversational and generative search becomes common. Prompt-level labels treat harm as a property of the query. But harm depends on what the model actually writes. Existing input-output guards do look at responses. But they judge a finished response, so the decision comes after full generation. However, we observe that safety of model interaction with the input prompt can be inferred early with only partial output. So the system can start generating, watch the partial response, and stop only if it turns harmful. We test this idea in three steps. First, we build a dataset of 41,944 prompt-response pairs with seven open weights LLMs from three families: Llama, Gemma, and Qwen. Second, we show that prompt harmfulness and interaction safety differ. Prompt labels and response labels agree on only 50.46\% of items (Cohen's $\kappa$ = 0.06). Of the prompts that make any model respond harmfully, only 3.5\% do so for all seven LLMs. Third, we show that partial responses carry most of the signal. Fine-tuned classifiers predict response-level harm well (best AUPRC 0.885, F1 0.807). About one third of the response tokens recover almost full-response AUPRC.
thinking: 论文针对LLM安全护栏的效率问题提出了创新方法，通过部分生成而非完整输出来判断交互安全性，技术上具有前沿性。研究基于大规模多模型数据集验证了提示有害性与交互安全性的差异，方法严谨，但实践价值受限于对特定模型微调的需求，在通用部署上存在挑战。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究发现通过分析大语言模型的部分生成结果即可早期判断交互安全性，能减少对无害提示的误拒，提升信息检索系统效率。

title: From Volpiano to Pixels: 30,000 Lines of OMR Ground Truth for Medieval Chant
abstract:
arXiv:2610.16862v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Optical music recognition (OMR) for medieval chant lacks training data linking manuscript images to musical symbols across notational families. Using existing Volpiano transcriptions from the Cantus Database, we created 30,567 image-target pairs from ten sources in eleven exports, including 339 verse fragments. Their target sequences contain 1,952,143 tokens. The pipeline locates staff systems, infers clefs and maps known pitches to staff positions. Six detector families handle the different layouts and notations. Where heuristics failed, two small U-Nets learned staff lines and clef letters from manual annotations. Reviews of sampled export lines found zero to four pitch or clef errors, but used different error definitions and do not provide a uniform audit of the corpus. A CRNN trained from scratch achieved a symbol error rate of 9.6 % on 3,086 test lines. The earlier model, trained mainly on Austrian sources of the 15th and 16th centuries, scored 45.3 %. In three separate training runs, each excluding one manuscript, error rates on the excluded manuscript were 21.5-31.0 %. Model-assisted alignment recovered a further 2,686 lines.
thinking: 该论文通过构建大规模中世纪圣咏光学音乐识别（OMR）数据集，并采用U-Net和CRNN等深度学习模型进行训练与评估，在技术方法上具有前沿性。其成果直接为音乐学、数字人文和图书馆的珍贵手稿数字化项目提供了可复用的数据与工具，实践价值显著。但论文对数据质量审计的描述较为简略，且模型在不同手稿上的泛化能力差异较大，方法严谨性尚有提升空间。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个包含三万行数据的中世纪圣咏乐谱识别数据集，并训练了深度学习模型，显著提升了对此类历史文献的自动识别准确率。

title: Comparing GenAI to Machine Learning and Manual Review for eDiscovery
abstract:
arXiv:2610.16925v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Keeling et al. [Keeling2026Generative] report on a case study recently conducted by Redgrave LLP in which they assert that Relativity's Generative AI Review tool (aiR) achieved 88% recall while Relativity Assisted Learning (RAL), its machine-learning tool, achieved 64% recall. These results are not comparable because the methods employed have different objectives, because of inter-assessor disagreement, and because they represent different recall-precision and cost-benefit trade-offs. Our analysis of the Redgrave data indicates that, when these differences are taken into account, aiR and manual review are comparable. Furthermore, established machine-learning models employing Continuous Active Learning (CAL) show state-of-the-art effectiveness, and superior efficiency, when trained only on a sample of 2,000 first-pass-reviewer responsiveness determinations.
thinking: 论文对生成式AI、机器学习和人工审阅在电子取证中的效果进行了严谨的比较分析，指出了不同方法因目标、评估者间差异和权衡取舍而不可简单对比，并基于数据论证了生成式AI与人工审阅效果相当，而采用持续主动学习的机器学习模型在效率和效果上表现优异。其方法严谨，但技术应用本身并非最前沿，且结论对法律信息检索实践有直接指导价值。
one_sentence_summary: 研究指出，在电子取证中，生成式AI与人工审阅效果相当，而采用特定学习策略的机器学习模型在少量样本训练下即可实现高效检索。

title: KNN Implementation Details Can Dramatically Change Performance: An Example from Cover Trees
abstract:
arXiv:2610.16940v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Nearest neighbor search algorithms are widely used and have a long history, but we find that key implementation details are seldom reviewed in articles about them. These details can materially impact performance, and thus change the conclusions one makes about a given algorithm's superiority. In this article, we highlight these impacts by reviewing the Cover Tree as an example, producing RustKNN, a unified Rust implementation of three construction variants of the Cover Tree with three query modes. Our analysis reveals: (1) the optimal query strategy depends on $k$ and on the dataset (single-tree search is fastest at $k{=}1$ on three of our four largest datasets, while dual-tree search is fastest at $k{\ge}5$ on the three largest), and choosing the wrong query mode can cost up to a $7.5\times$ factor in runtime; (2) the cover tree base parameter, set to 2 in theory and 1.3 in practice, is not a safe default for dual-tree search: 1.3 is optimal on only one of seven datasets, and on covtype it is $1.6\times$ slower than the optimum; (3) among five micro-optimizations, only early-exit distance computation has a consistent effect, and that effect grows with dimension (none at $d{=}32$, $1.31\times$ at $d{=}54$, and $1.49\times$ at $d{=}784$); and (4) all-nearest-neighbor and held-out benchmarks yield different implementation rankings. All main timing tables report medians over 20 independent allocations with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals. RustKNN is open source at https://github.com/CrowdStrike/RustKNN.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于最近邻搜索算法（如Cover Tree）的实现细节对性能的显著影响，通过构建统一的Rust实现并进行严谨的实验分析，揭示了参数设置、查询模式选择等关键因素如何改变算法评价结论。其研究方法规范，采用了多次独立实验和置信区间分析，但研究内容更偏向算法工程优化，在图情领域的直接业务落地场景有限。
one_sentence_summary: 论文通过实验证明，最近邻搜索算法的具体实现细节（如参数和查询模式）会极大影响其性能表现和算法优劣结论。

title: Tracing Money Flows in the Multi-Token Cryptocurrency Network
abstract:
arXiv:2610.16981v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Tracing money flows in cryptocurrency transaction networks is challenging because funds can move across accounts, transactions, and token layers. We propose a transaction-aware graph in which nodes represent account--asset states within transactions, while edges encode observed transfers, inferred asset transformations, and temporal inter-transaction sequences. Applied to Aave borrow--repay flows, we compare graph construction and edge-pruning strategies and extract shortest paths using a heuristic weighting. Our results reveal a trade-off between reachability and interpretability and uncover frequent token sequences underlying how borrowed assets are transformed before repayment. This work lays a foundation for general, interpretable multi-token flow tracing.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于交易感知图的方法来追踪多代币加密货币网络中的资金流动，采用了图论和启发式加权等前沿技术，方法设计较为严谨。然而，其研究场景（Aave借贷协议）相对特定，对图书馆等传统信息机构的直接业务落地价值有限，且作为预印本，其方法论的完备性有待同行评审进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过构建交易感知图，揭示了加密货币借贷中资产在偿还前被频繁转换的路径，为追踪复杂资金流提供了新方法。

title: From Conceptual EneMonIE to an Executable Backend: A Modular Architecture for Energy Information Extractionand Grounded Question Answering
abstract:
arXiv:2610.17243v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: The original EneMonIE proposal describes a Web-based semantic system for continuously monitoring energy trends through targeted information extraction from heterogeneous online media. This article presents EneMonIE-Backend, an implementation-derived redesign that converts that conceptual pipeline into a modular, executable, and application-independent backend. The architecture separates five concerns: data sources, acquisition and normalization, semantic processing, knowledge organization, and persistent storage. It operationalizes configurable connectors for RSS feeds, URL collections, arXiv, social-media JSON files, and open-data CSV files; it also introduces question-driven Web search and scraping. Relevant documents pass through energy categorization, named entity recognition, temporal and event extraction, source sensitive sentiment analysis, and extractive summarization. The resulting semantic representations support entity co-occurrence graphs, cross-document interlinking, cluster-level information fusion, and relational persistence in SQLite. Three grounded question-answering paths are exposed at the backend level: live Web evidence, the stored corpus, and selected configured resources. Answer generation uses a language model when configured and otherwise falls back to deterministic extractive output. Unlike the original proposal, the presented architecture deliberately excludes the user-interface and server-side application layers, allowing the semantic core to be embedded in different applications. A deterministic smoke validation confirms relevance filtering, persistence, clustering, evidence retrieval, and document deletion. The work provides a reproducible architectural basis for future evaluation on larger multilingual energy corpora.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种模块化、可执行的能源信息抽取与问答系统后端架构，在技术实现上结合了语义处理、知识组织和语言模型，具有较高的前沿技术度。其设计注重应用独立性，为能源趋势监测提供了可复用的技术基础，业务落地潜力较强。但论文目前仅进行了小规模的验证测试，方法严谨性有待在更大规模语料上进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究将能源监测的概念系统转化为一个模块化的后端架构，支持从多源数据中抽取信息并基于知识库或实时网络进行问答。

title: SSEmb: Training a Generalizable Speech Retrieval Model Using Only Automatic Speech Recognition Data
abstract:
arXiv:2610.17813v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: End-to-end speech-to-text retrieval is becoming an important capability for voice agents, allowing spoken queries to retrieve relevant documents without intermediate transcription. Training these retrievers typically depends on large collections of spoken query-document pairs that are costly to acquire and difficult to extend across domains and languages. We introduce \ours, which replaces such task-specific supervision with speech-transcript pairs from standard ASR corpora. A lightweight adapter projects the output of a frozen speech encoder into the retrieval space of a frozen pretrained text embedding model. \ours is competitive with cascaded ASR-then-retrieve systems while reducing inference latency, and outperforms existing publicly available speech embedding models. It also transfers to text-to-speech and speech-to-speech retrieval without additional training. Controlled analyses validate the speech-transcript alignment paradigm, demonstrating robustness to reduced training data and consistent gains from larger corpora. Further ablations of loss functions and trainable modules establish practical guidelines for the framework. Model weights and codes are to be released.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种利用自动语音识别数据训练通用语音检索模型的方法，通过轻量级适配器将语音编码器与预训练文本嵌入模型对齐，减少了传统方法对大规模语音-文档配对数据的依赖。其方法设计严谨，通过控制实验验证了框架的有效性和鲁棒性，但作为一项技术探索，其在实际图书馆或信息机构业务场景中的直接应用路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种仅用语音识别数据训练通用语音检索模型的新方法，在降低推理延迟的同时，性能媲美传统级联系统。

title: Web Scale on a Budget: Tail-Aware Retrieval Evaluation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.17986v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: A common practice in instance retrieval is to grow the gallery size to improve a benchmark's discrimination capability. One prominent example is ILIAS, which adds up to 100 million distractor images. The prevailing assumption is that faithful evaluation demands web scale, and that indexing all 100M images through the backbone is the unavoidable price of a comparable number. That price is steep: hundreds of GPU-hours and ~200 GB of descriptors per model, paid again for every method or ablation. We show the web-scale indexing price is largely avoidable: evaluation itself obeys a scaling law. The number of distractors that outrank a positive is Binomial in the gallery size. We define the per-query retrieval hardness, a gallery-scale agnostic quantity that yields a retrieval metric at any scale, and demonstrate it can be derived from a small random sample. The underlying sampled-rank machinery is long established in recommender-system and biometric evaluation, but to our knowledge has never been adapted to visual retrieval. We make the law per-query and estimable, and validate it at true 100M scale on ILIAS and INSTRE, and on the full 759k-distractor Google Landmarks v2 pool. Concretely, within a 5% sample (a flat 20x less indexing), every backbone's tail-aware (EVT) estimate has converged onto the large-scale mAP, to within ~0.01 (mean absolute error 0.005), across five backbones, three benchmarks, and two distractor pools (mAP@1000 at 100M on ILIAS/INSTRE; the official mAP@100 at the full 759k pool on GLDv2); the recommender-systems count baseline over-predicts everywhere (+0.037 to +0.068). This is an order of magnitude better than naively reporting the metric on the same subset (+0.08 to +0.13). We release code and the per-query hardness to facilitate faster, cheaper, and greener retrieval evaluation.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于尾部感知的检索评估方法，通过小规模随机采样来准确估计大规模数据集上的检索性能，显著降低了评估成本。其方法在多个基准测试上验证有效，但核心统计方法本身并非前沿技术，而是对已有方法的创新性迁移和应用。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种通过小样本准确估计大规模图像检索性能的方法，能大幅降低评估所需的计算资源和时间成本。

title: Fresh at Decision, Stale at Action: Routing New Information to LLM Decisions Already Made
abstract:
arXiv:2610.18126v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Freshness shapes an LLM decision at the moment it is made; the action it commits to is latent, carried out later, in a changing world. We therefore introduce a timestamp theory of decision validity and a decision ledger that realises it. Six timestamps define a decision; a freshness ceiling bounds what up-to-date evidence guarantees at action time, placing the remaining risk in information published afterwards. Accuracy then factorises into two capabilities: routing, which delivers that information to affected decisions before their revision deadlines, and temporal judgment, which reads it for the time of action. The ledger is persistent state holding each decision's times, evidence and background knowledge, indexed by watch conditions written at decision time. Controlled decision streams with exact labels confirm four predictions across five LLMs, from 8B to frontier scale: freshness alone yields exactly the accuracy the ceiling predicts; models act on decisive news once it arrives, so accuracy follows routing; the ledger's index sets what routing reaches, and watch conditions reach indirect dependencies at low exposure; and the remaining errors concern when a change takes effect. Freshness makes a decision right when it is made; routing and temporal judgment keep it right when it is carried out.
thinking: 该论文提出了基于时间戳的决策有效性理论和决策账本机制，以解决大语言模型决策与行动间的时间不一致问题，具有显著的方法创新性。然而，论文主要基于受控实验进行验证，其在实际复杂业务场景（如图书馆参考咨询、信息推荐）中的落地路径和普适性仍需进一步探索。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种通过决策账本和时间戳路由新信息的方法，以保持大语言模型在动态世界中所作决策在行动时的有效性。

title: JevGPT: Thinking Fast and Slow in Autonomous Research
abstract:
arXiv:2610.18272v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Autonomous research agents must acquire and reason over evidence within a limited budget. Yet relevant sources can remain uninspected or unused, leaving a gap between retrieval coverage and the evidence that informs research. The challenge is to align fast local judgments with changing evidence needs and feed their findings back into research decisions. We introduce JevGPT, a dual-system architecture for autonomous research that couples fast evidence processing with deliberative research planning. System Two sets evidence objectives and integrates findings, while System One locates support, assesses relevance, and guides further inspection. Independent source judgments run in parallel; selected original passages inform the next research step. Experiments on fixed-corpus question answering and document ranking show that JevGPT achieves leading task performance, with faster completion and lower cost than comparably effective research agents. Evidence analysis shows broader source inspection and greater coverage of supporting documents in the research loop, highlighting efficient evidence processing as a route to more capable autonomous research.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个结合快速直觉处理与审慎规划的双系统架构，用于提升自主研究代理的证据处理效率，在信息检索任务中展示了优越的性能和成本效益。然而，其技术核心仍基于现有的大语言模型范式，在方法创新上属于优化集成，且实验场景相对受限，在真实、复杂的图书馆或信息机构业务场景中的落地潜力有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过一个双系统架构，让AI研究代理能更高效地规划任务并处理文献证据，从而在固定资料库的问答和排序任务中取得更好成绩且成本更低。

title: SimInter: Evidence-Grounded User Simulation with Interview-Based Profile Enrichment for Conversational Recommender Systems
abstract:
arXiv:2610.18308v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Conversational Recommender Systems (CRSs) require reliable user simulators for cost-effective evaluation. LLM-based simulators have made realistic simulation possible but typically condition on profiles derived from explicit ratings, demographics, and static sources capturing surface preferences while omitting implicit behavioral characteristics such as decision-making style, aspect-level preferences, and domain expertise. We propose SimInter, a pipeline that elicits these attributes via synthetic interviews between two LLM agents, grounded in the user's statistical profile and historical conversational evidence. Before profile enrichment, an audit agent explicitly flags potential fabrication and stereotyping at the turn level. We instantiate and evaluate SimInter on movie recommendation. We simulate 300 ReDial users and, on a matched subset of 100 users, compare SimInter with a statistics-only baseline: SimInter significantly increases the diversity of expressed preference aspects (filtered aspect entropy: 1.619 vs. 0.859; paired d = 0.96, Holm-adjusted p < 0.001). This gain persists when the simulator converses with two trained recommenders, KBRD and UniCRS, under two independent evaluation judges (+0.28 to +0.56 nats; all p < 0.001). Human evaluation finds 94.3% of enriched-attribute claims supported or partially supported, while human judgments agree with 95.2% of the auditor's binary filtering decisions on a stratified sample.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于大语言模型的用户模拟器SimInter，通过合成访谈来丰富用户画像，有效提升了对话推荐系统中用户偏好的多样性表达。方法设计严谨，引入了审计代理来减少虚构和刻板印象，并通过统计测试和人工评估验证了效果。然而，研究目前仅应用于电影推荐领域，在其他领域的普适性有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种通过大语言模型进行合成访谈来丰富用户画像的方法，能显著提升对话推荐系统中模拟用户偏好的多样性和真实性。

title: Choosing LLMs for Strategic Agent Interactions
abstract:
arXiv:2610.18354v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Game-theoretic benchmarks claim that large language model (LLM) strategic decision-making varies across game types, interaction structures, and capability dimensions. However, they only evaluate strategic performance across individual fixed models. In parallel, contemporary LLM routers pick models under quality-cost trade-offs, but with no notion of a strategic structure. They do not account for an opponent that might be unknown, and that can adapt over time and shift the feedback signal. To address this, we extend the game-theoretic evaluations and define strategic selection as the meta game layered on top of the base game. In each round, a strategic selector fields an LLM from a portfolio of models to navigate a game payoff matrix that is latent and learned online. We find that the evaluation signal is game-specific, and that extracting a reliable signal requires a much higher number of seed runs $N$ compared to traditional benchmarking setups. Evaluating across 5 games and 10 LLMs, we show a model's strategic competence varies significantly depending on the game setup and the opponent faced. Building on this, we implement a suite of selector methods and find that approaches that rely on query embeddings or LLM self-reflection do not consistently capture the underlying strategic signal. A lightweight multi-armed bandit algorithm performs more reliably across games, though it still falls short of the best fixed model. Finally, we show that simple non-stationary and adversarial bandit variants fail to outperform a stationary bandit baseline, pointing to a gap in how current methods handle a shifting opponent in strategic settings.
thinking: 该论文将博弈论评估与LLM路由选择相结合，提出了一个新颖的“策略选择”元博弈框架，并进行了大规模的实验验证，方法设计严谨。其核心发现——策略能力高度依赖具体博弈场景且现有嵌入或自省方法效果有限——对构建自适应智能体系统有直接启示，但作为基础研究，其具体业务落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现大语言模型的策略决策能力因博弈类型和对手而异，且轻量级多臂老虎机算法在模型选择上比依赖查询嵌入或模型自省的方法更可靠。

title: Retrieval Disagreement as a Signal: Diagnosing and Steering Multilingual Dense Embedders
abstract:
arXiv:2610.18526v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Multilingual dense retrievers place all languages in one shared space so that a question finds relevant documents, regardless of which language they are written in. We show that the same question, asked in different languages, retrieves substantially different documents, and this disagreement is not because of weak language understanding. Each language performs well on its own and ranks candidates consistently with the other languages; divergence appears only when languages share an index. We trace the mechanism: each language keeps its own ranking, but in the shared index, its correct answers are pushed far down, buried under non-relevant documents that are either in the query's own language or in English, depending on the model. We introduce disagreement-guided steering: for each language, we contrast the documents that other languages agree on for a question against those that language retrieves idiosyncratically, and take the difference of their representations as a language-specific direction, added to that language's queries at inference. Against baselines of language-mean removal, subspace removal, and per-language rotation, it most strongly reduces same-language crowding while remaining competitive on recall, trading off against mean removal, which better preserves ranking quality.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于多语言稠密检索器中的检索不一致性问题，并提出了一种基于分歧引导的调控方法，在技术方法上具有前沿性。其提出的解决方案具有明确的工程实现路径，对改进多语言检索系统有直接应用价值。研究通过对比实验验证了方法的有效性，方法严谨，但作为预印本，其结论尚未经过同行评议的全面检验。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究揭示了多语言稠密检索器存在跨语言检索结果不一致的问题，并提出了一种通过分析语言间分歧来针对性优化查询向量的新方法。

title: Knowledge Graphs as Files: An Agent Harness Where Tool Creation and Tool Use Co-Evolve
abstract:
arXiv:2610.18616v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Searching text-rich knowledge graphs requires following relations while examining textual evidence. Predefined graph interfaces constrain what evidence agents can access, even when they write code to combine tool calls or process retrieved subgraphs. We propose direct knowledge graph interaction (DKGI), a harness in which language model agents create graph access tools directly over complete node and edge files. The agent writes Python code to follow relations, combine node sets, and select textual evidence, interleaving execution with shell search and file inspection. This lets agents process large node sets in bulk while returning selected text for the model to assess. Execution feedback guides tool creation and revision, while the evolving tools determine what evidence the agent gathers next. On benchmark datasets spanning three domains, training-free DKGI exceeds the strongest published baseline by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on every graph, even with a minimal harness. Controlled ablations show the benefits of multi-turn programming over shell-only access and predefined graph tools, while trajectories show agents revising code to extend searches or address errors. These findings highlight the value of allowing tool creation and tool use to co-evolve during graph search. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/leopoldwhite/DKGI.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于文件直接交互的知识图谱检索新方法，允许智能体动态创建和修改检索工具，在多个基准数据集上取得了显著优于现有基线的效果，体现了方法创新性。然而，作为预印本，其方法细节和实验复现性有待同行评议进一步验证，且其技术路径对现有图书馆系统的直接适配性尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出让大语言模型智能体通过动态编写代码来直接操作知识图谱文件，实现了工具创建与使用的协同进化，从而提升了复杂图谱检索的准确率。

title: Kwai Summary Attention V2 Technical Report
abstract:
arXiv:2610.18654v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Summary-token architectures such as Kwai Summary Attention (KSA) compress distant context into learnable Summary token per chunk, and hybrid variants interleave these layers with full attention to retain exact access to the original text. In such hybrid KSA-Full architecture, the interleaving inserted summary tokens are served as a streaming flow role across different layers. Although effective, however, it also introduce some bottlenecks: (1) the different layers summary compression chunk must be same, therefore hard to reach a flexible KV Cache compression, e.g., different layer set different summary compression chunk window. (2) in the full-attention layers, the summary token introduced additional computation cost, but such layer ignore them and still pay quadratic prefilling, therefore unfriendly to the computation side. Motivated by them, we developed the KSA V2, which not only achieves a more flexible KV cache memory compression but also reduces the computation cost in Full attention layer. Specifically, we found that the summary tokens can serve two roles: the KV memory and sparse indexer.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种改进的注意力机制架构，旨在优化大语言模型中的KV缓存压缩和计算效率，属于信息检索领域的前沿技术探索。其技术方案具体，但作为技术报告，缺乏在图书馆或信息机构等实际业务场景中的应用验证，且未提供充分的实验数据来支撑其方法严谨性。
one_sentence_summary: 该技术报告提出了一种改进的注意力机制，旨在更灵活地压缩模型内存并降低计算成本。

title: LLMRec: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Recommendation Task
abstract:
arXiv:2308.12241v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Recently, the fast development of Large Language Models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT has significantly advanced NLP tasks by enhancing the capabilities of conversational models. However, the application of LLMs in the recommendation domain has not been thoroughly investigated. To bridge this gap, we propose LLMRec, a LLM-based recommender system designed for benchmarking LLMs on various recommendation tasks. Specifically, we benchmark several popular off-the-shelf LLMs, such as ChatGPT, LLaMA, ChatGLM, on five recommendation tasks, including rating prediction, sequential recommendation, direct recommendation, explanation generation, and review summarization. Furthermore, we investigate the effectiveness of supervised finetuning to improve LLMs' instruction compliance ability. The benchmark results indicate that LLMs displayed only moderate proficiency in accuracy-based tasks such as sequential and direct recommendation. However, they demonstrated comparable performance to state-of-the-art methods in explainability-based tasks. We also conduct qualitative evaluations to further evaluate the quality of contents generated by different models, and the results show that LLMs can truly understand the provided information and generate clearer and more reasonable results. We aspire that this benchmark will serve as an inspiration for researchers to delve deeper into the potential of LLMs in enhancing recommendation performance. Our codes, processed data and benchmark results are available at https://github.com/williamliujl/LLMRec.
thinking: 该论文系统性地评估了多种大语言模型在推荐任务上的表现，填补了LLMs在推荐领域应用研究的空白，具有明确的方法论设计和实证分析。然而，论文主要基于现有模型的基准测试，在技术原创性上有所不足，且其研究结论对图书馆等具体业务场景的直接落地指导性有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过构建LLMRec基准测试发现，大语言模型在推荐任务的可解释性方面表现优异，但在预测准确性方面仅达到中等水平。

title: Horizon Scans can be accelerated using novel information retrieval and artificial intelligence tools
abstract:
arXiv:2504.01627v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Introduction: Horizon scanning in healthcare assesses early signals of innovation, crucial for timely adoption. Current horizon scanning faces challenges in efficient information retrieval and analysis, especially in grey literature, presenting a need for innovative tools.
  Methodology: This article introduces SCANAR and AIDOC, open-source Python-based tools designed to improve horizon scanning. SCANAR automates the retrieval and processing of news articles, using de-duplication and unsupervised relevancy ranking. AIDOC aids filtration by leveraging large language models and text embeddings for calculation of semantic similarity, to reorder data based on relevancy.
  Results: Twelve internal datasets from horizon scans and four external benchmarking datasets were used. SCANAR improved retrieval efficiency by automating processes previously dependent on manual labour. AIDOC displayed work-saving potential, achieving around 65% theoretic reduction in manual review efforts at 95% recall or 20% reduction when adding CMH, an existing open-source algorithm to make data-driven decisions on stopping screening early. Comparative analysis with benchmarking data showed AIDOC's performance was similar to existing systematic review automation tools, though performance varied depending on dataset characteristics.
  Conclusion: The validation indicates that SCANAR and AIDOC show potential to enhance horizon scanning efficiency by streamlining data retrieval and prioritisation. These tools may alleviate methodological limitations and allow broader, swifter horizon scans. Further studies are suggested to optimize these models and to design new workflows and validation processes that integrate large language models.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于利用信息检索和人工智能工具加速医疗保健领域的前沿扫描，提出了SCANAR和AIDOC两个开源工具，在方法上结合了自动化检索、去重、无监督相关度排序以及大语言模型，具有一定的技术前沿性。研究使用了内部和外部数据集进行验证，并量化了减少人工工作量的潜力，方法较为严谨，应用场景明确，但工具性能受数据集特性影响，且主要针对特定领域，通用性有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了两种基于人工智能的开源工具，能够有效提升医疗健康领域前沿扫描的信息检索和筛选效率。

title: A Reduction-Driven Local Search for the Generalized Independent Set Problem
abstract:
arXiv:2505.21052v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: The Generalized Independent Set (GIS) problem extends the classical maximum independent set problem by incorporating profits for vertices and penalties for edges. This generalized problem has been identified in diverse applications in fields such as forest harvest planning, competitive facility location, social network analysis, and even machine learning. However, solving the GIS problem in large-scale, real-world networks remains computationally challenging. In this paper, we explore data reduction techniques to address this challenge. We first propose 14 reduction rules that can reduce the input graph with rigorous optimality guarantees. We then present a reduction-driven local search (RLS) algorithm that integrates these reduction rules into the pre-processing, the initial solution generation, and the local search components in a computationally efficient way. The RLS is empirically evaluated on 278 graphs arising from different application scenarios. The results indicates that the RLS is highly competitive -- For most graphs, it achieves significantly superior solutions compared to other known solvers, and it effectively provides solutions for graphs exceeding 260 million edges, a task at which every other known method fails. Analysis also reveals that the data reduction plays a key role in achieving such a competitive performance.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合数据约简规则的局部搜索算法，用于解决广义独立集问题，在算法设计和实验验证方面具有较高的方法严谨性，并在大规模图处理上展现了技术优势。然而，作为一篇偏重算法理论优化的论文，其与图情领域的具体业务场景（如信息检索系统、知识组织应用）的直接关联性较弱，实践应用价值尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种融合数据约简技术的局部搜索算法，能高效求解大规模图上的广义独立集问题，性能优于现有方法。

title: FindRec: Stein-Guided Entropic Flow for Multi-Modal Sequential Recommendation
abstract:
arXiv:2507.04651v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Modern recommendation systems face significant challenges in processing multimodal sequential data, particularly in temporal dynamics modeling and information flow coordination. Traditional approaches struggle with distribution discrepancies between heterogeneous features and noise interference in multimodal signals. We propose \textbf{FindRec}~ (\textbf{F}lexible unified \textbf{in}formation \textbf{d}isentanglement for multi-modal sequential \textbf{Rec}ommendation), introducing a novel "information flow-control-output" paradigm. The framework features two key innovations: (1) A Stein kernel-based Integrated Information Coordination Module (IICM) that theoretically guarantees distribution consistency between multimodal features and ID streams, and (2) A cross-modal expert routing mechanism that adaptively filters and combines multimodal features based on their contextual relevance. Our approach leverages multi-head subspace decomposition for routing stability and RBF-Stein gradient for unbiased distribution alignment, enhanced by linear-complexity Mamba layers for efficient temporal modeling. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate FindRec's superior performance over state-of-the-art baselines, particularly in handling long sequences and noisy multimodal inputs. Our framework achieves both improved recommendation accuracy and enhanced model interpretability through its modular design. The implementation code is available anonymously online for easy reproducibility~\footnote{https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/FindRec}.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种新颖的多模态序列推荐框架，整合了基于Stein核的信息协调模块和交叉模态专家路由机制，在方法上具有显著的前沿性。其方法严谨，在多个真实数据集上进行了充分实验验证，并公开了代码以确保可复现性。然而，作为一篇偏重算法创新的研究，其具体在图书馆或信息服务机构中的落地应用场景和路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种新的多模态序列推荐模型，通过信息流协调和专家路由机制，有效提升了处理长序列和噪声数据的推荐性能。

title: The Impact of AI Search on the Online Content Ecosystem: Evidence from Google and Reddit
abstract:
arXiv:2605.16428v4 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Search engines traditionally complement online content platforms by directing users seeking information to external websites. The emergence of generative AI search tools that summarize answers directly on the results page may disrupt this relationship by making visits to source platforms optional. We study this question using Google AI Overviews and Reddit, one of the largest online discussion platforms. Our identification exploits Google's content moderation policy: Safe-for-Work (SFW) Reddit communities are indexed by Google organic search and surfaced in Google AI Overviews, while Not-Safe-for-Work (NSFW) communities, though indexed by organic search, are prohibited from being referenced in AI Overview summaries. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that AI Overviews increase engagement in SFW communities: daily comments rise by 12.0 percent and the number of commenting users by 12.4 percent relative to NSFW communities. The effects are concentrated in experience-based discussions (opinions, advice, and personal experiences) rather than fact-based information. However, the subsequent introduction of Google AI Mode, which allows users to interact conversationally with the AI summary, largely eliminates these gains in experience-based content. These results suggest that the effects of AI search depend critically on interface design and content type.
thinking: 论文利用自然实验设计，通过对比SFW与NSFW社区在Google AI Overviews上线前后的差异，方法严谨且识别策略巧妙。研究聚焦于生成式AI搜索对内容生态的实际影响，具有明确的实践意义，但所采用的技术（AI摘要）本身已是当前主流应用，前沿性略显不足。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，生成式AI搜索摘要能提升经验讨论类内容的用户参与度，但这种提升会因后续交互功能（如对话模式）的引入而消失。

title: ScholarQuest: A Taxonomy-Guided Benchmark for Agentic Academic Paper Search in Open Literature Environments
abstract:
arXiv:2606.20235v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Academic paper search is a core step in scientific research, and LLM-based search agents are emerging as a promising paradigm for iterative, intent-driven literature exploration. However, existing benchmarks offer limited coverage of research intents and insufficient support for scalable answer construction and reproducible multi-turn evaluation. We propose \textbf{ScholarQuest}, a taxonomy-guided benchmark constructed from over 1,000 computer science topics and organized around four research intents. To construct answer sets at scale, we combine multi-source retrieval, citation expansion, and multi-stage relevance adjudication. We further build \textit{\textbf{ScholarBase}}, a million-scale literature environment with unified retrieval and citation-expansion interfaces, together with a shared multi-turn search harness. We benchmark complete literature search systems and compare language models within this harness, evaluating retrieval coverage, search efficiency, and robustness across research intents. Results show that agentic methods outperform single-shot retrieval baselines, yet the best-performing search system achieves only 0.312 Recall@100 and 0.352 Recall@All. Comparisons under the shared harness reveal intent-dependent model strengths, with higher Planner token consumption not consistently yielding higher recall. We release the benchmark, retrieval backend, and evaluation harness for reproducible research
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于分类法指导的学术论文搜索基准测试框架，结合了多源检索、引文扩展和多阶段相关性判定等前沿方法，技术新颖度较高。其构建的百万级文献环境与多轮搜索评估工具具有较好的可复现性和实践潜力，但基准测试结果本身（如Recall@100仅为0.312）表明现有系统性能仍有较大提升空间，方法严谨性主要体现在规模化数据构建和标准化评估流程上。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个基于大语言模型的、支持多轮意图驱动的学术论文搜索基准测试平台，用于系统评估和比较智能文献检索方法的性能。

title: From Clicks to Intent: Cross-Platform Session Embeddings with LLM-Distilled Taxonomy for Financial Services Recommendations
abstract:
arXiv:2606.26277v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Sequential user behavior modeling is widely adopted in industrial recommender systems; however, significant gaps remain in financial services, where pre-login web interactions and authenticated in-app experiences differ drastically. Specifically, pre-login web users typically explore new products, whereas logged-in app users focus on account servicing. Due to the challenge of cross-channel entity resolution (e.g., matching anonymous web sessions to authenticated mobile accounts), web-based intent signals remain underutilized for post-authentication personalization. Existing methods for capturing web-based intent are often ad-hoc and narrow, lacking the flexibility to support both quantitative downstream recommendations and qualitative understanding at scale. In this work, we propose a scalable and dual-purpose intent prediction framework for web-based interactions and demonstrate its applicability for personalization. Our approach transforms raw web clickstreams into two outputs: a self-supervised Transformer encodes multi-modal clickstreams into a compact session embedding, while an LLM-based taxonomy generation and distillation pipeline produces interpretable intent labels. Our system demonstrates that self-supervised clickstream representations combined with LLM-distilled taxonomies can jointly serve quantitative tasks and qualitative understanding in production: on the mobile homepage tile ranking task, the session embedding improves macro Recall@1 by 1.88% and reduces Log Loss by 13.38% over production baselines. On the user conversion prediction task, the embedding outperforms the LLM labels by 4.3% on micro F1, while the distillation layer delivers interpretable labels at ultra-low latency with only a 7% performance drop.

title: An LLM-powered Agentic Recommendation System for Connected TV Content Discovery
abstract:
arXiv:2607.09988v4 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Recommendation systems, from traditional multi-stage to recent unified generative architectures, face challenges in incorporating diverse contextual signals, such as trending topics, breaking news, cultural events, and cross-surface user activities, into their ranking pipelines. These systems are designed to consume structured behavioral signals with consistent schemas, and lack the reasoning capability to naturally process unstructured or heterogeneously formatted contextual information. Incorporating such signals typically requires feature engineering, bespoke data pipelines, and carefully tuned heuristics. In this paper, we present an LLM-powered agentic recommendation system designed for Connected TV (CTV) content discovery that addresses these limitations. Our system leverages the reasoning capabilities of large language models to naturally process and synthesize diverse signals across varying schemas and structures, eliminating much of the manual integration inherent in traditional ranking and retrieval systems. Recognizing that current LLM-based solutions still fall short of traditional machine learning models in several recommendation tasks, including retrieval efficiency, personalization precision, and scalability, we adopt an agentic architecture that orchestrates specialized components, allowing each sub-task to be handled by the most suitable method, whether LLM-based or traditional ML. The main contribution of this work is our engineering approach to successfully overcoming the practical limitations of enabling LLM for recommendation, particularly inference latency. We share insights from our work and discuss the trade-offs and lessons learned in building a hybrid system that combines the flexibility of LLMs with the performance of established recommendation techniques.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合大语言模型与传统机器学习方法的混合推荐系统，在技术前沿性方面表现突出，特别是其智能体架构设计。研究具有较强的业务落地价值，针对智能电视内容发现场景，并提供了工程实现细节与权衡分析。方法严谨性方面，论文虽未详细描述实验设计与评估指标，但基于arXiv预印本性质，其技术路线描述清晰，具备一定参考价值。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究设计了一个结合大语言模型推理能力与传统机器学习性能的智能体架构，用于智能电视内容推荐，以解决异构上下文信息整合与系统效率的难题。

title: QASP: Query-Adaptive Robust Vector Search Policy
abstract:
arXiv:2607.29606v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: A fundamental challenge of vector search is achieving consistently high recall while minimizing computational costs. Fixed search parameters cause significant performance variance across queries, and conventional evaluation on average recall masks these per-query disparities. We introduce QASP (Query-Adaptive robust vector Search Policy), which predicts the complete recall progression curve per query via a single upfront supervised regression, from which a search policy is derived for any recall target; this avoids iterative model invocations during search or separate predictors per target. By predicting normalized recall values with scale-invariant features and pre-search inference, QASP generalizes across recall targets, index configurations, and datasets. Its fine-grained progress predictions further enable a lightweight reactive complement that adjusts search depth based on predicted-versus-observed deviations without additional inference. We prove that QASP requires a finite training sample independent of dataset size and dimensionality, that its loss exceeds the irreducible lower bound of any fixed policy by a vanishing margin, and that its data access savings over fixed probing grow exponentially in intrinsic dimensionality. Experimentally, QASP achieves significantly lower recall variance and deviation from target, higher query satisfaction rate, and scales to large data and hierarchical indices without retraining, achieving 99% recall with 80% less data access.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于查询自适应的向量检索策略，通过单次回归预测每个查询的完整召回曲线，有效解决了固定参数导致的性能波动问题。其方法在理论上有严格的样本复杂度保证和性能下界分析，实验验证了在大规模数据和分层索引上的良好泛化能力，但作为预印本尚未经过同行评议的完整检验。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种能根据每个查询动态预测最优搜索参数的向量检索方法，在保证高召回率的同时大幅降低了计算开销。

title: SIDScope: A Diagnostic Resource for Semantic-ID Interfaces in Generative Recommendation
abstract:
arXiv:2608.18779v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Semantic ID tokenizers assign code sequences to catalog items, which generative recommenders predict and resolve back to items. Reusing a released mapping requires checking its code organization, item resolution, and compatibility with an existing model after a refresh. SIDScope provides these checks through source traced adapters, mapping diagnostics, candidate retrieval tests, and generated trace analysis. Its inventory contains nine exports from seven tokenizer families across Amazon and Yelp, including eight executable routes and one auditable snapshot. The analyses establish three distinctions. First, code allocation and item addressability differ: in GRID, tail items occupy 95.7 distinct codes per 100 items, yet only 82.2 percent have globally unique codes. Second, prefix alignment calibrates retrieval operations that use prefixes. With fixed candidate budgets and ranking, original assignments on Beauty and Instruments expose more targets than controls preserving code capacity and coarse popularity. Resolving identical generated paths also shows that an explicit item selection rule recovers part of the gap between target path survival and singleton credit. Third, a released refresh repairs missing codes, while model adaptation separately restores new item recall. SIDScope supplies code, diagnostic summaries, and verification tools to compare mappings, evaluate their use in retrieval and generation, and test model reuse after changes.
thinking: 论文提出了SIDScope诊断工具，针对生成式推荐系统中语义ID分词器的映射质量、代码组织和模型兼容性进行系统评估，方法设计严谨且提供了开源工具，具有较高的实践价值。但研究聚焦于特定技术环节的评估框架，前沿技术度虽涉及生成式推荐，但核心贡献在于诊断方法而非技术突破。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一个诊断工具，用于系统评估生成式推荐系统中语义ID映射的质量、兼容性与刷新后的模型复用效果。

title: Open Tabular Insight Extraction: Where Do We Stand, and Where Should We Go?
abstract:
arXiv:2609.07629v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Democratizing access to the knowledge held in large corpora of tables such as data lakes is emerging as a central research challenge. Research in this space is advancing and broadening in scope, increasingly supplying the components to satisfy a person's insight need end-to-end. Yet these efforts remain fragmented across communities that frame the problem under their own conventions, such as table question answering, text-to-SQL, and data analysis agents, with works six times as likely to cite within the same task label as across labels. To bring these communities onto common ground, we establish a holistic framework for this pursuit, which we refer to as Open Tabular Insight Extraction (OpenTI). We formalize OpenTI from first principles around the analytical knowledge a person needs, the procedure for deriving it from a corpus of tables, and how well a result serves the person who sought it. In doing so we consolidate frameworks and terminology across information retrieval, natural language processing, machine learning, databases, and human-computer interaction, and apply this grounding in a systematic review and analysis of systems and benchmarks that work towards OpenTI. We find that current systems do not cover the end-to-end scope of OpenTI, mainly focusing on the analysis itself, and that benchmarks are largely unfit for evaluations in an open setting as inputs presuppose knowledge of tables, and validation mechanisms do not match the setup. Finally, we distill a research agenda towards OpenTI systems, evaluation, and interaction paradigms that surface the insights users need. An interactive companion to our paper is available at https://open-tabular-insight-extraction.github.io.
thinking: 该论文通过建立Open Tabular Insight Extraction (OpenTI) 统一框架，系统整合了表格问答、Text-to-SQL和数据分析代理等多个领域的研究，具有较高的理论整合价值和方法论前瞻性。然而，作为一篇综述与框架性论文，其本身并未提出新的核心技术或进行实证验证，因此在技术前沿性和方法严谨性上存在局限，其应用价值主要体现在为未来研究提供路线图。
one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一个统一的“开放表格洞察提取”框架，旨在整合表格数据处理领域的碎片化研究，并为未来系统开发与评估指明方向。

title: Eval4DiRec: A Unified and Systematic Evaluation Framework for Diffusion-based Recommender Systems
abstract:
arXiv:2609.34404v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Leveraging the strong generative capabilities and stable training dynamics of diffusion models, diffusion-based recommender systems (RSs) have recently emerged as a novel recommendation paradigm, attracting increasing attention from both academia and industry. However, despite the rapid growth of diffusion-based RSs, a critical issue has emerged: the lack of a unified and systematic quantitative evaluation benchmark, which often results in irreproducible experimental results and unfair comparisons across studies due to inconsistent data processing, training configurations, inference procedures, and evaluation protocols. To address this challenge, we propose Eval4DiRec, the first unified and open-source evaluation framework specifically designed for diffusion-based RSs. Eval4DiRec supports 14 representative diffusion-based RS models across five different recommendation scenarios, providing consistent and reproducible experimental settings to systematically assess their performance. Built upon this framework, we conduct extensive empirical studies to benchmark these models under unified protocols. The results highlight the strong potential of diffusion models for recommendation while also revealing key factors and practical challenges that substantially affect their performance, thereby establishing a solid foundation to facilitate fair evaluation and guide future research in this promising field. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/wangcong2001/Eval4DiRec.
thinking: 该论文针对扩散推荐系统领域缺乏统一评估基准的问题，提出了首个开源评估框架，并进行了广泛的实证研究，方法严谨且具有重要的规范价值。然而，其核心贡献在于构建评估基础设施，而非提出新的前沿推荐模型或算法。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究为基于扩散模型的推荐系统创建了一个统一的评估框架，旨在解决该领域实验结果不可复现和比较不公平的问题。

title: Decision-Oriented Recommendation Reranking: An Empirical Study of Its Promise and Limitations
abstract:
arXiv:2609.40241v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for recommendation reranking, but their use introduces an important trade-off between recommendation quality and serving efficiency. We investigate whether decision-oriented systems provide a useful alternative when the reranking task is fundamentally a structured choice among predefined candidate items. Specifically, we conduct a controlled empirical study of two decision-oriented systems, TypeSafe Jev and OpenAI Decisions, for recommendation reranking. Across three Amazon Reviews domains and four candidate-set sizes, we compare these systems against recommendation-specific models and pointwise and listwise LLM-based rerankers, systematically evaluating recommendation effectiveness, candidate-order robustness, and efficiency and scalability. Our results reveal that Jev frequently achieves a favorable quality--latency trade-off, offering competitive recommendation effectiveness at substantially lower observed latency than stronger LLM-based alternatives. Overall, our findings suggest that specialization for decision-making does not inherently guarantee superior recommendation quality or robustness. Instead, the practical value of decision-oriented inference depends on implementation-specific characteristics and application requirements. These findings motivate further investigation of decision-oriented systems for recommendation and other ranking tasks with structured output spaces.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于大语言模型在推荐重排序任务中的效率与质量权衡问题，通过实证研究比较了决策导向系统与LLM基线的性能。其优势在于设计严谨，在多个数据集和候选集规模下进行了系统评估，但研究场景相对特定，结论的普适性有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，针对结构化选择的决策导向推荐重排序系统，在特定实现下能以更低延迟达到与大语言模型相竞争的效果。

title: Iterative Critique-Refine Framework for Enhancing LLM Personalization
abstract:
arXiv:2510.24469v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Personalized text generation requires models not only to produce coherent text but also to align with a target user's style, tone, and topical focus. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches such as LaMP and PGraphRAG enrich profiles with user and neighbor histories, but they stop at generation and often yield outputs that drift in tone, topic, or style. We present PerFine, a unified, training-free critique-refine framework that enhances personalization through iterative, profile-grounded feedback. In each iteration, an LLM generator produces a draft conditioned on the retrieved profile, and a critic LLM - also conditioned on the same profile - provides structured feedback on tone, vocabulary, sentence structure, and topicality. The generator then revises, while a novel knockout strategy retains the stronger draft across iterations. We further study additional inference-time strategies such as Best-of-N and Topic Extraction to balance quality and efficiency. Across Yelp, Goodreads, and Amazon datasets, PerFine consistently improves personalization over PGraphRAG, with G-Eval gains of +8.5-12%, steady improvements over 3-5 refinement iterations, and scalability with increasing critic size. These results highlight that post-hoc, profile-aware feedback offers a powerful paradigm for personalized LLM generation that is both training-free and model-agnostic.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型的个性化文本生成迭代优化框架，通过引入独立的评论模型进行结构化反馈，在无需额外训练的情况下提升了生成内容与用户画像的契合度，方法设计新颖且实验验证充分。其局限性在于主要面向公开评论数据集，在图书馆等专业场景下的实际应用路径和成本效益尚需进一步探索。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种无需训练的迭代式反馈框架，通过让大语言模型自我批判和修订，有效提升了生成文本与用户个人风格的匹配度。

title: From Topology to Retrieval: Decoding Embedding Spaces with Unified Signatures
abstract:
arXiv:2511.22150v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Studying the shape of text embedding spaces enhances our understanding of model behavior and how geometry affects downstream task performance. While a range of topological and geometric metrics have been explored, they are typically analyzed in isolation, and the connections between them remain largely unknown. In this paper, we present Unified Topological Signatures (UTS) for characterizing the structure of embedding spaces. We evaluate our method across a wide range of text embedding models and retrieval datasets, finding that it outperforms individual metrics in downstream performance prediction. Through several experiments, we demonstrate that the signatures characterize embedding spaces more accurately, improve the prediction of model-specific properties and biases, and reveal novel insights into representational similarity that challenge the global claims of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种统一拓扑签名方法，用于系统地表征文本嵌入空间的结构，并验证了其在预测下游检索任务性能方面的优越性。其优势在于将多种拓扑几何度量整合为一个统一框架，方法较为严谨，并通过广泛的模型和数据集进行了验证；不足之处在于其核心贡献更偏向于提供一种新的分析视角和评估工具，对图书馆或信息机构业务流程的直接改造价值尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种统一拓扑签名方法，能更准确地分析和预测不同文本嵌入模型在下游检索任务中的表现。

title: UMM-RM: An Upcycle-and-Merge MoE Reward Model for Mitigating Reward Hacking
abstract:
arXiv:2512.00724v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Reward models (RMs) are critical to reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF). However, policy models can exploit biases or spurious correlations in dense RMs, causing reward hacking: RM scores rise while alignment with human preferences deteriorates, especially under distribution shift. We propose UMM-RM (Upcycle-and-Merge MoE Reward Model), which copies the feed-forward layers of an SFT checkpoint to initialize shared and routed experts, then trains the model on preference data. The always-active shared expert captures instruction-agnostic preference signals, while routed experts model fine-grained preferences across instructions or tasks. The experts are then merged into a single dense RM using learnable weights, preserving the robustness and exploitation resistance of expert diversity without MoE or ensemble inference overhead. Across multiple base models and preference datasets, UMM-RM improves preference accuracy, reduces reward hacking during PPO training, and achieves more stable preference alignment than standard dense RMs.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种创新的奖励模型架构UMM-RM，通过复用SFT模型参数并采用专家混合与合并技术来缓解强化学习中的奖励破解问题，技术方案前沿且设计巧妙。研究在多个基础模型和数据集上进行了验证，方法严谨，但其作为预印本论文，在图情领域的具体业务落地场景尚不明确，应用价值有待进一步转化。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种新型奖励模型架构，能有效减少人工智能对齐训练中的奖励作弊现象，提升模型与人类偏好的一致性。

title: Can David Beat Goliath? On Multi-Hop Reasoning with Resource-Constrained Agents
abstract:
arXiv:2601.21699v5 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) trains small language model agents to answer multi-hop questions by retrieving evidence over multiple turns, but reported gains typically rely on thousands of on-policy rollouts per update. We study RL for such agents on commodity GPUs, where each update samples only a few rollouts per question. Most sampled trajectories then retrieve none of the required evidence, so the outcome reward gives the policy little to learn from and small agents settle for answering without retrieval, a failure we call retrieval collapse. DAVID-GRPO addresses this with two mechanisms: (1) expert trajectory seeding places a handful of off-policy expert trajectories into the GRPO groups of the early updates, and (2) evidence-guided continuation rewards evidence coverage and resumes the most promising partial trajectory. The evidence for each training question is constructed from the corpus link graph, without annotated evidence. On six multi-hop QA benchmarks, DAVID-GRPO trained on four RTX 3090 GPUs with 144 rollouts per step brings Qwen2.5-1.5B to 22.6 average EM against 11.9 for the best baseline under the same budget, is comparable to Tree-GRPO trained with 20 times more rollouts, and, unlike the baselines that stop after at most one search, learns to retrieve across turns. The implementation is available at: https://github.com/AsadalJung/David-GRPO
thinking: 论文提出了一种针对资源受限环境下多跳推理任务的强化学习优化方法，通过专家轨迹种子和证据引导奖励机制有效缓解了检索崩溃问题，方法设计具有创新性且实验验证充分。但研究场景高度特定于技术优化，与图书馆、信息机构等典型图情业务的直接关联较弱。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种新的强化学习方法，能在有限的GPU计算资源下，有效训练小型语言模型进行多跳问题回答和证据检索。

title: Efficient K-generalizable Learned Search
abstract:
arXiv:2603.06159v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Learned top-K search improves the accuracy-latency trade-off of graph-based vector search, but existing methods target a fixed K. Serving real-world workloads with various K values thus incurs preprocessing cost proportional to the number of distinct Ks.
  We present OMEGA, which supports efficient arbitrary K learned search with the preprocessing cost of one top-1 model. It achieves so by reducing learned top-K search to repeated masked learned top-1 search with refinement, using carefully crafted trajectory features that generalize across Ks. OMEGA further employs rank-wise confidence allocation to tame error accumulation during refinements and applies a statistical forecast method to reduce model invocation overhead without compromising recall. Across nine dataset-scale configurations, OMEGA meets the 0.95 recall target and reduces mean latency by up to 65% (average: 23%; median: 20%) compared with learned search methods (including LAET, DARTH, MultiK-DARTH, ANNiE, and Ada-ef) at their lowest-preprocessing configurations. On production traces, it reduces total CPU time by up to 28% versus traditional HNSW search.
thinking: 论文提出了一种支持任意K值的高效学习搜索方法OMEGA，通过将学习式top-K搜索转化为重复的掩码式top-1搜索，并引入轨迹特征和统计预测方法，在保持高召回率的同时显著降低了延迟和计算开销。其方法设计巧妙，在多个数据集和实际生产环境中验证了有效性，技术前沿且方法严谨，但作为一项检索算法研究，其直接面向图书馆等业务场景的落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种名为OMEGA的新方法，能够高效支持任意数量的搜索结果（K值），在保证准确性的同时大幅提升搜索速度。

title: yProv4DV: Filling the visualization gap in reproducible research workflows
abstract:
arXiv:2603.20437v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: While results visualization is a critical phase to the communication of new academic results, plots are frequently shared without the complete combination of code, input data, execution context and outputs required to independently reproduce the resulting figures. Existing reproducibility solutions tend to focus on computational pipelines or workflow management systems, not covering script-based visualization practices commonly used by researchers and practitioners. Additionally, the minimalist nature of current Python data visualization libraries tend to speed up the creation of images, disincentivizing users from spending time integrating additional tools into these short scripts. This paper proposes yProv4DV, a library lightweight designed to enable reproducible data visualization scripts through the use of provenance information, minimizing the necessity for code modifications. Through a single call, users can track inputs, outputs and source code files, enabling saving and full reproducibility of their data visualization software. As a result, this library fills a gap in reproducible research workflows by addressing the reproducibility of plots in scientific publications.
thinking: 论文针对科研可视化脚本的可复现性提出了一种轻量级解决方案，通过捕获来源信息来简化流程，具有明确的技术创新性。然而，该方法主要面向Python脚本环境，在更复杂的可视化工具链或非编程场景下的落地潜力有待验证，且论文主要展示了概念和原型，缺乏大规模用户研究或对比实验来充分证明其有效性和严谨性。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一个轻量级Python库，通过自动捕获代码、数据和环境信息，旨在解决科研论文中图表难以复现的问题。

title: When LLM Reward Design Fails: Diagnostic-Driven Refinement for Sparse Structured RL
abstract:
arXiv:2605.28918v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: For sparse, structured reinforcement-learning tasks with semantic reward-function interfaces, LLM-generated reward shaping is better framed as debugging than one-shot generation. We study PPO-trained agents using MiniGrid as core evaluation and MuJoCo reaching/locomotion as boundary stress tests. Our qualitative audit finds two recurring one-shot failure modes -- reward flooding and semantic/API misunderstanding -- and a rarer, less reliably distinguished weak-shaping case. We propose diagnostic-driven iterative refinement, using training diagnostics and a failure-mode taxonomy to guide reward-function revision. On sparse structured tasks with diagnosable reward failures, refinement improves DoorKey-8x8 from 2.3% success without shaping to 97.6%, and KeyCorridor from 31.2% one-shot to 86.7% with high seed-to-seed variance. Controls show these gains are not from generic retrying or extra training alone: metrics-only re-prompting causes large drops, while a static-vocabulary control recovers much of the gap. Thus taxonomy prompting is a major mechanism, with only partially isolated incremental evidence for dynamic labels. In prompt-matched comparisons across Haiku 4.5, Opus 5, and DeepSeek V4 Pro, effects depend on task and model; none of the six contrasts survives family-wise correction. A four-call, episode-budget-matched population control is also competitive. Component-removal and sensitivity tests reveal calibration limits. In continuous control, success-based diagnostics can misfire in dense-reward locomotion; return-trend feedback removes one false-positive mechanism without robust locomotion gains. The method is bounded to sparse structured tasks with reliable structured interfaces under PPO training.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于大语言模型在强化学习奖励函数设计中的调试方法，提出了基于诊断驱动的迭代优化框架，在稀疏结构化任务中显著提升了成功率。其优势在于结合了LLM与强化学习的前沿技术，并提供了具体的问题分类和实验验证；但方法主要适用于特定任务类型，且实验结果的统计显著性未完全确立，限制了其通用性和严谨性。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种通过诊断和分类来迭代优化大语言模型生成的强化学习奖励函数的方法，在特定任务上大幅提升了智能体的成功率。

title: Retrievable Gradients: Continual Post-Training Without Cumulative Weight Drift
abstract:
arXiv:2606.15734v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Continual post-training enables models to absorb emerging knowledge after deployment, but repeatedly updating shared parameters can accumulate weight drift, potentially causing catastrophic forgetting and degrading general capabilities. Retrieval-augmented generation avoids such parameter drift, yet often lacks the depth of parametric knowledge integration. In this paper, we propose ReGrad (Retrievable Gradients), a new paradigm that treats gradients as retrievable units of knowledge. ReGrad pre-computes document-specific gradients offline, stores them in an indexed Gradient Bank, and retrieves only query-relevant gradients at inference time for temporary weight adaptation. However, raw language-modeling gradients are optimized for token-level document reconstruction rather than for query-driven knowledge use. We therefore introduce a bi-level meta-learning objective that reshapes document-derived gradients into generalizable adaptation signals for downstream tasks.
