Experiments across general and domain-specific settings show that \textsc{ReGrad} outperforms CPT and RAG baselines, enabling scalable and reversible parametric knowledge injection without accumulating weight drift.
thinking: 论文提出了一种名为ReGrad的新范式，将梯度作为可检索的知识单元，通过离线预计算和检索增强来避免持续训练中的权重漂移问题，并引入了双层元学习目标来优化梯度信号。该方法在技术和思路上具有显著的前沿性，但其作为arXiv预印本，方法细节和实验验证的完备性有待正式发表后进一步审视，且其实践落地到具体图情业务场景的路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种通过检索文档特定梯度来更新模型的新方法，旨在实现持续学习的同时避免模型性能的灾难性遗忘。

title: Decoupling Search from Reasoning: A Vendor-Agnostic Grounding Architecture for LLM Agents
abstract:
arXiv:2606.18947v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Production LLM agents increasingly depend on real-time search, yet native search grounding bundles retrieval policy, provider choice, evidence injection, cost, latency, and generation behavior behind a single model-provider boundary. This coupling makes grounding hard to inspect, tune, reuse, or port, and can trigger Search-Induced Verbosity that breaks strict output contracts. We present Decoupled Search Grounding (DSG), a vendor-agnostic boundary that moves grounding outside the reasoning model through an MCP-compatible gateway, exposing provider routing, source-aware context rendering, configured fallback, retrieval-depth control, and exact plus semantic caching as first-class controls. Across five frontier models on SimpleQA, FreshQA, and HotpotQA, native search leads on recency-sensitive FreshQA, but DSG exposes a stronger frontier when control matters: on SimpleQA it nearly matches native accuracy (86.1% vs. 87.7%) at 91% lower search cost, preserves concise answer contracts, and reaches a 99.4% warm-cache hit rate with 68% lower latency. Deployed as a shared production grounding layer for large-scale agentic workloads with interchangeable models, DSG matches native-search accuracy on an e-commerce query-understanding (QIU) workload while cutting search cost by over 98%. Real-time grounding is best treated as an optimizable interface boundary, not a fixed model feature.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种解耦搜索与推理的LLM智能体架构，通过引入供应商无关的中间层实现了对检索策略、成本、延迟等要素的独立控制，在信息检索与AI应用交叉领域具有显著的方法创新性。其研究基于多模型、多数据集的对比实验，方法严谨，且通过电商查询理解案例证明了大规模生产部署的可行性，业务落地价值明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种将搜索功能从大语言模型中解耦的通用架构，能在保持高准确率的同时大幅降低搜索成本与延迟。

title: DRNOISE: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents in Misleading Evidence Environments
abstract:
arXiv:2607.17291v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Deep research agents increasingly operate over the open web, where relevant records coexist with redundant summaries, outdated reports, and misleading documents. Existing evaluations offer limited insight into whether agents preserve sound evidential standards when an ordinary-looking false document is deliberately seeded into a searchable environment and offers a direct shortcut to a conflicting answer. We introduce DRNOISE, a 100-task benchmark for answer recovery under misleading evidence. Each task has a unique gold answer supported by two corroborating indirect record chains; the paired noisy condition adds one plausible document that states a conflicting answer directly. The benchmark spans ten families of evidence operations. Among models with strong clean-task performance in the shared agent framework, this single intervention causes 66--88 percentage-point accuracy drops. Trace analyses reveal a pattern of verification inertia: agents often retrieve truthful records yet defer to the answer-like document without adequately checking its claim against the underlying evidence. Generic verification prompts reduce but do not close this gap. The setting is especially relevant to open-web deployment, where plausible falsehoods arrive through ordinary-looking pages without explicit adversarial instructions. Reliable deep research therefore requires more than retrieval and citation; it requires active reconciliation of direct claims with record-level evidence.
thinking: 该论文针对深度研究代理在开放网络环境中易受误导性证据影响的问题，提出了一个包含100个任务的基准测试DRNOISE，并揭示了代理存在‘验证惰性’这一关键缺陷。研究设计严谨，通过构建包含间接证据链和直接误导文档的对比任务，有效评估了代理的鲁棒性，但其前沿性主要体现在对现有LLM代理框架的测试上，而非提出全新的技术方法。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，当前基于大语言模型的深度研究代理在面对看似合理的误导性文档时，存在严重的‘验证惰性’，导致答案准确性大幅下降。

title: Audit Before You Update: Recording Artifacts and the Limits of Bounded Model Updates in MIMIC-IV ICU Prediction
abstract:
arXiv:2607.19020v5 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Clinical prediction models in intensive care degrade as data shift, and regulators such as the FDA ask developers to specify bounded update protocols in advance. Evaluations of such protocols assume that apparent drift reflects clinical practice rather than changes in how the database records care. We test whether update strategies can be evaluated on unaudited ICU data, and whether a parameter-bounded update gives up accuracy or attribution stability relative to full fine-tuning once the data are audited. We audit MIMIC-IV 3.1 (2008-2022) for recording artifacts and define a cleaning protocol. On the cleaned cohort, a label-free classifier two-sample test gates updates across three eras. We compare a bounded update, which retrains only treatment-context and fusion parameters, with full fine-tuning for two model families and two targets under a pre-specified non-inferiority margin of 0.015 AUROC, and measure attribution stability against the source model. In 2020-2022 about half of ICU stays have no input or procedure-event records, and a vasopressor ItemID migration makes the 2017-2019 label rate appear to fall when it actually rises. On the cleaned cohort, the gate detects drift in every era, including in physiology-only features, with no false alarms on null data. Bounded updating is non-inferior or superior in 10 of 12 primary cells, but this depends on the target, the model family and learning-rate tuning, and adaptation gains over never updating are small. At a shared learning rate, bounded updates keep physiological attributions more stable in neural models, clearly for vasopressor and less clearly for intubation; with separately tuned rates, full updates are more stable. Audits should precede update evaluation, and the update boundary should be chosen per target.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于ICU临床预测模型的更新策略评估，其核心贡献在于揭示了未经审计的数据记录伪影（如ItemID迁移、记录缺失）会严重误导模型更新决策，并提出了结合数据清洗和漂移检测的审计框架。研究方法严谨，在MIMIC-IV数据集上进行了详实的实证分析，并设定了明确的非劣效性边界；其发现对依赖电子健康记录进行模型维护的实践具有直接指导意义。然而，论文采用的技术方法（如参数有界更新、漂移检测）虽稳健，但并非当前最前沿的AI技术。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在更新ICU预测模型前，必须对数据进行审计以排除记录伪影的干扰，否则可能做出错误的更新决策。

title: SciCurateBench: Curating Experimental Data from Heterogeneous Scientific Literature with Verbal-Action Agents
abstract:
arXiv:2610.14393v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Scientific research increasingly depends on curating experimental data from literature. Scientific data curation requires verifying exact experimental conditions (e.g., specific assays, clinical outcomes, and data availability) across long, heterogeneous files, which is a highly time-consuming process. Existing benchmarks evaluate only broad relevance on short queries, failing to capture this complexity. We introduce SciCurateBench, a benchmark of 200 expert-annotated papers from major life-science journals that challenges systems to verify conjunctive biological experimental criteria from raw, unprocessed scientific literature. We show that plain LLMs and popular reasoning, tool-using, and feedback-based agents all struggle with this task. To study what makes the task tractable, we further propose LangPoli, an integrative system in which a policy agent generates natural language action guidelines that actor agents convert into executable tools. LangPoli showed strong performance on both Paper Classification (83.16% F1 vs. 58.22% for its base LLM) and Structured Information Retrieval, and also improves re-ranking on the public benchmarks of LitSearch, BEIR, and TREC. We further explore curriculum transfer, a method that distills generalizable strategies from solved tasks to accelerate the solving of related problems. We hope this work facilitates research in truly practical scientific AI assistance. The anonymized pre-release can be found from https://anonymous.4open. science/r/scicuratebench-D885/.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个面向生命科学文献的实验数据策展基准SciCurateBench，并设计了集成策略的智能体系统LangPoli来解决该任务，在技术方法上具有前沿性。其基准构建和系统验证过程严谨，但作为预印本论文，其提出的系统在真实图书馆或信息机构数据管理流程中的具体落地路径和成本效益尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个从复杂科学文献中精确提取实验数据的评测基准，并提出了一个基于语言智能体的集成系统来有效完成此项任务。

title: NepPlural: A Human-Anchored Benchmark for Persona Annotation in Nepali Migration Discourse
abstract:
arXiv:2610.15732v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Pluralistic alignment asks that language models faithfully represent a society's diverse, competing values rather than collapse them into one dominant viewpoint, yet flagship pluralistic-alignment datasets remain heavily skewed toward Western respondents. We introduce NepPlural, a human-anchored benchmark for modelling competing socio-cultural personas in Nepali public discourse on youth migration and brain drain. We curate 2,148 code-mixed (Devanagari, Romanized Nepali, English) YouTube comments, annotate them along a four-axis persona taxonomy (Intent, Primary Driver, Value Orientation, Affect) plus an explicit No-Persona class, and build a 300-comment gold set labelled independently by three native Nepali speakers (mean Fleiss' $\kappa \approx 0.55$). Using this gold set to audit automatic annotation, we find that LLM annotation reliability is driven by protocol. Labels collected in batches through chat interfaces reach only near-chance inter-model agreement ($\kappa \approx 0.17$). Annotating one comment at a time raises agreement above the native-speaker level ($\kappa \approx 0.72$), but consistency is not validity: under a forced-choice schema, models agree on personas for the 39% of comments native speakers judge to express none, keeping macro-F1 against human gold near 0.50. Allowing abstention resolves this: models recover No-Persona comments with F1 of 0.79 to 0.87 and, against leave-one-annotator-out references, match or exceed individual native speakers (macro-F1 0.75 to 0.86 vs. 0.75). Encoders fine-tuned on the batched labels reach only 0.34. Finally, a human-judged steerability probe finds that three frontier models adopt single persona axes with 59 to 77% fidelity but compose full personas only 33% of the time, with no congruence gap detected at this scale between Western-congruent and Nepali-collectivist personas.
thinking: 该论文构建了尼泊尔语多语言社交媒体评论的多元对齐标注数据集，并系统评估了LLM的标注性能与局限性，方法严谨且具有跨文化视角。其前沿性体现在对非西方语境下大语言模型对齐问题的探索，但技术方法本身（LLM标注与评估）在NLP领域已较为常见，且其直接业务落地于图书馆或信息机构的价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 论文构建了一个尼泊尔语数据集，发现大语言模型在标注多元社会观点时存在协议与效度分离的问题，且其表现高度依赖于标注协议的设计。

title: Latent Taxonomies: How Property Induction Develops in Language Model Pre-training
abstract:
arXiv:2610.15836v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: When told that robins have sesamoid bones, people are far more prone to extend the property to sparrows than to whales. This behavior, called category-based property induction, is well documented in humans, but whether and how it develops in language models trained only to predict the next token is unclear. To shed light on this, we construct a hierarchical taxonomy of synthetic entities grouped by the properties they share. We then inject facts from this latent taxonomy into the continued pre-training of Pythia and OLMo 2 models from 70M to 7B parameters, and track the development of inductive behaviors. We find that taxonomically aligned induction emerges from next-token prediction alone: a property learned for one entity transfers more strongly within its taxonomic category than across categories. Internally, entities that share a deeper category become more similar in activation space, and clustering recovers the full taxonomic tree from entity representations. Contrary to the usual expectation that scale helps, we find that induction weakens with model size when the data budget is fixed, suggesting that larger models memorize individual facts rather than compress them into shared structure. Induction also strengthens with more pre-training before the taxonomy injection, transfers to novel in-context properties, and can be overridden by a latent taxonomy implied by the prompt. Together, these results show that a model's inductive generalization reflects the latent organization of its training data, with implications for data curation and for predicting how far a learned fact will spread.
thinking: 该论文通过构建合成实体层次分类法，系统研究了语言模型在预训练中如何发展基于类别的属性归纳能力，方法设计严谨且具有创新性。然而，研究基于合成数据，其结论在真实图情业务场景（如知识组织、语义检索）中的直接应用路径尚不明确，实践价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，语言模型仅通过预测下一个词的训练，就能自发形成与数据潜在结构一致的分类归纳能力，且模型越大越倾向于记忆而非归纳。

title: PersonaFactor: Preference Factors with Dynamic Selection for LLM Personalization
abstract:
arXiv:2610.16372v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Although users may express different personalization needs across tasks, these task-specific behaviors can reflect shared underlying preference mechanisms. Existing LLM personalization methods often focus on surface-level interactions or undifferentiated histories, overlooking the shared mechanisms underlying these behaviors. We introduce PersonaFactors, a framework that distills reusable and interpretable personalization factors from heterogeneous user interactions. We construct a library of thirteen PersonaFactors by extracting evidence-grounded rationales and clustering recurring patterns across tasks, and develop a dynamic factor-guided generation framework that selects factors relevant to each user's history and current request. Across four personalization benchmarks and four backbone models, Dynamic PersonaFactor achieves the best score on every reported metric. Representation analyses further show that PersonaFactors and user history induce partially overlapping low-dimensional representations, and that their joint use yields complementary shifts. Taken together, these findings suggest that factor-based and history-based personalization can mutually reinforce each other.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种从异构用户交互中提炼可复用、可解释个性化因子的框架，并开发了动态因子引导的生成方法，在多个基准测试中取得了最佳性能。其方法结合了因子表示与用户历史，具有较好的解释性和互补性，但作为预印本，其方法细节和实验复现性有待同行评议进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一个从用户行为中提取可解释“个性化因子”的框架，用于动态增强大语言模型的个性化生成能力。

title: CultureBot: A Framework for Retrieval-Augmented Exploration of Cultural Heritage Data
abstract:
arXiv:2610.16435v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Digital cultural heritage collections encode rich relations among objects, places, periods, providers, images, and source institutions, yet users typically access them through keyword search and faceted browsing. We present CULTUREBOT, an interactive framework for natural-language exploration of cultural heritage collections that combines knowledge-graph-guided retrieval, lexical-semantic retrieval, and source-linked generation. CULTUREBOT maps user queries to structured catalogue relations, enriches retrieved records with textual evidence, and generates answers that link back to the underlying repository records. We instantiate the framework on 81,852 SearchCulture records and release an online demonstration. In an expert evaluation involving six cultural-heritage specialists, 55 persona-grounded queries, and 250 evaluations, the graph-guided system was rated significantly higher than two general-purpose assistants and a non-graph ablation, with the largest gains in evidence grounding, diversity, reasoning, and completeness. These results support graph-guided retrieval as a practical way to expose the relational structure of cultural collections through conversational access while preserving links to catalogue evidence.
thinking: 论文提出了一个结合知识图谱检索与生成式AI的交互式文化遗产探索框架，在检索增强生成（RAG）的基础上融入了结构化知识图谱引导，技术方案前沿且针对性强。其方法严谨，在真实数据集上进行了实例化，并通过专家评估与消融实验验证了有效性，但作为一项技术框架研究，其具体在图书馆或博物馆业务中的部署路径和成本效益分析尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一个利用知识图谱引导检索与生成的技术框架，能更有效地通过对话方式探索和揭示文化遗产数字藏品间的复杂关联。

title: Ontology-Based Post-Coordinated Expression Assembly: from Clinical Narrative to Queryable Knowledge Graphs
abstract:
arXiv:2610.16474v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Clinical oncology documentation records decisive information in free text, where it remains readable but not retrievable at scale, leaving cohort identification dependent on incomplete diagnostic codes or manual review. The current standard, coding individual terms, captures what a document mentions, not what it asserts: meaning lies in how those terms relate to one another. We present a method for deriving queryable knowledge graphs from clinical narratives, conforming to the Extended Grammar of SNOMED CT across multiple ontologies. The method specifies how entities should be annotated and related. It defines five relation classes, each bound to a construction rule that assembles the entities and relations into post-coordinated expressions. A deterministic implementation, UNIGRAPHE, applies those rules to construct knowledge graphs from annotated text. Applied to expert-annotated real-world oncology documentation, UNIGRAPHE reconstructed 5,299 annotations into 2,196 post-coordinated expressions and shows that relation structure is the missing piece to make clinical narrative formally queryable.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于本体的后组配表达构建方法，将临床叙事文本转化为可查询的知识图谱，核心是引入了五类关系及其构建规则，技术路径清晰且针对临床信息检索的痛点。该方法在真实肿瘤学文档上进行了验证，样本量充足，但作为方法学论文，其在实际医疗信息系统中的部署复杂度和泛化能力仍需进一步评估。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种方法，通过定义实体间的关系规则，能将临床文本自动构建为符合标准的知识图谱，从而实现精准检索。

title: ANCHOR: Assessing Naturalistic Constraint Hierarchies and Ordering in Repository-Grounded Agentic Coding
abstract:
arXiv:2610.16859v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: For repository-grounded coding agents, a functionally correct patch is not necessarily an acceptable one: developers also constrain how the task must be carried out-modification scope, workflow order, validation, tool use, and reporting. This capability, which we call engineering constraint following, remains largely invisible to current evaluations. We introduce ANCHOR (Assessing Naturalistic Constraint Hierarchies and Ordering in Repository-Grounded Agentic Coding), a benchmark built on naturalistic, multilingual repository tasks spanning eight language groups. ANCHOR combines (i) a hierarchical taxonomy of 10 categories and 78 leaf types distilled from real developer interactions, (ii) an automated pipeline that instantiates task-grounded atomic constraints and composes them into typed AND/THEN/PRIORITY relations, and (iii) a trajectory-grounded evaluation framework that checks both the code diff and the execution trajectory with rule-based and LLM judges. Across 19 agent configurations spanning 2 scaffolds and 10 foundation models on 358 tasks, the strongest measured system, Claude Opus 4.8 under Cline, reaches 70.1% atomic compliance and 63.7% relation compliance, while 19.0% of tasks pass every scored checklist item under the strict all-item FCCR criterion. A five-engineer audit of constraints from 50 instances reports 94% feasibility, 94% repository consistency, and 96% realism. In the primary paired set (14 configurations), the mean signed change in task completion after adding constraints is +0.7 percentage points; individual changes vary in both directions. These results distinguish functional success from constraint compliance, with failures concentrated in workflow ordering, tool-use discipline, and reporting, and substantial interactions between models and scaffolds.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个针对代码仓库智能体的工程约束遵循评估基准ANCHOR，其核心贡献在于构建了一个从真实开发者交互中提炼的、层次化的约束分类体系，并设计了结合代码差异和执行轨迹的自动化评估框架。研究在方法上较为严谨，通过多智能体配置测试和工程师审计验证了基准的可行性与真实性。然而，论文主要聚焦于评估框架的构建与验证，其前沿技术（如大语言模型）是作为被评估对象而非核心创新，且其提出的评估框架在图书馆等图情机构中的直接应用场景尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 论文构建了一个评估代码仓库智能体是否遵循复杂工程约束的基准，揭示了当前智能体在流程顺序和工具使用等方面的合规性短板。

title: UMCR: Universal Medical Concept Recognition through Guideline Integration and Agentic Linking
abstract:
arXiv:2610.17363v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Medical Concept Recognition is the task of extracting and grounding spans in medical text to entries in a standard ontology. Current methods are generally developed towards a single ontology and source text type (clinical notes, drug labels, etc.) The central challenge is therefore to build methods that adapt to any target ontology without requiring ontology-specific retraining. More recent approaches like REAL and AutoPCR make direct use of Large Language Models and can theoretically adapt to any ontology choice but suffer from a lack of generalization. We propose UMCR, a pipeline that allows extraction and linking to any target ontology using any source text variety, utilizing direct guideline integration and an agentic linking module. We evaluate our method on the recent MedPath benchmark, covering a wide variety of medical text types and vocabularies, and show that our method achieves strong performance across these tasks. This ability unlocks interoperability in the healthcare domain, allowing for extraction and alignment between different medical standards. Our method also reduces dependence on parametric LLM memory, thanks to improved interaction with the target ontology compared to other proposed approaches.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种利用指南集成和智能链接模块实现通用医学概念识别的方法，在技术层面结合了大语言模型与本体交互策略，具有较好的前沿性。然而，作为一篇预印本论文，其方法严谨性（如实验设计的细节和可复现性）尚未经过同行评议的充分检验，且其业务落地价值高度依赖于医疗信息系统的具体集成环境，存在一定不确定性。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种能适配不同医学本体和文本类型的通用概念识别方法，旨在提升医疗信息系统的互操作性。

title: Many Steps into One: Reasoning Contraction and the Limits of Safe Memory Reuse for LLM Agents
abstract:
arXiv:2610.17544v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Thought templates, skill libraries, agent memories and caches turn many reasoning steps into one. We call this reasoning contraction. A contracted memory saves reasoning steps and errors until its facts change, then quietly answers wrong. Most systems trust memories by counting successes and failures. We prove that such counters are badly tuned change detectors: a symmetric counter notices a partial change only after a power of its false-alarm horizon, and an unclipped one may never notice it. On five LLMs answering multi-hop questions over edited facts, ExpeL- and ACE-style counters serve 7.0-13.5x more stale answers than certified memories given the same information, and on code tasks with an exact verifier 35-73x more. Safety also has a price. When facts change and each memory is judged only by its own verified outcomes, one number, the certification load, sets how much reasoning any safe memory can skip, and under Zipf demand it yields a scaling law. Our recipe weighs each memory's failures by its own likelihood ratio, certifies its utility against live reasoning, and restarts the certificate when facts change, with the likelihood-ratio detector as the safety net for unannounced changes; for large edits it also invalidates the memory.
thinking: 论文针对LLM智能体中的记忆复用问题，提出了推理收缩的概念，并创新性地设计了基于似然比检测的认证机制来保障记忆安全，方法具有理论深度和严谨证明。研究聚焦于前沿的LLM智能体可靠性问题，但当前主要面向特定任务场景，其通用业务落地路径尚需进一步探索。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究揭示了大型语言模型智能体复用记忆时可能产生错误答案的风险，并提出了一种新的认证机制来更安全地管理记忆。

title: Agent-Reflex: Teaching Language Agents to Act Reflectively
abstract:
arXiv:2610.17953v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models have evolved from single-turn chatbots into interactive agents capable of long-horizon reasoning. In real deployments, MCP tool services can return noisy feedback and users may intervene to correct the agent, but existing methods provide limited supervision for reflection learning and failure recovery. To bridge this gap, we propose Agent-Reflex, a general training framework for incentivizing proactive reflection in agents. Specifically, Agent-Reflex comprises three stages. First, Environment Reflection Skill Discovery (RSD) injects grounded tool-feedback perturbations into environment scaling, samples a capability-diverse LLM pool, mines matched success-failure pairs, and summarizes reusable reflection meta-skills. Building on this skill library, we then apply Reflective Supervised Fine-Tuning (ReSFT) that converts each skill into supervision for self-reflection, skill recovery, and user-centric correction, strengthening complementary reflective behaviors. Finally, we propose On-Policy Reflective Policy Optimization (ORPO) to combine agentic reinforcement learning under noisy interactions with reflection-guided on-policy distillation to further elicit proactive reflection. Built on Qwen3-8B, Agent-Reflex reaches 58.6 overall on five long-horizon tool-use benchmarks and 29.1 on AgentNoiseBench, surpassing strong environment-scaling and reflection baselines. Experiments on six challenging agent benchmark suites demonstrate the effectiveness of Agent-Reflex. Further analyses show that Agent-Reflex improves agents' robustness to noise while maintaining stable training dynamics, supporting scalable agent training. Our code is available at https://github.com/RUC-NLPIR/Agent-Reflex.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于提升大语言模型智能体在复杂、噪声环境下的反思与恢复能力，提出了一个包含技能发现、监督微调和策略优化的系统训练框架。其优势在于方法体系完整，在多个基准测试上验证了有效性，并提升了智能体的鲁棒性；不足之处在于研究场景高度技术化，与图情领域的直接业务结合点尚不明确，其方法严谨性虽在实验设计上有所体现，但未涉及真实用户或图书馆业务场景的验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种名为Agent-Reflex的训练框架，旨在通过主动反思和技能恢复机制，提升AI智能体在工具使用任务中的鲁棒性和长期推理能力。

title: Are We Testing Too Much? A Survey of Benchmark Compression for Efficient Evaluation of Large Language Models
abstract:
arXiv:2610.18248v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Benchmarks are essential for evaluating and improving large language models (LLMs). Yet many widely used benchmarks are redundant, making evaluation unnecessarily expensive. Benchmark compression lowers this cost by estimating full-benchmark scores and rankings from a partial evaluation. Research in this area has grown rapidly since 2024, but to our knowledge no survey has systematically organized its methods and findings. We review 119 papers to explain how methods choose what to evaluate, recover full-benchmark results, and verify their reliability. From this analysis, we develop a taxonomy covering compression within individual benchmarks, across benchmark suites, and during adaptive evaluation, together with work on redundancy and reliability. We compare their information needs, total costs, reliability checks, and limitations. Methods reduce evaluation costs by selecting representative subsets, using cheaper or reusable information, and testing adaptively, but risk poor coverage, inaccurate estimates, and sequential delays. The resulting taxonomy and practical guide help researchers choose, validate, and deploy methods for more efficient and reliable LLM evaluation.
thinking: 该论文系统综述了大型语言模型评估中的基准压缩方法，属于对前沿技术（LLM评估效率）的元研究，技术前沿性高，但本身不提出新方法。论文通过分析119篇文献构建分类体系，方法严谨，但对图情领域的直接业务落地价值有限，主要服务于NLP研究社区。
one_sentence_summary: 这篇论文系统梳理了通过压缩基准测试来降低大语言模型评估成本的各种方法，并提供了选择和使用指南。

title: Prompt or Policy? Optimizing Physician Slate Presentations with LLM User Simulators
abstract:
arXiv:2610.18309v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Choosing the right physician is a key challenge for patients seeking medical care. Physician recommendation systems identify relevant doctors, but patients still find it difficult to compare their profiles to make a decision. We formulate slate presentation optimization: given a patient's medical case and a fixed, ranked list of physicians, we generate short, case-specific summaries that make doctors easier to compare, while remaining grounded in the information in their profiles. To optimize physician presentations without relying on real patient interactions, we develop an offline framework that uses persona-conditioned LLMs to simulate patient choices. We generate patient personas from attributes extracted from each medical case and evaluate presentations for factual accuracy, relevance, naturalness and simulated patient choice. We also use a second LLM judge, unseen during optimization, to assess simulator-specific overfitting. We compare automatic prompt-level optimization with GEPA, parameter-level optimization with GRPO, and their combination across two model sizes. GRPO substantially outperforms GEPA in satisfying the full set of constraints, and its gains in simulated conversion persist under the unseen judge. GEPA alone brings smaller improvements, but using its optimized prompt to initialize GRPO speeds up training and achieves the highest simulated conversion. These results show that prompt-level and parameter-level optimization play complementary roles in improving how physician recommendations are presented.
thinking: 该论文利用大语言模型构建用户模拟器进行离线优化，技术方法前沿且设计严谨，通过多维度评估和未见法官验证有效缓解了过拟合问题。然而，研究场景聚焦于医疗领域，其方法虽具启发性，但直接迁移至图书馆等图情业务场景仍需适配，实践应用价值相对受限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究利用大语言模型模拟用户选择，优化了医生推荐列表的呈现方式，证明参数级优化比提示级优化更有效。

title: Copying Is Not Grounding: Training Faithful Long-Form RAG with Authored-Sentence Credit
abstract:
arXiv:2610.18442v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In search engines and assistants, long-form RAG answers can mislead readers with claims their sources do not support. Faithfulness rewards, the share of supported sentences, train models toward fewer such claims. We show that these rewards are hacked by copying. A sentence copied from the passages is supported almost by construction, so trained models learn to copy rather than ground what they write. Common defenses only move the hack: a KL or copy penalty leaves copying in place or trades it for shorter, emptier answers and refusals. GRPO, the standard RL algorithm, makes it worse by giving every sentence its answer's advantage, reinforcing copied and grounded sentences alike. We propose Authored-Sentence Credit (ASC) , which fixes both by moving GRPO's reward and advantage from the answer to the sentence level. The reward credits only sentences that are authored rather than copied, say more than the question, and are supported by the passages. The advantage compares each sentence with every sentence sampled for the question, so one that earns no credit ranks last and is never reinforced. Across four models and two in-domain, three held-out corpora, only ASC lowers the error rate of authored sentences and writes more supported ones in every setting, by 38% and 46% at the median under held-out evaluators, giving readers more grounded information. It takes none of these shortcuts, and two LLM judges comparing whole answers prefer no baseline to the base model but rate ASC's answers on par with it. We conclude that a faithfulness reward should credit what a model writes, not what it copies.
thinking: 该论文针对长文本RAG系统存在的忠实性问题，提出了原创句子奖励机制，有效解决了模型通过简单复制来提升忠实性指标的问题。研究在多个模型和数据集上验证了方法的有效性，实验设计较为严谨，但技术方案主要针对现有RAG框架的优化，前沿性相对有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种新的奖励机制，能有效训练长文本RAG模型生成更多基于检索内容的原创性回答，减少对原文的简单复制。

title: SMI: Ontology-Grounded Semantic IDs for Hierarchy-Aware Medical Concept Representation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.18672v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Biomedical language models (LMs) provide strong representations for clinical tasks, but they often fail to capture the hierarchical structure among medical concepts. This limitation is especially pronounced for rare and fine-grained clinical codes in long-tailed vocabularies, where hierarchy-agnostic LM representations become less informative as concept frequency decreases. We introduce Semantic Medical Identifier (SMI), a training-free framework for constructing ontology-grounded Semantic IDs and hierarchy-aware medical concept representations. For each diagnosis, procedure, or medication concept, SMI defines its Semantic ID as the coarse-to-fine path through an expert-defined medical ontology. SMI then aggregates frozen biomedical LM embeddings across the corresponding ontology levels to form hierarchy-aware medical concept representations that preserve coarse-to-fine clinical semantics. The base SMI uses uniform aggregation across ontology levels, while a level-weighted variant selects global level weights on validation data. Our theoretical analysis shows that SMI yields more informative medical concept representations than hierarchy-agnostic LM embeddings, particularly for rare and fine-grained clinical concepts. Experiments show that SMI captures meaningful hierarchical structure and improves clinical relation prediction. On MIMIC-IV, SMI improves mortality prediction, readmission prediction, drug recommendation, and rare drug prediction. On eICU, SMI yields more robust patient representations under cross-hospital distribution shift.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于医学本体构建语义ID的框架，有效整合了生物医学语言模型的表示能力和领域知识的结构化层次，在罕见和细粒度临床概念表示上具有理论优势。其实验设计较为严谨，在MIMIC-IV和eICU数据集上验证了多个下游任务的性能提升，但作为预印本论文，其方法尚未经过同行评议的全面检验。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种结合医学本体层次结构与语言模型的方法，能更好地表示罕见医疗概念，并提升临床预测任务的性能。

title: Which Metadata Matters for LLM Tool Selection in MCP? Evidence from Controlled Factor-Level Interventions
abstract:
arXiv:2610.14334v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: In Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems, LLMs select tools from metadata rather than from their implementations. Names and descriptions summarize what a tool does, while the parameter schema specifies the fields a tool accepts and how they are organized. Our analysis of metadata for 367,174 MCP tools reveals substantial schema variation among functionally similar tools. Many of these tools share names and similar descriptions but expose different parameter schemas. This raises a key question: can parameter-schema differences influence tool selection before any call is made? We study this question through controlled metadata interventions across five LLMs and five tasks. Each comparison changes exactly one metadata factor (server name, tool name, description, or parameter schema) while keeping the others fixed. We balance tool positions and use conditional logistic regression to estimate position-adjusted effects. We find that: (1) parameter-schema changes produce the largest and most consistent selection shifts among the tested interventions. Models tend to favor separate top-level parameters over grouped or composite forms. (2) Descriptions that explain parameters also tend to increase selection, while name effects are weaker and less consistent. (3) Targeted comparisons show that schema effects depend on the specific parameter names and on how the request represents the same information. When only one schema satisfies an explicit request requirement, all five models select the compatible tool despite position preferences. These results show that parameter schemas influence not only how tools are called, but also whether they are selected. For MCP developers and evaluators, schema design and tool ordering can therefore affect which implementation is invoked even when functionality is unchanged.
thinking: 论文采用控制实验和条件逻辑回归方法，系统研究了元数据（特别是参数模式）对LLM工具选择的影响，方法严谨且样本量大。研究聚焦于MCP这一新兴技术框架，具有明确的技术前沿性，但其发现主要面向MCP系统开发者，对图书馆等传统信息机构的直接落地价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在MCP系统中，工具参数模式的设计差异会显著影响大语言模型对工具的选择，其影响甚至超过工具名称和描述。

title: Hashrope: A Persistent Data Structure for Mechanisms of LLM Context Management
abstract:
arXiv:2610.16144v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Serving stacks for large language models manage context through four recurring mechanisms: incremental edits to a growing context, branching and snapshotting for tree search, identification of reusable prefixes for KV-cache reuse, and encoding of repeated segments. Each mechanism is served today by a different specialist structure. We show that all four reduce to a single persistent weight-balanced rope whose every node carries a polynomial hash of its subtree over a Mersenne prime, so that the structure supports logarithmic edits and logarithmic verified content-identity queries at the same time. We validate each mechanism with pre-registered, replicated experiments, then compare against a deployed specialist per mechanism: the Ropey editing library, a faithful PagedAttention copy-on-write block table, and the vendored SGLang radix matcher. On workloads that interleave edits with identity queries, Hashrope is net-superior to Ropey by a factor that grows without bound (369.7x at one million characters). Against the radix matcher on a live vLLM stack serving Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M on four A100 GPUs, Hashrope identifies a one-million-token shared prefix exactly and 1.20x faster, at a context length the dense engine cannot even prefill.
thinking: 论文提出了一种统一的大语言模型上下文管理数据结构Hashrope，通过持久化权重平衡绳和多项式哈希技术，将四种常见机制整合为单一结构，在实验验证中表现出显著性能优势。其技术方案具有创新性和前沿性，但作为计算机科学领域的底层数据结构研究，其直接在图情业务场景中的落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种名为Hashrope的新型数据结构，能更高效地统一处理大语言模型服务中的多种上下文管理机制。

title: Understanding Personalization Gains in Whisper
abstract:
arXiv:2610.17019v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Whisper-style ASR models provide strong zero-shot transcription, but their residual errors are not evenly distributed across datasets, recording conditions, and metadata-based groups. We study when lightweight low-rank adaptation (LoRA) improves Whisper and whether observed gains require group-specific adapters. Across Common Voice, LibriSpeech, and VoxPopuli, we compare zero-shot Whisper, pooled LoRA, and group-specific LoRA under matched within-group splits. We find that adaptation is not uniformly beneficial: gains are concentrated in difficult Common Voice groups, are consistent on VoxPopuli, and largely disappear on low-error LibriSpeech. Crucially, pooled LoRA often matches, and sometimes clearly outperforms, group-specific LoRA. Gains over zero-shot should therefore be tested against matched pooled adaptation before being interpreted as evidence of personalization.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于语音识别模型Whisper的轻量化适配技术（LoRA），探讨其在特定数据集上的个性化增益效果，属于AI在信息处理领域的应用研究。论文采用多数据集对比实验，方法较为严谨，但研究场景相对具体，业务落地价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，对Whisper语音识别模型进行轻量化适配并非总是有效，其增益主要集中在困难数据集上，且通用适配器常能达到与专用适配器相当的效果。

title: Tanawpamana: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Philippine Cultural Heritage Sites
abstract:
arXiv:2610.17596v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used to identify and describe places, yet their recognition and knowledge of specific cultures remain poorly understood, particularly in underrepresented regions such as the Philippines. This study introduces the Tanawpamana Dataset, a repository of Philippine heritage site images with metadata based on the Talapamana registry of the National Commission for Culture and the Arts of the Philippines. We also introduce the Tanawpamana Benchmark, comprising 4,046 tasks designed to evaluate models' recognition and knowledge of heritage sites. Evaluating seven vision-language models, we find that they struggle more with fine-grained visual discrimination among similar heritage sites than with coarse recognition, and that their geographic knowledge is weaker when inferred from image inputs than from text.
thinking: 该论文构建了菲律宾文化遗产地标数据集与评测基准，针对视觉语言模型在特定文化场景下的识别与知识能力进行评估，具有明确的技术前沿性和方法创新性。研究通过系统性的任务设计和多模型对比，揭示了模型在细粒度视觉识别和地理知识推断方面的不足，方法严谨且样本量充足。然而，其研究成果目前主要服务于模型评测社区，对图书馆、信息机构等业务场景的直接落地应用价值尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究创建了一个菲律宾文化遗产数据集和评测基准，发现当前视觉语言模型对相似遗产地的细节识别能力较差，且从图像推断地理知识的能力弱于从文本推断。

title: SWE-MISBEHAVIOR: Benchmarking and Mitigating Boundary Violations in Software Coding Agents
abstract:
arXiv:2610.18206v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: We present SWE-MISBEHAVIOR, the first taxonomy and evaluation framework for diagnosing boundary-violating misbehaviors in coding agents. It contains 7.4K human-in-the-loop synthesized samples spanning three layers of agent action space: (i) Code Generation, (ii) File Management, and (iii) System Interaction. Across these categories, SWE-MISBEHAVIOR covers 11 distinct misbehaviors with a fully automated evaluation protocol, including coding-action violations, Create/Read/Update/Delete (CRUD) file misbehaviors, system integrity and abuse violations, and task-goal misalignment. Experiments on state-of-the-art open-source coding agents (e.g., OpenHands, smolagents) reveal substantial misaligned behaviors, including dependency misinterpretation (up to 98.5% of cases), unintended modification of user inputs (50.5%), and silent compromise of environment integrity (53%). Motivated by these findings, we further propose CODE-KIT, a lightweight adaptive framework that combines misbehavior-aware guidelines with novel tools to help agents avoid such failures. CODE-KIT reduces misbehaviors by 52% for smolagents and 34% for OpenHands, while simultaneously improving task completion performance.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于软件编码代理的边界违规行为，提出了首个分类与评估框架，并设计了缓解方案，在AI应用领域具有明确的技术前沿性。其基于大规模合成样本的实验设计和方法验证体现了较高的方法严谨性，但其提出的缓解框架在图书馆等传统图情业务中的直接落地价值尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究首次系统性地定义并量化了AI编码代理的越界行为，并提出了一个能有效减少此类问题的轻量级缓解框架。

title: How Safe Is ChatGPT Health Advice? Evidence from Real User Conversations in Four Global South Countries
abstract:
arXiv:2610.18465v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: People increasingly bring their health questions to ChatGPT, yet safety evaluations of LLM health advice rest almost entirely on clinician-authored vignettes, synthetic prompts, or simulated user profiles. The gap is widest for the Global South, where concerns about demographic bias and unsafe recommendations are well documented but have never been tested on real usage. We present, to our knowledge, the first demographically grounded safety evaluation of real-world health conversations with ChatGPT. From a consent-based data-donation corpus of 202,590 conversations from 1,252 users in India, Nigeria, Brazil, and Pakistan (December 2022 to February 2026), each linked to self-reported age and gender, we identify 15,555 health conversations, classify their health intent using an LLM classifier adapted from an established taxonomy, and score response safety under both a context-blind and a user-context-aware rubric. Roughly one in five health conversations receives a high-risk rating. Risk concentrates in symptom and condition queries and recurs through identifiable failure modes: unsafe medication or dosage guidance, harmful self-diagnosis, missing safety warnings, encouraging over-reliance on the model, and failure to refer users to professionals. Supplying the user's own accumulated context raises the high-risk share by 13-17 percentage points, and about one in four conversations rated safe in isolation turns out to be unsafe for the specific person asking. Safety evaluations built on synthetic cases are likely to miss these harms.
thinking: 论文基于真实用户对话数据评估ChatGPT在健康建议中的安全性，研究设计严谨，样本量大且覆盖四个发展中国家，方法上结合了LLM分类和双重视角的安全评分。但技术层面主要应用现有LLM进行分类和评估，未提出新的前沿技术方法。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，基于真实用户对话的评估显示，ChatGPT的健康建议中约五分之一存在高风险，且合成测试会低估对特定用户的危害。

title: Bayesian Test-Time Inference of Task-Aligned Similarity from Weak Interactive Feedback
abstract:
arXiv:2610.18656v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Language model systems repeatedly make test-time decisions by comparing similarity: they retrieve exemplars, rank candidates, and revise responses. Yet similarity is not unique: lexical, semantic, structural, and stylistic resemblance can point to different candidates, and the task-aligned notion can change across instances. We introduce BASIS (Bayesian Axis Selection via Interactive Signals), a training-free Bayesian method that uses weak test-time feedback to infer which criterion in a supplied, task-specific library governs the current decision. It maintains a joint posterior over candidate targets and criteria, updates it from scalar scores, pairwise preferences, or verifier outputs, and selects probes by expected information gain. In a finite noisy model, we characterize when the target-criterion pair is recoverable and show why fixed-criterion and fixed-mixture rules can fail under criterion shift. Across concept recovery, reasoning exemplar selection, and response refinement, BASIS improves six-probe concept-recovery Success@1 from 56.0% to 68.1%, reasoning accuracy from 72.3% to 73.1%, and refinement win rate from 61.4% to 63.8% over tuned static mixtures. It also exceeds compute-matched best-of-N selection on reasoning (72.1%) and refinement (61.2%). Gains are largest under criterion mismatch and with larger candidate pools, and matched controls indicate that adaptive criterion weighting explains much of the benefit, with joint target-criterion inference adding further value. BASIS selects only among supplied criteria and does not discover new ones.
thinking: 论文提出了一种无需训练、利用弱反馈进行贝叶斯推断的任务对齐相似性选择方法，在概念恢复、推理和响应精炼任务上取得了稳定提升，方法具有理论分析和实验验证，严谨性较好。但该方法主要面向语言模型系统的测试时决策优化，在图情领域的直接业务落地场景尚不明确，前沿性更多体现在方法学层面而非图情特定技术。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种基于贝叶斯推断的方法，能在测试时利用弱反馈动态选择最符合当前任务需求的相似性判断标准，从而提升语言模型在检索、排序等决策任务中的性能。

title: Open Foundation Models in Healthcare: Challenges, Paradoxes, and Opportunities with GenAI Driven Personalized Prescription
abstract:
arXiv:2502.04356v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: In response to the success of proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs), there is a growing interest in developing open, non-proprietary LLMs and AI foundation models (AIFMs) for transparent use in academic, scientific, and non-commercial applications. Open models have substantial potential to improve healthcare applications. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive survey and a taxonomy of state-of-the-art open LLMs and AIFMs for clinical tasks. In addition, we empirically evaluate open-weight LLMs on a personalized-prescription task and compare them with a proprietary model with and without Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Across 100 synthetic patient profiles, the open-weight models matched or exceeded the proprietary baseline on overall suitability accuracy without retrieval augmentation (0.810--0.850 versus 0.780), although the confidence intervals overlap; with retrieval augmentation, every model improved, and the ranking closed to within 0.04. Gains from RAG were field-dependent rather than uniform. To highlight the clinical relevance of LLM-driven personalized prescriptions, we also conduct a subjective evaluation in which two raters, blinded to model and condition, scored responses independently of each other. Their ratings did not follow the accuracy gains: retrieval raised overall suitability accuracy for every model while lowering the two-rater means for two of the four on all five dimensions. Finally, we outline the ethical implications and potential risks associated with the misuse of advanced LLMs and AIFMs, highlighting the importance of responsible and transparent deployment in healthcare contexts. \textit{Data and code used in the paper will be released upon publication.
thinking: 该论文对医疗健康领域的开源大语言模型进行了系统性综述和实证评估，技术前沿性突出，方法上结合了量化指标和主观盲评，较为严谨。但其业务落地价值受限于医疗场景的高风险性和严格监管，短期内直接应用难度较大。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究发现，在个性化处方任务中，开源大模型的表现可与专有模型媲美，但检索增强生成的效果因领域而异，且模型性能的客观提升与专家主观评价不完全一致。

title: RCR-Router: Efficient Role-Aware Context Routing for Multi-Agent LLM Systems with Structured Memory
abstract:
arXiv:2508.04903v4 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly organized into multi-agent systems for complex reasoning and decision-making tasks. However, scaling such systems can substantially increase inference cost, especially when multiple agents repeatedly process overlapping or role-irrelevant context. Many existing multi-agent frameworks focus on orchestration and role specialization, but still rely on full-context sharing or static context routing, leading to redundant token consumption, increased runtime, and inefficient memory utilization. We present \emph{Role-Conditioned Context Routing (RCR)}, an execution-time layer that allocates role-relevant shared-memory items to agents under token budgets. Given a structured shared memory and a set of role-specialized agents, RCR selectively routes task-relevant memory items to each agent according to its role, optional task-stage metadata, and token budget. RCR integrates role-conditioned relevance scoring, token-budgeted memory selection, and iterative memory updates to reduce redundant context exposure during multi-agent execution. Experiments on multi-hop QA, embodied reasoning (ALFWorld), and web-based decision-making (WebShop) show that RCR reduces token usage by 35\% on average and runtime by 38\% on average relative to Full-Context, while maintaining or improving task performance.
thinking: 该论文提出了面向多智能体大语言模型系统的角色感知上下文路由方法，通过结构化记忆和动态路由机制有效减少了冗余令牌消耗，技术方案新颖且实验验证充分。然而，其应用场景主要面向通用AI系统优化，与图书馆、信息机构等具体业务场景的直接关联性较弱，落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种能根据智能体角色动态分配上下文的方法，可显著降低多智能体大语言模型系统的计算开销。

title: What Are We Measuring in NLG? A Meta-Analysis of Evaluation Trends 2020-2025
abstract:
arXiv:2601.07648v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: As Natural Language Generation (NLG) dominates modern NLP, scalable evaluation remains a critical bottleneck. Consequently, LLM-as-a-judge (LaaJ) adoption has accelerated rapidly, appearing in more papers than human evaluation in 2025. This pivotal shift motivates a critical analysis of current evaluation practices. Overcoming the limits of rigid keyword filtering and manual review, we employ a multi-LLM information extraction pipeline to gather structured metadata from 14,171 papers across four major NLP conferences (2020-2025). Analyzing 3,334 filtered NLG papers, we identify three systemic challenges. (1) Metric inertia: despite the shift toward open-ended generation, legacy lexical metrics (BLEU, ROUGE) persist as primary indicators, typically used alongside rather than replaced by semantic alternatives. (2) Metric-criteria mapping problem: our paper-level co-occurrence data reveals that general-purpose automatic metrics are applied as broad proxies for quality, without specifying which dimension of text generation they are intended to evaluate. (3) Validation gap: LaaJ has grown rapidly without commensurate human validation (fewer than 8% of papers). Crucially, while LaaJ correlates with aggregate quality, alignment collapses on fine-grained criteria like fluency. To address these gaps, we distill our findings into a minimal Evaluation Checklist to guide metric selection, construct validity, and LaaJ deployment.
thinking: 该论文采用多LLM信息抽取流水线对大量NLP会议论文进行元分析，技术方法前沿且样本规模大，方法严谨性突出。研究揭示了NLG评估中存在的系统性挑战，并提出了实用的评估清单，对自然语言处理领域的评估实践具有直接指导价值。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过大规模元分析揭示了自然语言生成评估中存在的指标惯性、映射不清和验证不足三大系统性挑战，并提出了改进清单。

title: Negative Advantages Is a Double-Edged Sword: Calibrating advantages in GRPO for Search Agents
abstract:
arXiv:2604.18235v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Search agents achieve strong question-answering performance through multi-turn interactions with search engines, with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) being a widely used training algorithm. However, GRPO-style algorithms still face several challenges in multi-hop search settings. First, correct intermediate steps are often penalized when the final answer is wrong. Second, training is highly unstable, often causing degradation of natural language ability or even catastrophic training collapse. Our analysis attributes these issues to coarse-grained advantage assignment and an imbalance between positive and negative advantages. To address these problems, we propose CalibAdv, an advantage calibration method specifically designed for search agents that enables more accurate and more stable modeling of penalties and rewards. Specifically, CalibAdv leverages the correctness of intermediate steps to downscale excessive negative advantages at a fine-grained level. It then further rebalances positive and negative advantages to improve training stability. Importantly, CalibAdv adopts a lightweight design that calibrates advantages from standard rollout signals, making it simple and easy to deploy. Extensive experiments across three models and seven benchmarks demonstrate that CalibAdv improves both model performance and training stability. Our code is available at https://github.com/wujwyi/CalibAdv.
thinking: 该论文针对GRPO算法在搜索智能体训练中的优势分配问题，提出了CalibAdv校准方法，在技术方法上具有创新性，并通过多模型、多基准实验验证了有效性。但作为一篇技术导向的arXiv预印本，其研究场景和评估体系相对通用，与图书馆、信息机构等具体业务场景的直接结合度有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种校准优势信号的方法，以提升搜索问答智能体在多轮交互训练中的性能和稳定性。

title: Source or It Didn't Happen: A Multi-Agent Framework for Citation Hallucination Detection
abstract:
arXiv:2605.08583v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in scientific writing, yet they can fabricate citation-shaped references that appear plausible but fail bibliographic verification. Existing detectors often reduce verification to binary found/not-found decisions and rely on brittle parsing or incomplete retrieval, offering little field-level signal to auditors. We reframe citation hallucination detection as taxonomy-aligned field-level adjudication and introduce a 12-code taxonomy spanning Real, Potential, and Hallucinated citations. Based on this taxonomy, we build CiteTracer, a cascading multi-agent detector that extracts structured citations from PDF and BibTeX, retrieves evidence through cache lookup, URL fetch, scholar connectors, and web search, applies deterministic field matching, and routes ambiguous cases to class-specialist judgers. We release a benchmark of 2,450 synthetic citations built from real seeds with controlled LLM mutations, paired with 957 real-world fabricated citations drawn from desk-rejected submissions at ICLR 2026 and an anonymous conference. CiteTracer reaches 97.1% accuracy on the synthetic benchmark, with class-level F1 scores of 97.0, 95.8, and 98.5 for Real, Potential, and Hallucinated, respectively, and detects 97.1% of fabrications on the real-world set without abstaining. Code: https://github.com/aaFrostnova/CiteTracer.
thinking: 该论文针对大语言模型在学术写作中生成虚假引用的现实问题，提出了一个系统性的检测框架和细粒度分类法，方法设计严谨且验证充分，具有明确的实践价值。其不足在于，虽然采用了多智能体架构，但核心技术仍以确定性规则匹配和传统检索为主，在技术前沿性上略有欠缺。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个多智能体框架，能有效检测学术文献中大语言模型生成的虚假引用，为学术出版和审稿提供了实用工具。

title: Agentic Clustering: Controllable Text Taxonomies via Multi-Agent Refinement
abstract:
arXiv:2606.01255v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Recent text-clustering methods use large language models to propose a cluster taxonomy from a corpus and then assign each text to it. These pipelines are fundamentally programmatic: the sequence of LLM calls and the rules for stopping, merging, and splitting clusters are fixed in code in advance, so they generalise poorly across corpora of different structure and cannot easily incorporate user-supplied constraints such as a target cluster count or a clustering intent. We propose an agentic alternative in which an orchestrator LLM inspects the state of the discovery process at each step and dispatches one of a small set of specialised agents -- proposer, synthesizer, auditor, investigator, and critic -- adapting the pipeline to the corpus rather than executing a fixed one. On seven public text-clustering benchmarks the method achieves state-of-the-art performance, beating the strongest prior baseline by 47% in mean ARI.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于多智能体协作的文本聚类方法，通过引入一个协调器来动态调度不同功能的智能体，从而替代了传统固定流程的聚类管道，在多个基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升。其创新点在于将大语言模型的应用从程序化调用转向了更具适应性的智能体架构，技术前沿性突出，但作为预印本论文，其方法细节和在实际业务场景中的部署可行性尚需进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种由大语言模型智能体动态协作的文本聚类新方法，显著提升了聚类效果并增强了流程的适应性。

title: SkillHarm: Lifecycle-Aware Skill-Based Attacks via Automated Construction
abstract:
arXiv:2606.02540v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Agent skills occupy a privileged position in the agent workflow, as agents are expected to implicitly follow and execute them, rendering third-party skills a vulnerable attack surface. Existing studies have revealed unsafe agent behaviors induced by skill-based attacks, but they primarily evaluate poisoned skills within a single task execution and enumerate harms through ad hoc risk lists. To bridge these gaps, we introduce SkillHarm, a benchmark of skill-based attacks across the skill-use lifecycle, paired with a systematic taxonomy of skill-relevant risks. SkillHarm evaluates two attack scenarios: Fixed-Payload Poisoning (FPP), where a fixed poisoned skill package directly compromises any task session that invokes it, and Self-Mutating Poisoning (SMP), where an initially benign execution silently mutates persistent skill content, deferring harm until a subsequent reuse. It further defines 12 risk types based on the agent workflow component targeted by the harm: data pipelines, system environments, and agent autonomy. To instantiate these attacks at scale, we build AutoSkillHarm, an automated construction pipeline with coding agents driven by natural-language harnesses. The resulting benchmark contains 879 attack samples across 71 skills. Experiments show that current agents remain vulnerable with attack success rates up to 86.3% in FPP and 69.3% in SMP. Our analysis further reveals a latent risk: many apparent attack failures stem from the agent failing to engage with the poisoned file rather than genuine resistance, and current defenses still fail to reliably mitigate the threat.
thinking: 论文聚焦于智能体技能生命周期中的安全风险，提出了系统化的攻击分类和自动化构建方法，技术前沿性较强，但研究场景偏向攻击验证，与图书馆业务直接关联度有限。方法学上通过大规模实验验证了攻击有效性，但样本来源和攻击场景的普适性仍需进一步考量。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究系统揭示了智能体技能在生命周期中面临的安全风险，并构建了一个自动化攻击基准来评估现有智能体的脆弱性。

title: Mapping Political-Elite Networks in Europe with a Multilingual Joint Entity-Relation Extraction Pipeline
abstract:
arXiv:2606.27347v4 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Whether political elites organise into rent-seeking coalitions that capture public resources or civic networks that sustain governance is a central question in comparative politics. Yet observing these complex, informal, and adversarial ties at scale has historically required intensive manual coding, while automated text-as-data methods have largely been limited to simple co-occurrence. Recent large language model (LLM) approaches offer a path forward but often rely on proprietary APIs, lack cross-lingual capability, and struggle with scalable entity resolution. We present a modular, fully open-weight pipeline for multilingual joint entity-relation extraction that builds signed, temporal knowledge graphs from massive unstructured news corpora. It combines span-based named-entity recognition (NER) with a three-stage linking cascade mapping mentions to language-independent Wikidata identifiers; a high-throughput, ontology-constrained mixture-of-experts model then uses guided decoding to extract directed, signed relationships grounded in a domain ontology. A full-coverage spot-check against a 3491-relation gold standard shows high textual correctness (68.2% strict to 93.7% lenient). Two large-scale case studies validate the pipeline against the public record. In Austria, it reconstructs a political party's complete lifecycle, dating internal fractures and tracking personnel into successor factions and court convictions. In a Polish corpus, it uncovers the overlapping economic and governance networks of state-enterprise patronage, alongside the structurally balanced, signed conflict network of the polarized Civic Platform (Platforma Obywatelska, PO)--Law and Justice (Prawo i Sprawiedliwo\'s\'c, PiS) duopoly. By bridging raw multilingual text and structured relational data, our framework provides a robust, replicable foundation for cross-national empirical computational social science.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于开放权重大语言模型的多语言联合实体关系抽取流水线，并应用于欧洲政治精英网络构建，技术方法具有前沿性且流程设计严谨。研究通过大规模新闻语料构建带符号的时序知识图谱，并进行了严格的验证和案例研究，方法学严谨性较高。虽然技术框架先进，但其直接在图情业务场景（如图书馆、信息机构）的落地应用路径尚不明确，实践价值相对有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一个开放的多语言实体关系抽取框架，用于从新闻文本中自动构建政治精英的动态关系网络。

title: Factorized Hypothesis Search for Evidence-to-Taxonomy Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2608.06614v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Large-taxonomy retrieval often assumes that the input already expresses the target concept. In many settings, however, the input is indirect evidence, such as a table cell whose meaning depends on its row, column, datatype, and context. We call this mismatch the retrieval readiness gap. Our analysis shows that the current index retrieves the target reliably when its semantics are explicit, while raw evidence often leaves it deep in the ranking. We propose Factorized Hypothesis Search (FHS), which maintains multiple partial interpretations over named semantic dimensions. These hypotheses support structured query rendering, multi-hypothesis retrieval, and dimension-level candidate verification. On both financial taxonomy tagging and CodiEsp clinical coding tasks, FHS achieves the best Recall@1, MRR, and final accuracy among the non-oracle methods. Replacing the factorized hypothesis path with a free-text ensemble causes the largest drop in head-ranking performance, while sequential refinement provides no additional gain over FHS's strong parallel first round.
thinking: 该论文针对大分类检索中证据与目标概念不匹配的问题，提出了因子化假设搜索方法，在金融和临床编码任务上取得了优于基线方法的效果，体现了较强的技术创新性和方法严谨性。然而，其技术方案相对复杂，在图书馆等实际业务场景中的直接落地路径尚不明确，应用价值有待进一步探索。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种新的检索方法，通过维护多个维度的语义假设，有效提升了从间接证据到大分类目标概念的检索准确率。

title: From Parameters to Behaviors: A Survey of Model Fusion for Large Language Models
abstract:
arXiv:2609.19553v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Model fusion integrates the capabilities from source models into a single target model. As of June 2026, Hugging Face hosts more than 2M models. This growing pool provides a rich base for model reuse and capability integration. Yet existing surveys often cover only separate parts of this space, and they do not provide a unified definition or a systematic taxonomy. This survey defines model fusion and organizes prior work into three levels: parameter-level, representation-level, and behavior-level fusion. We also review related metrics, benchmarks, and applications, summarize current challenges, and identify future directions. Our goal is to provide a clear map of this area and support future work on model fusion. A comprehensive list of papers about model fusion is available at https://github.com/Baicaihaochi/Awesome-Model-Fusion-Survey.
thinking: 该论文是一篇关于大语言模型融合的系统性综述，对前沿技术进行了全面梳理和分类，具有较高的学术参考价值。然而，作为一篇综述性文章，其本身不涉及具体的技术创新或实证研究，因此在业务落地和方法严谨性上得分相对有限。
one_sentence_summary: 这篇综述论文系统梳理了大语言模型融合的技术路径，将其分为参数、表征和行为三个层次，为相关研究提供了清晰的路线图。

title: Cite Pretrain: Retrieval-Free Knowledge Attribution for Large Language Models
abstract:
arXiv:2506.17585v4 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Large language models can answer questions correctly and still hallucinate their citations. Most citation systems address this by retrieving documents at inference time. Retrieval adds latency and depends on external infrastructure. Retrieval noise can also affect the answer. We study whether LLMs can cite documents from their (continual) pretraining without test-time retrieval. We introduce CitePretrainBench to evaluate this setting. It includes Wikipedia, Common Crawl, and arXiv as real-world corpora and also includes novel, unseen documents. The benchmark includes short-form citation tasks for a single fact and long-form tasks for multiple facts. Continual-pretraining first binds factual knowledge to a persistent identifier for each document. Instruction tuning then teaches the model to put these identifiers in its answers as citations. Passive Indexing appends an identifier at the end of each document. Synthetic data used in Active Indexing restate facts in diverse, compositional forms. We train two mappings together. These mappings are source$\to$fact and fact$\to$source. The first direction involves the model generating content given a cited source. In the second, it learns to attribute its own answers when facts are paraphrased or combined. On Qwen-2.5-7B and 3B, Active Indexing improves citation precision over Passive Indexing on every evaluated citation task, with gains of up to 30.2 percentage points. In the scaling ablation, citation performance continues to improve as we add augmented data, including at 16 times the original token count. Combining internal and external citations also improves robustness to retrieval noise.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种无需检索的知识归因方法，通过持续预训练和指令微调使大语言模型能够直接引用其内部知识，在技术方法上具有前沿性。其构建的基准测试和对比实验设计较为严谨，但该方法目前主要针对特定模型和数据集，在图书馆等实际业务场景中的直接落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种新方法，让大语言模型无需外部检索即可准确引用其预训练数据中的文档，从而减少幻觉并提升引用精度。

title: AdvJudge-Zero: Binary Decision Flips in LLM-as-a-Judge via Adversarial Control Tokens
abstract:
arXiv:2512.17375v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge systems supply the reward signal in modern RLHF and RLVR pipelines, but their binary verdict reduces to a single linear readout F_gap on one hidden state. We show this readout is shallow enough that short, low-perplexity tokens flip the verdict from "No" to "Yes". These tokens are sampled from the judge's own next-token distribution at the response position, with no manual seed set and no gradient-based optimization. Our procedure, AdvJudge-Zero, reaches $>$90% ensemble false-positive rate on 22 of 24 (model, dataset) cells across six Qwen, Llama, and Gemma judges, versus 54-72% for the prior curated 10-token benchmark, and the discovered surface transfers cross-format to a 70B scalar reward model. The same discovered pool enables a defense: a LoRA fine-tune stratified by a 9-class mechanism taxonomy hardens cross-family generalization where naive sampling on the same pool fails, with mechanism breadth rather than pool size carrying the gain. Under GRPO training, the hardened judge eliminates the reward-collapse failures (false-positive spikes and length collapse) we observe in the unhardened baseline on both MATH and GSM8K at ten seeds per condition. The discovered pool, the mechanism taxonomy, and per-prompt flip records will be released under responsible disclosure.
thinking: 论文揭示了LLM-as-a-Judge系统中奖励信号生成的脆弱性，通过无梯度优化的对抗性控制令牌即可高成功率地翻转其二元判决，这一发现具有重要的安全警示意义。研究通过大量实验（覆盖6个模型、24个组合）验证了攻击的有效性，并提出了基于机制分类的防御方法，方法严谨且结果可靠。然而，其研究场景高度聚焦于大模型对齐与安全的技术攻防，与当前图书馆、信息机构的主流业务实践结合度较弱，直接落地应用价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究发现大语言模型作为评判者时，其奖励信号极易被特定的对抗性文本令牌操控，从而产生错误判决，并提出了相应的防御方案。

title: RewardHarness: Self-Evolving Agentic Post-Training
abstract:
arXiv:2605.08703v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Aligning generative models with human preferences remains a central challenge. While RLHF is widely adopted, it relies on large-scale preference data. This limitation is particularly evident in evaluating instruction-guided image edits, even though humans can often learn such preferences from only a few examples. We present RewardHarness, a training-free, self-evolving agentic reward framework that reframes reward modeling as context evolution rather than weight optimization. Instead of learning from large-scale annotations, RewardHarness aligns with human preferences by iteratively evolving a library of tools and skills from as few as 100 preference demonstrations. Given a source image, an edited image, and an editing instruction, an orchestrator agent selects the most relevant subset of tools and skills from the maintained library, and sub-agents invoke them to construct a reasoning chain that produces a reward score. By comparing predicted scores with ground-truth preferences and analyzing successes and failures in the reasoning process, the orchestrator automatically refines its library of tools and skills without additional human annotation. Using only 0.05% of the EditReward preference data, RewardHarness achieves 47.4% average accuracy on EditReward-Bench K=2/3/4 and GenAI-Bench, surpassing GPT-5 by 5.3 points. When used as a reward signal in FlowGRPO, RL-tuned models achieve 3.52 on ImgEdit-Bench. Code and model are available at the project page: https://rewardharness.com/
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于工具和技能库自演化的奖励建模框架，无需大规模标注数据，在图像编辑评估任务上取得了显著效果，技术思路新颖且具有前沿性。然而，作为一篇计算机领域（NLP）的预印本论文，其研究场景和方法论与图情领域的直接业务实践关联较弱，应用价值尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种无需大量标注数据、通过自演化智能体来评估图像编辑质量的奖励建模新方法。

title: Incumbent Advantage: Brand Bias and Cognitive Manipulation Dynamics in LLM Recommendation Systems
abstract:
arXiv:2606.17443v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming a major way for consumers to find products, but we do not yet understand how brands compete in this new channel. We study brand dynamics in LLM recommendations using skincare products -- a category where consumers cannot easily judge quality before buying and must rely on brand reputation -- across three commercial LLMs (GPT-4o-mini, Claude Sonnet, Gemini 3 Flash), with a robustness check on search goods. In three experiments, we find: (1) a Conditional Monopoly where well-known brands get recommended 100% of the time (IAI = 10.0) when all products have the same specifications, but this dominance disappears with less than a +0.1-star rating advantage for a competitor; (2) authority-style marketing language, including fabricated clinical-evidence claims, breaks this monopoly at a Bias Surplus Value equal to +0.17 rating points, with each model responding differently; and (3) a social dilemma in multi-brand GEO competition: when all brands adopt the same optimization strategy, individual payoff falls from +0.802 to +0.007 in our payoff proxy, and non-participating brands receive zero recommendations in our tests. Our results suggest that generative engine optimization (GEO) should be studied not only as a security risk, but also as an emerging marketing practice that shapes market competition.
thinking: 论文通过实验方法系统研究了LLM推荐系统中的品牌偏见与认知操纵动态，在方法上较为严谨，设计了多模型对比和稳健性检验。然而，研究场景聚焦于商业营销竞争，与图书馆、信息机构的核心业务（如资源发现、知识服务）的直接关联性较弱，实践应用价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在LLM产品推荐中存在知名品牌垄断效应，但这种优势容易被营销话术或微小的评分优势打破，并揭示了生成式引擎优化的市场博弈困境。

title: EARS: Explanatory Abstention for Reliable Sub-Agent Modeling in Large-scale Multi-Agent Systems
abstract:
arXiv:2606.18668v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: In large-scale enterprise settings, centralized multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly adopted, in which a coordinator delegates user requests to lightweight, domain-specialized sub-agents. While this architecture improves modularity, scalability, and cost efficiency, its reliability depends not only on accurate routing but also on sub-agents' ability to calibrate their responses to capability constraints. In particular, sub-agents built on smaller fine-tuned models often struggle with such calibration, leading them to over-answer ambiguous, underspecified, misrouted, or unsupported requests and produce hallucinated outputs instead of actionable feedback. To address this challenge, we present EARS (Explanatory Abstention for Reliable Sub-Agent Modeling), a production-oriented framework that reframes sub-agent abstention as an inter-agent communication protocol: a sub-agent does not merely abstain, but exposes an actionable failure state to the coordinator. EARS curates human-agent interaction data using an ensemble of calibrated LLM-as-a-Judge models, producing structured abstention labels and rationales under a taxonomy of sub-agent failure modes. These data are used to fine-tune sub-agents to detect failure conditions and return rationales for coordinator-level clarification, rerouting, or fallback. We evaluate EARS in a large-scale production e-commerce assistant supporting enterprise business intelligence workflows. EARS improves the overall response pass rate from 68.5% to 78.9%, demonstrating that sub-agent-side explanatory abstention improves MAS reliability.
thinking: 论文提出了一种面向生产环境的多智能体系统可靠性框架，通过引入解释性弃权机制提升子智能体的自我校准能力。该研究结合了前沿的LLM-as-a-Judge方法和真实电商场景验证，方法严谨且落地价值显著，但技术核心仍是基于现有微调范式，前沿突破性有限。

title: ContinualSkillBench: Can LLM Agents Truly Evolve Their Capabilities?
abstract:
arXiv:2608.03874v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Modern agent frameworks equip large language models with external skill libraries to solve complex tasks. However, it remains unclear whether these systems can effectively evolve their skills and whether the resulting skills improve task-solving capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce ContinualSkillBench, a dynamic evaluation framework for in-context continual skill learning. It covers five domains, each with 100 tasks ordered by difficulty and opportunities for skill transfer. Our experiments show that sequential execution generally improves performance, but the gains vary substantially across models and domains. Moreover, across two models and three domains, retaining context and feedback without skill maintenance yields nearly the same mean performance as maintaining an explicit skill library. Explicit skills nevertheless provide selective benefits for tasks requiring reusable procedures or precise outputs. We further find that the weaker model (GPT-4o) accumulates more skills but reuses them less often, suggesting difficulty consolidating task-specific experience into reusable procedures. These findings show that current in-context skill evolution mechanisms can support continual adaptation, but still struggle to consistently consolidate experience into robust and transferable skills.
thinking: 论文聚焦于大语言模型智能体的持续技能学习能力评估，提出了一个动态评估框架并进行了多领域实验，方法设计较为系统。但研究主要基于现有模型进行测试，技术前沿性有限，且结论指出当前机制在技能固化与迁移方面仍存在困难，实践应用价值尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现当前大语言模型智能体能在一定程度上通过上下文学习新技能，但难以将经验固化为稳定、可迁移的可靠能力。

title: EmoStance: Response-Side Affective-Orientation Control for Empathetic Response Generation via Emoji Weak Supervision
abstract:
arXiv:2609.02133v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Empathetic response generation requires models to decide not only what to say, but also how to respond to the previous speaker's affective situation. We formulate this as response-side affective-orientation control and use multi-annotator emoji distributions as weak affective--attitudinal evidence, rather than as output symbols or gold labels, to induce a latent control space that operationally approximates listener stance. We construct EmojiDialogue, an utterance-level extension of EmpatheticDialogues with emoji votes and confidence scores, and propose EmoStance, which models source-side affective expression, predicts a soft response-side orientation from dialogue context and speaker roles, and steers a frozen instruction-tuned LLM through continuous prefix embeddings. In blind pairwise evaluation with 20 annotators and 800 judgments, EmoStance achieves a 62.2% decisive win rate, with the clearest gains in contextual specificity and perceived responsiveness, while remaining complementary to external-knowledge methods. Code, annotation metadata, and reconstruction scripts are available in our GitHub repository: https://github.com/18277390221/EmoStance.

title: MS-Exam-Gen: An Automatic Benchmark Construction Toolkit for Evaluating LLMs on Multiple Sclerosis-MRI Imaging Knowledge
abstract:
arXiv:2610.06170v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Biomedical large language model (LLM) evaluation requires auditable assessment of narrow, evolving, source-grounded subspecialty knowledge. Multiple sclerosis MRI (MS-MRI) provides a high-stakes textual-knowledge test case because correct reasoning requires current diagnostic criteria, standardized acquisition and reporting knowledge, longitudinal monitoring concepts, lesion morphology, and recognition of difficult mimics. We present MS-Exam-Gen, a reproducible framework for constructing and auditing a text-based multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmark for MS-MRI knowledge; it does not evaluate direct MRI image interpretation. MS-Exam-Gen targets source-grounded criteria, protocols, reporting, and differential diagnosis. The framework combines expert-source indexing, exam-oriented topic induction, evidence-grounded MCQ generation, automated quality audits, a same-family consistency screen, and empirical calibration. From a 66-source corpus indexed into 4,289 retrieval chunks, the pipeline produced a locked 3,058-item candidate benchmark spanning 16 topics and 53 subtopics. Evaluation across 12 primary LLM endpoints yielded 36,696 item-level predictions and separated performance over a 42.8-percentage-point accuracy range (89.7% to 46.9%). Across these endpoints, 25.5% of items were missed by at least four. Post-generation audits showed that refreshed construction reduced measurable answer cues, while option-order testing showed that absolute MCQ scores remain position-sensitive. Generated construction labels remain metadata rather than validated psychometric categories. Because expert adjudication and full option-order counterbalancing remain future work, MS-Exam-Gen is not a clinically certified examination. It should be interpreted as an automatically filtered, source-grounded candidate benchmark and reproducible audit workflow for item-level and topic-specific LLM evaluation.

title: An Analysis of Role Semantics in Directed Dynamic Graph Modeling for Edge Classification
abstract:
arXiv:2602.23135v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Edge classification on directed dynamic graphs is critical for understanding evolving user-item interactions and behavioral patterns in recommender systems and social platforms. Existing dynamic graph architectures typically process these interactions using shared parameters for nodes with semantically distinct roles, including source, destination, query, and neighbor. While abundant supervision in tasks such as link prediction provides sufficient gradient signal for models to implicitly deduce role semantics and overcome this conflation, there are often far fewer labels available for edge classification. We hypothesize that in such regimes, the ability of models to implicitly separate roles is restricted, degrading downstream performance. To empirically investigate this relationship, we introduce an experimental framework for sequence-based models that explicitly disentangles functional roles using targeted embeddings and an asymmetric pretraining objective. By providing architectural priors for these roles, the framework serves as an evaluative vehicle to isolate and measure the resulting performance delta across a range of label budgets. Our empirical evaluation demonstrates that this explicit role disentanglement yields substantial and consistent relative performance gains over baselines. Furthermore, representational analyses reveal that the mechanism by which the framework provides these benefits is a bifurcation of source and destination latent spaces that improves linear separability.

title: A precision-driven evaluation protocol for author name disambiguation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13415v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Author Name Disambiguation systems are commonly evaluated using pairwise and B$^3$ metrics, which summarize clustering quality through aggregate precision and recall but do not explicitly distinguish between lumping (merging publications from different authors) and splitting (fragmenting the publications of a single author). Because these errors can have asymmetric consequences in bibliographic applications, we propose a precision-driven evaluation framework that decomposes clustering quality into complementary instance-level and cluster-level signals. The framework introduces cluster-level Lumping Error and Splitting Error to separately quantify contamination and fragmentation, combines them with standard pairwise and B$^3$ metrics through a Composite Score, and uses the resulting measures for model selection. We characterize the diagnostic behavior of the framework through a controlled synthetic case study and assess the sensitivity of the Composite Score to its weighting scheme. The results show that the proposed structural measures distinguish error patterns that aggregate metrics can mask, while the sensitivity analysis identifies a stable region for the adopted weighting configuration. The framework is released as an open-source Python pipeline.
