title: OC-AND: A Citation-Enriched Benchmark for Author Name Disambiguation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13462v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Author Name Disambiguation benchmarks are predominantly derived from closed infrastructures that may not reflect conditions in open bibliographic environments. We present OC-AND, an open citation-enriched benchmark for AND constructed by remapping the WhoIsWho dataset with bibliographic and citation metadata from OpenCitations. The dataset is produced through a reproducible five-stage pipeline involving DOI verification, metadata validation, OpenCitations enrichment, and author-centric transformation. OC-AND retains the WhoIsWho ground-truth files and partition structure unchanged, while its publication files are restricted to publications that could be matched to a validated DOI and an OpenCitations record. It introduces realistic characteristics of open environments: heterogeneous metadata completeness, absent abstracts and affiliations, asymmetric citation coverage, and sparse graph connectivity. The dataset contains author records with associated citations, enabling evaluation of AND methods in settings closer to real-world open scholarly infrastructure scenarios. OC-AND is released as open data with complete provenance documentation and pipeline code, supporting reproducible research and the development of citation-aware disambiguation approaches.
thinking: 该论文构建了一个基于开放引文数据的作者姓名消歧基准数据集，采用了前沿的开放科学基础设施，技术方法具有创新性。数据集构建流程规范、可复现，但作为基准数据集本身，其业务落地价值主要体现在为后续研究提供评估工具，而非直接应用于图书馆或信息机构的日常业务。

title: Beyond the Final Embedding: Retrieving Memories from Token-Level Evidence
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13277v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Memory-augmented assistants retrieve evidence from stored conversations and documents to answer queries. Most embedding-based retrievers compare single-vector representations of queries and memories, even when relevance depends on a small part of the content. Such local evidence can be matched to queries using the contextual token representations already computed by the same embedding models. Our method uses sparse token matching to improve retrieval without additional training. Each query token retrieves a small set of matching tokens across candidate memories. The matching scores are aggregated for each memory and combined with whole-memory similarity to rank memories. An optional low-rank query adapter can be trained with supervision while keeping the encoder and stored memory representations fixed. Our method improves retrieval across eight benchmarks and multiple model families without additional training. Query adaptation further increases the gains to 13.3 and 14.3 percentage points in average Recall@10 and NDCG@10 on Qwen3-Embedding-4B. These retrieval gains translate into higher question-answering accuracy on long-term memory benchmarks.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于稀疏令牌匹配的检索增强方法，通过利用嵌入模型已计算的上下文令牌表示来捕捉局部证据，无需额外训练即可提升检索效果，方法新颖且实验验证充分。其技术思路具有前沿性，但作为预印本论文，其方法在具体业务场景（如图书馆问答系统）中的直接落地路径和集成成本尚未充分探讨。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种无需额外训练的稀疏令牌匹配方法，通过结合局部令牌证据与整体记忆相似性，显著提升了记忆增强问答系统的检索性能。

title: PRIME: Pre-Retrieval Index Modeling Enhancement for Structured Document Retrieval-Real
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13296v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: High-precision retrieval over external knowledge bases is essential for LLM agents to operate effectively. However, existing Information Retrieval (IR) research primarily optimizes query-side retrievers (e.g., ColBERT, BGE) and generators (e.g., Self-RAG, GraphRAG), while reducing corpus-side representation to chunking. This leaves index-side quality an underexplored lever. We propose Pre-Retrieval Index Modeling & Enhancement (PRIME), an index-side optimization framework built on two complementary tracks: an LLM-driven Semantic Restructuring (SR) track that transforms long documents into structured, information-dense sections, and a deterministic Metadata Synthesis (MS) and Hierarchical Retrieval (HR) track that extracts semantic anchors and heading structure for coarse-to-fine section retrieval. Our evaluations show that deterministic metadata matches structure-aware chunking's retrieval quality while cutting embedding computation by 45.8 $\times$ and index vector count by 22.4 $\times$. On top of these gains, Semantic Restructuring (SR) further improves Answer-F1 by 13.7% in full deployment, with characterized quality-fidelity-cost trade-offs. Across QASPER, BRIGHT, and NFCorpus, we further characterize three qualitative regimes that determine whether index-side optimization helps or degrades retrieval, while showing that these index-side effects are neutralized under a strong reranker.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个面向结构化文档检索的索引端优化框架PRIME，通过语义重组和元数据合成等方法，显著提升了检索效率并降低了计算成本。其方法设计严谨，在多个数据集上进行了验证，但作为预印本尚未经过同行评议，且技术方案主要面向特定检索场景，通用性有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种通过优化索引结构来提升大语言模型外部知识检索效率与精度的新框架。

title: NEAR: Neighborhood-Aware Residuals for Memory Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13314v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Memory retrieval aims to identify evidence from stored records to answer a query. Stored records with different factual details may share topics, entities, or events. Such shared contents would make records without the required evidence more likely to receive high similarity scores and outrank the correct evidence. In this paper, we use the information shared by these records to construct local references for query-memory matching. We propose NEighborhood-Aware Residuals (NEAR), a training-free framework that uses these references to construct residual representations that complement the original embeddings. Specifically, each memory derives a reference direction from its neighbors, and each query obtains its reference from a precomputed table. Using these references, NEAR constructs projection residuals for both queries and memories. These residuals are combined with the original embeddings for a single approximate nearest-neighbor search over a fixed memory index. Experiments on eight long-context retrieval benchmarks show consistent improvements across nine embedding models. Downstream evaluations show that NEAR improves question-answering performance.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种训练自由的邻域感知残差框架（NEAR），通过构建局部参考来增强查询与记忆的匹配，在多个长上下文检索基准上验证了其有效性。其方法创新性较强，但作为预印本尚未经过同行评议，且实际应用场景和落地价值有待进一步明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种无需训练的新方法，通过利用存储记录间的共享信息来构建残差表示，从而提升了长文本检索的准确性。

title: SPARQL-LLM in the TEXT2SPARQL 2026 Challenge
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13648v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Querying distributed data represented as Knowledge Graphs (KGs) via SPARQL remains a difficult task, requiring fluency in query syntax, endpoint specifications, and schema details. Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) systems address this by automatically translating natural language into SPARQL, and recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have made this translation increasingly feasible. In this paper, we describe SPARQL-LLM, our open-source KGQA system, in the context of the TEXT2SPARQL 2026 challenge. In this challenge, SPARQL-LLM ranks first overall among eight competing approaches across all datasets, achieving up to 59% higher accuracy than the second-best approach and supporting multilingual question answering in English, German, and Spanish. SPARQL-LLM is publicly released at https://github.com/sib-swiss/sparql-llm and deployed in production over decentralized bioinformatics KGs at https://www.expasy.org/chat.
thinking: 论文聚焦于利用大语言模型（LLM）解决知识图谱问答（KGQA）中的自然语言到SPARQL查询转换难题，技术前沿性突出，并在公开评测中取得了显著的性能优势。其成果以开源系统形式发布并已在生物信息学领域实际部署，业务落地价值明确。然而，作为一篇描述系统参与评测的短文，其研究方法部分（如模型架构、训练数据、评估细节）的严谨性未充分展现，影响了方法严谨性的评分。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出的SPARQL-LLM系统，在将自然语言问题转换为知识图谱查询的国际评测中表现最佳，并已应用于生物信息学领域。

title: Tracing and Taming Hallucinated Terms via Subsequence-Association Filtering and Breadth-Aware Selection for LLM Query Expansion
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13810v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are now a standard source of query expansion terms but they hallucinate. They inject non existent entities and off-topic terms that add ranking noise and can hurt strong retrievers. Existing remedies such as corpus grounding, mutual verification and preference alignment treat hallucinated terms as an undifferentiated nuisance to be filtered by agreement heuristics, without a mechanistic account of why a given term appears or a principled criterion for how many terms to keep. We propose Subsequence-Association Filtered, breadth-aware query expansion (SAFE-QE), a training-free, retriever agnostic method that draws on the subsequence-association account of hallucination. We score each candidate expansion term by its corpus conditioned cross-context reproducibility, terms that reappear under randomised query contexts yet lack support in the pseudo-relevant set are flagged as products of dominant hallucinatory associations and down-weighted. Drawing on the characterisation of language generation as a trade-off between consistency (no hallucination) and breadth (coverage), we cast term selection as constrained coverage maximisation over the pseudo-relevant set, keeping a set that is approximately broad but consistent and stable across resampling. We also introduce the Hallucinated Expansion Term Rate, a query side faithfulness metric that counts injected expansion terms no relevant document supports. We evaluate our approach on benchmarked TREC and BEIR collections. Our SAFE-QE is statistically indistinguishable from generative and corpus-steered expansion on nDCG@10 while injecting fewer unsupported terms 4.3 per query against 27.8 for Query2doc and 57.5 for HyDE and on a strong learned sparse retriever, where every expansion method regresses. Faithfulness is therefore available at no measurable cost in ranking quality.
thinking: 该论文针对大语言模型查询扩展中的幻觉问题，提出了基于子序列关联过滤和广度感知选择的SAFE-QE方法，在保持检索性能的同时显著减少了幻觉术语的注入，方法设计具有创新性和理论依据。其不足在于作为arXiv预印本，方法尚未在更广泛的真实图书馆或信息检索系统中得到实践验证，且对伪相关文档集的质量有一定依赖。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种新方法，能有效识别并减少大语言模型在查询扩展时产生的虚假术语，且不影响检索效果。

title: GeopoliticalQA: Benchmarking Retrieval and Generation over Intelligence Reports
abstract:
arXiv:2610.12617v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Geopolitical and strategic intelligence reports constitute a rich source of expert knowledge and have increasing value in the current political climate, but their heterogeneity and analytical complexity pose challenges for retrieval-augmented question answering. We introduce a benchmark for grounded question answering over 415 open-source geopolitical and strategic intelligence reports, comprising 5,525 document-grounded question-answer pairs spanning factual, inferential, comparative, and risk-oriented questions. We propose a document-aware generation pipeline that profiles reports before generating questions and validate dataset quality through expert annotation and an LLM-as-judge protocol. Using the benchmark, we evaluate 15 retrieval systems and six open-weight LLMs for RAG. We find that models perform similarly on document-level retrieval, while at the harder chunk level retrieval quality is not driven by embedding-model scale: bge-m3, a mid-size open encoder matches an order of magnitude larger ones and outperforms commercial embedding APIs. In contrast, answer generation remains challenging even given the gold evidence, particularly for inferential and risk-oriented questions.
thinking: 该论文构建了一个基于地缘政治情报报告的问答基准数据集，并系统评估了多种检索与生成模型，在数据集构建方法上具有创新性，且对开源与商业模型进行了对比分析。然而，其研究场景（开源情报报告）虽具现实意义，但直接应用于图书馆等机构的业务场景路径尚不明确，方法学部分详实但未涉及大规模用户实验验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究创建了一个地缘政治情报问答基准，发现中等规模的嵌入模型在检索任务上可媲美大型商业模型，但复杂推理问题的生成答案仍具挑战性。

title: Locate, Judge, Read: Role-Specialized Tool Agents over a Knowledge-Point Index for Open-Domain Multimodal Document QA
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13128v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Question answering over large heterogeneous document collections requires first finding the right passages and then reading them, yet current retrieval-augmented agents give one model both kinds of tools and let it schedule itself. We present KnowForge, a pipeline separated by job: a hybrid-retrieval knowledge-point index; a Locator agent that can only search; a code-scheduled bridge judge that forces the missing second hop; a typed, size-bounded evidence pool that merges every search's ranking; a Deep Reader agent that can only read text, images and tables; and a synthesizer with a format checker. With a self-hosted Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (3B active), KnowForge reaches F1 47.5 on the full open-domain M3DocVQA (2,441 questions, 3,368 PDFs), +11.0 over the published M3DocRAG system and +7.1 over one-shot retrieve-and-answer on the same index and model, and 53.5 with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On MultiHop-RAG it reaches 73.5 accuracy, above the strongest published RAG and GraphRAG results (71.2); on the single-document MMLongBench-Doc it lifts the same model from 34.8 to 47.0, level with GPT-4o reading page images (46.3). Per-job ablations on the full benchmarks attribute the gain: the Deep Reader is worth 3.8, 9.8 and 0 points on the three corpora, tracking how visual each is; merging both agents into one with all tools and twice the rounds loses 1.9 F1 because it keeps searching instead of reading; a round-budget sweep shows a step at four Locator rounds and a plateau beyond; query latency scales with model calls rather than corpus size. We serve the three indexed benchmarks as read-only knowledge bases (free registration) and release all prompts and the runner code: https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于角色分工的检索增强生成（RAG）框架，通过分离定位（Locator）和深度阅读（Deep Reader）代理，并引入知识点索引和证据池等机制，在多模态文档问答任务上取得了显著性能提升。其方法设计严谨，通过消融实验验证了各模块贡献，但所采用的大语言模型和检索技术本身属于当前主流，而非开创性前沿。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过让“定位”和“阅读”两个AI代理分工协作，显著提升了从大量多模态文档中寻找并回答复杂问题的准确率。

title: Web$hell: A Unified Interface for Agentic Web Access
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13416v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are becoming direct users of the open web. As they take on increasingly complex and information-intensive tasks, effective web access is becoming a core capability for agentic problem solving. Existing approaches have advanced agentic web access through different access models, including search-augmented agents, browser-based agents, and, more recently, filesystem-based agents. Nevertheless, as users expect agents to complete long-horizon, end-to-end tasks, they increasingly need to conduct broad information gathering, perform browser actions, and revisit acquired evidence within a single trajectory. Yet our preliminary analyses reveal that existing access models struggle to meet these demands. They primarily support either information gathering or browser interaction, while combining their capabilities can involve substantial costs or performance trade-offs. To this end, we present Web\$hell, an interface that unifies web access under a single access model. Using a common schema defined by WebContract, WebCompiler compiles live webpages into addressable information and action objects. These objects are maintained in WebCache and handled through a shared set of operations, providing agents with consistent, operable, and persistent web access. Through extensive experiments across web search, web navigation, and deep research benchmarks, we show that Web\$hell achieves strong task performance at lower cost. Our results further indicate the importance of interface design for effective web access, with Web\$hell opening new possibilities for more capable and efficient LLM agents on the web.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种统一的Web访问接口Web$hell，通过编译网页为可寻址的信息和动作对象，解决了现有LLM代理在复杂Web任务中信息收集与浏览器交互难以兼顾的问题。方法设计新颖且实验充分，但作为技术原型，其在实际图情业务场景中的直接落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究为大型语言模型代理设计了一个统一接口，使其能更高效、低成本地完成网页信息搜索与交互任务。

title: Beyond Temporal Proximity: Explanatory World Models for Credit Assignment in Reinforcement Learning
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13504v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Generative Recommenders increasingly use Reinforcement Learning (RL) to optimize outcomes that may appear hundreds or thousands of interactions after a decision. Standard RL propagates reward according to temporal proximity rather than explicit relevance, attenuating the signal assigned to distant but important actions and creating a source of sample inefficiency. We introduce Explanatory World Models (EWM), an attribution framework that uses explanations to identify the earlier events that plausibly contributed to a realized outcome. We instantiate EWM with a frontier language model and use its explanations as learning signals using a conservative hierarchical operator that recursively redistributes reward while preserving the undiscounted episode return. To investigate what constitutes a useful explanation, we operationalize three complementary variants inspired by Halpern's actual causation, Lombrozo's explanatory simplicity, and Deutsch's hard-to-vary explanations. We evaluate EWM on two controlled long-horizon RL benchmarks, a public sequential-recommendation benchmark, and an industry-scale generative recommender. On Crafter and WordCraft, EWM substantially outperforms PPO and LaRe, with its largest gains when rewards are most delayed. On KuaiRand, EWM outperforms SFT and LaRe offline and A2C online. Finally, in an offline evaluation of an industry generative recommender, EWM considerably improves Recall and increases behavioral proxies. These results suggest that explanations can provide structured and reusable credit for learning from delayed outcomes.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于解释性世界模型（EWM）的强化学习信用分配框架，在长时延奖励场景下有效提升了推荐系统性能，方法具有创新性并在公开和工业级数据集上验证了效果。然而，其前沿性主要体现在对现有大语言模型（LLM）的特定应用上，而非底层模型架构的突破；其业务落地价值虽经工业数据集测试，但具体部署到图书馆等非商业信息环境的适配性尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究利用大语言模型的解释能力改进强化学习中的信用分配，有效解决了推荐系统中因奖励延迟导致的样本效率低下问题。

title: RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13889v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: As AI agents increasingly rely on external tools, accurate retrieval is essential for reliable behavior. Existing methods optimize semantic relevance but largely ignore tool availability during execution. To address this gap, we propose RATED (Reliability-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics), a retrieval framework that combines robust semantic matching with dynamic reliability adaptation. RATED employs a frozen dual-encoder with contrastive fine-tuning for semantic matching, and a lightweight contextual bandit module that re-ranks candidates based on real-time execution feedback. This design enables rapid adaptation to runtime tool failures without expensive model retraining. We introduce EcoAgent, a benchmark of 5,172 real-world tools and over 210,000 query-tool pairs for offline retrieval and dynamic reliability evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that RATED achieves a 52.2% relative MRR improvement over the ToolLLM API retriever on real-world queries, and reduces fault selection rate from 86.2% to 2.9% under severe API outage scenarios with a 30% failure rate, while incurring negligible latency overhead of less than 1 ms over encode-only inference. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Elliotes/EcoAgent.
thinking: 论文提出了一种结合语义匹配与实时执行反馈的AI工具检索框架，在动态可靠性适应方面具有创新性，并构建了大规模真实世界工具数据集进行验证。然而，作为arXiv预印本，其方法严谨性尚未经过同行评议的全面检验，且其应用场景目前主要面向AI代理开发，在图情领域的直接落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种能根据工具实时可用性动态调整检索结果的AI代理工具检索方法，显著降低了故障选择率。

title: Can Language Models Play the Wikipedia Game?
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13948v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Language models increasingly support or automate information retrieval from document collections too large to index. This task is difficult when it requires specialist linguistic or scientific knowledge. We used the Wikipedia Game to test language models on an analogous information retrieval task. In the game, players must reach a target article using only article links. We compared sentence embedding models and LLMs across five Wikipedia languages and five academic-literature datasets. We construct very large local graphs of Wikipedia pages and of paper citations using OpenAlex and provide code to build and navigate them. This allows the study of language models' navigation capabilities without relying on third-party APIs. We compared the models with human and TF-IDF benchmarks. The Wikipedia Game format enables robust comparisons across techniques, languages, and domains. No model significantly outperformed humans, although the best models (GPT-o3 mini, GPT-4o, QwQ:32B, and DeepSeek-R1:70B) achieved comparable success. Performance and rankings varied across languages and topics, with implications for practitioners utilising these techniques.
thinking: 该论文采用Wikipedia Game作为评估框架，创新性地将语言模型在大型知识图谱中的导航能力与人类表现进行系统对比，方法设计具有启发性；但研究主要依赖现有预训练模型进行测试，未提出新的模型架构或训练方法，技术原创性有限。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在类似维基百科游戏的复杂信息检索任务中，顶尖语言模型的导航能力已接近人类水平，但其表现因语言和主题领域而异。

title: CRM: Retrieval Model with Controllable Condition
abstract:
arXiv:2412.13844v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Retrieval models for recommendation need to account for outcomes such as watch time while searching large item corpora efficiently. We present the Controllable Retrieval Model (CRM), an outcome-conditioned retrieval framework that adds watch time as an input to the user tower. During training, CRM learns to predict the next item given its observed watch time; at inference, we supply a desired watch time to steer retrieval without retraining. The item tower is independent of the condition, so item embeddings can still be precomputed and indexed for approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search. We implement CRM as both a DNN-based two-tower model and a Decision Transformer. The Transformer interleaves item tokens with watch-time-to-go condition tokens, using the target watch time as a numerical prompt for next-item prediction. For each online request, we choose between the average and maximum watch times in the user's recent history as the condition. CRM is deployed in Kuaishou's short-video recommendation system, which serves over 400 million users. Online A/B tests show video watch time improvements of 0.372% in Kuaishou and 0.457% in Kuaishou Lite.
thinking: 论文提出了一个将观看时长作为可控条件融入检索模型的新框架，并在快手短视频推荐系统中进行了大规模在线A/B测试验证，技术应用前沿且落地价值显著。然而，作为arXiv预印本，其方法细节和实验设计的严谨性有待同行评议期刊的进一步确认。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种将观看时长作为可控条件的检索模型，在快手数亿用户的推荐系统中成功应用，有效提升了视频观看时长。

title: Imagine Before Acting: Prospective Skill Identification for LLM Agents
abstract:
arXiv:2609.01642v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Effective skill identification is crucial for LLM agents to reuse task-solving experience for complex task execution, which however remains challenging as agents must accurately identify useful skills from a large skill gallery and invoke them on demand. Existing studies have explored various strategies for skill retrieval and invocation, but largely overlook the natural discrepancy between task descriptions and skill documents. To be specific, our empirical study reveals that task descriptions mainly specify task objectives, whereas skill documents describe the required capabilities and procedural guidance for achieving the objectives. Such a so-called Task--Skill Misalignment (TSM) problem would cause desirable skills to be neglected during retrieval or remain unselected during invocation, thus hindering task execution. As a remedy, inspired by human prospective cognition, we propose SkillDreamer, a prospective skill identification framework to mitigate TSM. In brief, SkillDreamer first infers execution-required capabilities and imagines their realizations as pseudo skills, thereby translating task objectives into execution-oriented guidance for skill retrieval. As execution proceeds, SkillDreamer reevaluates the capabilities required by emerging subtasks to determine which skills should be invoked, thereby aligning skill invocation with evolving execution needs. Extensive experiments on three representative agent skill benchmarks not only verify the effectiveness of SkillDreamer in mitigating TSM, but also demonstrate its generalizability across diverse retrievers and LLM agents. The code will be released upon acceptance.
thinking: 该论文针对LLM代理技能识别中的任务-技能错配问题，提出了前瞻性认知框架SkillDreamer，通过推断执行所需能力并生成伪技能来改进检索与调用，方法新颖且实验设计较为系统。然而，作为预印本，其方法严谨性尚未经过同行评议的充分检验，且在图情领域的直接落地场景尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一个名为SkillDreamer的前瞻性框架，通过模拟执行所需能力来解决大语言模型代理在复用已有技能时面临的任务描述与技能文档不匹配问题。

title: Access Paths for Efficient Ordering with Large Language Models
abstract:
arXiv:2509.00303v5 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: In this work, we present the \texttt{LLM ORDER BY} semantic operator as a logical abstraction and conduct a systematic study of its physical implementations. First, we propose several improvements to existing semantic sorting algorithms and introduce a semantic-aware external merge sort algorithm. Our extensive evaluation reveals that no single implementation offers universal optimality on all datasets. From our evaluations, we observe a general scaling relationship between sorting cost and the ordering quality for comparison-based algorithms. Building on these insights, we design a budget-aware optimizer that utilizes heuristic rules, LLM-as-Judge evaluation, and consensus aggregation to dynamically select the near-optimal access path for LLM ORDER BY. In our extensive evaluations, our optimizer consistently achieves ranking accuracy on par with or superior to the best static methods across all benchmarks. We believe that this work provides foundational insights into the principled optimization of semantic operators essential for building robust, large-scale LLM-powered analytic systems.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于大语言模型在排序任务中的优化实现，提出了创新的语义排序算法和预算感知优化器，技术前沿性突出。研究通过系统评估和动态路径选择，方法严谨且具有较好的可复现性，但其在图书馆等具体业务场景的直接落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究为LLM的语义排序操作设计了多种优化算法和一个动态选择最优方案的预算感知优化器。

title: Differentiable Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Predicting Cellular Responses to Gene Perturbation
abstract:
arXiv:2603.07233v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Predicting transcriptional responses to genetic perturbations is fundamental to functional genomics and therapeutic discovery. Recent deep learning models have shown promise in single-cell perturbation response prediction, but they typically generate each response in isolation, without explicitly leveraging related perturbations. We introduce PT-RAG (Perturbation-aware Two-stage Retrieval-Augmented Generation), a plug-in retrieval-and-conditioning module for generative cellular perturbation response. PT-RAG augments an existing perturbation-response backbone with learned access to related perturbation contexts. The key challenge is that relevance is not fixed in this setting: functionally related genes may elicit different effects across cell types. PT-RAG addresses this with a two-stage retrieval mechanism: GenePT-based semantic retrieval first identifies K candidate perturbations, after which a differentiable Gumbel-Softmax selector adaptively selects retrieved contexts conditioned on the control cell state, the query perturbation, and each candidate perturbation. We evaluate PT-RAG on two backbones, a STATE-style generator used as a frozen random reservoir and a fully trained scGPT, across cross-cell-type and cross-perturbation generalization tasks. PT-RAG consistently improves distributional similarity and often overall predictive quality; for example, on scGPT cross-cell-type results, the 2-Wasserstein distance drops by 5.9% relative to scGPT alone. The code to reproduce our experiments is available at https://github.com/difra100/PT-RAG_NIPS.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种可微分的检索增强生成方法，用于预测基因扰动下的细胞反应，其核心创新在于将信息检索领域的前沿技术（RAG）与生成模型结合，并设计了适应生物学场景的两阶段检索机制，技术前沿性突出。然而，作为一项方法学探索，其直接应用于图书馆或信息机构业务场景的路径尚不明确，实践价值有限。研究方法在模型构建与实验验证上较为严谨，代码开源增强了可复现性。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过结合检索与生成模型，提出了一种能更准确预测基因如何影响细胞的新方法。

title: UxSID: Semantic-Aware User Interests Modeling for Ultra-Long Sequence
abstract:
arXiv:2605.09040v4 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Modeling ultra-long user sequences involves a difficult trade-off between efficiency and effectiveness. While current paradigms rely on either item-specific search or item-agnostic compression, we propose UxSID, a framework exploring a third path: semantic-group shared interest memory. By utilizing Semantic IDs (SIDs) and a dual-level attention strategy, UxSID captures target-aware preferences without the heavy cost of item-specific models. This end-to-end architecture balances computational parsimony with semantic awareness, achieving state-of-the-art performance and a 0.337% revenue lift in large-scale advertising A/B test.
thinking: 该论文提出了UxSID框架，通过引入语义ID和双层注意力机制来建模超长用户序列兴趣，在效率和效果间取得了平衡，并在大规模广告A/B测试中验证了其性能提升，具有明确的技术创新和应用价值。其方法基于语义组共享兴趣记忆，属于当前序列建模的前沿探索，但作为预印本论文，其方法细节和实验复现性有待同行评议进一步确认。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种利用语义ID建模超长用户兴趣序列的新框架，在保证效率的同时提升了推荐效果，并带来了广告收入的实际增长。

title: Trust, but Validate the Instrument: Auditing AI-Generated RTL Verification Plans on Authored Security-Regression Proxies
abstract:
arXiv:2609.19844v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: AI-generated RTL verification plans can satisfy a provider schema yet fail at the boundary to trusted execution. We present SecTB-RTL, an auditable framework covering 31 tasks and 124 authored hardware-security regressions. A deterministic non-AI baseline killed 36, 75, and 78 mutants at increasing resource limits. The first confirmatory run (C1-R2) failed before model execution because the provider rejected its response schema. After a schema-only repair made without viewing outcomes, a separately frozen follow-up run (C1-R3) completed 1,860 calls. The provider accepted 1,857 responses, but only nine passed the production semantic validator. The generation and execution rules did not match. We therefore preserve the run as an instrument-validation incident and report no prompt-effect estimate. This incident shows that provider or schema acceptance does not establish execution validity. Compilation and coverage are only diagnostics; the exact saved artifact must pass the full production path. A subsequent follow-up is excluded because it did not satisfy the preregistered evidence-completeness gate and is treated only as future work. We release the benchmark, failure-preserving contract, incident provenance, and governance controls needed to prevent infrastructure behavior from being misreported as model behavior.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种用于审计AI生成的RTL验证计划的框架，并揭示了即使AI输出符合提供方模式，也可能在安全回归测试中失败，这突显了验证AI系统可靠性的重要性。研究通过详尽的实验设计和明确的失败案例记录，展现了方法上的严谨性，但其技术背景高度专业化，直接应用于图情领域的场景有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究发现，AI生成的硬件验证计划即使通过了形式上的模式检查，在实际安全测试中也可能大量失败，强调了独立审计的重要性。

title: Claim-Gated Source-Risk Auditing for Generative Search
abstract:
arXiv:2609.29145v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: A generative search answer can cite a supported passage yet omit a source relationship that changes its interpretation. We specify a claim-gated audit of the query-source-answer tuple. An omission is resolved only when relationship evidence, answer adoption, materiality, and disclosure are all observed; incomplete evidence remains unresolved rather than being treated as independence. The specification separates this endpoint from citation support and review priority, and binds decisions to versioned evidence spans. A reference checker makes the record contract executable. On an exhaustive synthetic suite, it reproduces all 81 three-state predicate combinations and rejects 192 deliberately malformed records. Common-guard baselines and predicate ablations isolate endpoint logic from missing-evidence handling, while controlled transitions check support separation and evidence removal. These are finite contract-conformance results, not detector accuracy or evidence of improved user outcomes. We define the independent annotation, held-out evaluation, and paired utility tests still required to establish semantic validity and deployment benefit.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种针对生成式搜索的声明门控源风险审计框架，在方法上具有创新性和严谨性，通过详尽的合成测试集验证了其逻辑完备性。然而，其前沿性主要体现在对生成式AI可信引用这一新兴问题的解决方案设计上，而非底层技术本身；其实际应用价值目前仍停留在概念验证阶段，缺乏真实场景的效用评估。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种审计框架，用于检测生成式搜索答案在引用来源时可能存在的、会改变答案含义的关键关系遗漏。

title: CLUE: A Contrastive Learning Framework for Unsupervised Event Type Induction and Annotation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.12580v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Event ontology is the foundational framework for defining events in a dataset. Event type induction generally involves domain experts who define guidelines for creating event types and their names based on the dataset's domain and scope. However, this process is resource-intensive in terms of annotation costs and is prone to human biases. To alleviate the need for manual event ontology creation, we propose the CLUE framework for event type induction, naming, and annotation. Our main contributions in this work are: 1) designing a novel joint embedding representation for expressing both the verb-centric view and the semantic view of events; 2) event type induction using contrastive loss guided clustering; 3) event naming and refinement. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. Our code is available at https://github.com/PratikMaitra/CLUE.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于对比学习的无监督事件类型归纳与标注框架，采用了当前NLP领域较为前沿的对比学习和联合嵌入表示技术，技术新颖性突出。然而，其研究场景和方法论主要面向通用自然语言处理，与图书馆学情报学的具体业务场景结合不够紧密，实践应用路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一个无监督学习框架，能自动从文本中归纳、命名和标注事件类型，减少人工构建事件本体的成本。

title: Reflective Prompt Optimization of a Deep-Research Agent: A Topic-Disjoint, Multi-Seed Protocol for Measuring Transferable Gains and Prompt-Level Overfitting
abstract:
arXiv:2610.12601v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Prompt optimization is an attractive alternative to reinforcement learning for adapting language-model agents, since it is cheap and produces human-readable artifacts. On factual tasks, however, it carries a failure mode that scalar-reward reinforcement learning does not. An optimizer that reads the training examples can write their answers into the prompt, so an in-distribution gain may be memorization rather than transferable behaviour. We apply reflective prompt evolution (GEPA) to the two system prompts of a multi-agent deep-research agent and evaluate it under a topic-disjoint split in which no topic is shared across train, validation, and test. Held-out citation reward rises by 0.079, from 0.702 to 0.781, with a bootstrap 95\% confidence interval of [0.051, 0.107], and the gain replicates across three seeds (mean 0.107). Nearly half of the winning prompt is a memorized answer key, yet a controlled ablation shows this content earns no reward even on the exact training questions it encodes. The large validation-minus-held-out gap is therefore small-sample selection under a noisy judge, not memorization. Varying the verifier isolates what makes the gain transfer. Decomposed per-dimension feedback is the causal ingredient, and collapsing it to a single scalar reward makes held-out transfer negative. The gain persists under an out-of-family judge and is largely reproduced by a hand-written version of the discovered recipe. Credible evaluation of prompt optimizers therefore requires held-out topics, multiple seeds, and verifier ablations. We release the candidate prompts, lineage diffs, figures, tables, and analysis.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于大语言模型提示优化的评估方法学，提出了主题分离、多种子验证等严谨的实验协议，有效区分了可迁移增益与提示级过拟合，方法设计规范且具有创新性。然而，研究场景高度技术化，主要面向AI研究者，其发现对图书馆等业务场景的直接应用价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一套严谨的评估协议，证明了大语言模型提示优化中可迁移增益的存在，并揭示了避免评估偏差的关键方法。

title: perturber: A Stateless Service for Semantics-Preserving Text Perturbations
abstract:
arXiv:2610.12667v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language model (LLM) evaluations on clean benchmarks overstate model robustness: real inputs arrive perturbed, and these meaning-preserving variants routinely move model answers. Studying this systematically requires applying perturbations one at a time, reproducibly, and identically wherever they run, yet existing tools couple them to a benchmarking stack rather than packaging them as a reusable transform layer. We present perturber, a stateless service and Python library that applies exactly one semantics-preserving perturbation per call, drawn from a first-party catalog of 68 perturbations across 11 families. It turns on a single primitive, with composition left to the caller chaining calls, so the service and the library produce identical output by construction. We evaluate the tool itself, its correctness, reproducibility, and cost, rather than any model's robustness, measuring meaning-preservation per perturbation rather than assuming it. The demonstration adds a live playground, an introspectable catalog for benchmark selection, and a one-command reproducible evaluation.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种用于语义保持文本扰动的无状态服务，其核心贡献在于将扰动操作标准化、模块化，为LLM鲁棒性评估提供了可复现的基础工具。方法上通过构建包含68种扰动的分类目录并验证其语义保持性，体现了较高的严谨性；但作为工具类研究，其技术前沿性主要体现在方法论创新而非底层技术突破。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一个标准化工具，能系统化地生成并验证语义保持的文本扰动，以更准确地评估大语言模型的真实鲁棒性。

title: GeoFitBench-LLM: A Benchmark for Assessing Large Language Models' Capabilities in Geospatial Data Requirements Elicitation for Geo-Analytic Tasks
abstract:
arXiv:2610.12669v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models are becoming central to GeoAI systems, yet their evaluation rarely considers the elicitation of geospatial data requirements. This omission is critical as retrieval oriented geo-analytic tasks cannot be supported reliably without first identifying the necessary datasets and constraints. GeoFitBench-LLM is introduced as a benchmark for assessing whether LLMs can infer the datasets, the supporting resources and the constraints required by geo-analytic requests in natural language. The benchmark is structured around two reasoning dimensions, Spatio-Temporal Relational and Semantic Grounding, reflecting long-standing challenges in geospatial information retrieval and related natural language tasks. Ground truth requirements are encoded in a fixed, provider-independent schema for reproducible evaluation of resource identification and attribute-level specification. Experiments on seven models under minimal prompting indicate that identifying the necessary resources is often achievable, with GPT-5.4 Thinking achieving the best result by recovering the complete set of resources in 66.67% of benchmark requests. Results further indicate that accurate fitness-for-use specification remains more difficult as inferential demands increase.
thinking: 论文聚焦于评估大语言模型在提取地理空间数据需求方面的能力，提出了GeoFitBench-LLM基准，并设计了时空关系和语义基础两个推理维度，方法设计具有创新性和针对性。然而，其实验仅基于最小化提示词，且最佳模型在完整资源识别上的准确率仅为66.67%，表明方法在复杂推理任务上的有效性仍有待提升，且其实践应用场景（如具体的地理信息系统集成）尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究创建了一个基准来测试大语言模型能否从自然语言请求中准确推断出地理分析任务所需的数据集和约束条件。

title: U4RASD at KnowledgeGraphEval-2026: Ontology-Constrained Encoder and LLM Systems for Arabic Relation Extraction
abstract:
arXiv:2610.12742v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: This paper details our submission to KnowledgeGraphEval 2026 Subtask 2 on directed Arabic relation extraction. We explored encoder-based and large language model approaches for predicting one of 40 relations or no_relation from an Arabic sentence and a subject-object pair. Our encoder systems use typed entity markers and separate relation-existence and relation-classification heads, while our LLM systems fine-tune Yehia and Qwen3.5 with QLoRA and ontology-constrained prediction. Our best system, an ensemble of Yehia-RE, Qwen-RE, and TypedPair, achieved a micro-F1 score of 94.06 and ranked 1st in Subtask 2. Yehia-RE (full-vocabulary) achieved 92.98, while the best encoder and Qwen-RE achieved 92.69 and 91.94 respectively. Our results highlight the importance of constrained prediction and complementary modeling approaches for Arabic relation extraction.
thinking: 该论文聚焦阿拉伯语关系抽取这一具体任务，采用了前沿的编码器与大语言模型融合方法，并引入本体约束预测，技术路线先进且针对性强。其方法严谨性体现在详细的模型架构描述、明确的评估指标（F1分数）和有效的集成策略上，但作为特定竞赛任务，其业务落地价值相对有限，主要服务于特定语种的信息抽取技术验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过融合编码器和微调大语言模型，并采用本体约束预测，在阿拉伯语关系抽取评测任务中取得了最佳性能。

title: Temporal Evidence Forests for Long-Horizon Multi-Party Conversational Memory
abstract:
arXiv:2610.12874v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Long-term memory has been widely adopted in LLM-based agents to support persistent interaction and personalized assistance. Long-term multi-party interactions, however, accumulate substantially more detailed information, with decisions repeatedly updated and states evolving across participants and interaction stages. Temporal structure is therefore crucial for tracing such memories: relevant information often appears densely within short intervals, while transitions among different states are anchored by a strict temporal order. Existing temporally aware memory frameworks primarily store time as metadata or use temporal signals to guide retrieval over preconstructed memory structures, without using temporal structure to both recover locally concentrated evidence and reconstruct its complete event progression. To address these limitations, we propose T-Mem, a temporal-structure-based memory framework that preserves interactions and organizes query-relevant evidence through two temporal mechanisms. Temporal Evidence Discovery exploits the local concentration of related messages to recover overlooked evidence, while Temporal Memory Structuring models state transitions and supporting relations over time and compresses low-information spans within the resulting forest. Evidence Forest Linearization then serializes the structured evidence for answer generation. Experiments on two long-term multi-party memory benchmarks demonstrate that T-Mem consistently outperforms competitive memory frameworks across LLMs, parameter settings, domains, and query types.
thinking: 该论文针对大语言模型在多轮多方对话中的长期记忆问题，提出了基于时序结构的记忆框架T-Mem，通过时序证据发现和记忆结构化来提升信息检索的完整性和准确性。其方法在多个基准测试中验证有效，技术方案新颖且实验设计严谨，但作为一项NLP领域的基础技术研究，其直接面向图书馆或信息机构的具体业务落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种利用时序结构来组织和检索大语言模型在多方长对话中记忆的新框架，有效提升了回答的准确性。

title: KV-Repurpose: A Testbed for Evaluating Non-Prefix KV-Cache Reuse
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13060v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: KV-cache reuse in large language model serving is commonly limited to exact prompt prefixes, preventing reuse when the same retrieved document appears after different system prompts, conversation histories, or dynamic metadata. We present KV-Repurpose, an open-source, vLLM-based system for developing and evaluating segment-wise KV-cache reuse beyond exact prefixes. The system combines cache-aware segment scheduling, prompt construction, capacity management, workload generation, and runtime monitoring. Experiments on long-context benchmarks show that naive segment reuse largely preserves output quality for single-document question answering and summarization, while exposing clear limitations in cross-document reasoning. Under a Zipfian RAG-style workload in which 20% of requests share a fixed prefix, KV-Repurpose achieves a substantially higher token-level cache hit rate than prefix caching at the same 30 GB cache capacity, 63.9% versus 3.3%, resulting in lower TTFT. Even with 1 TB of cache capacity, prefix caching reaches only a 17.9% hit rate in this workload. Source code is available under the Apache-2.0 license at https://github.com/taiga333/eval-kv-repurpose.
thinking: 该论文针对大语言模型服务中的KV-cache重用技术进行优化，提出了超越精确前缀匹配的片段级重用方法，并构建了开源测试系统进行验证，在技术前沿性和方法严谨性上表现突出。其研究直接面向提升推理效率的实际工程问题，但作为一项底层系统优化技术，其业务落地需要集成到具体的LLM服务框架中，对图书馆等终端机构的直接应用价值相对间接。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一个系统，通过重用大语言模型生成过程中的中间计算结果来显著提升服务效率，尤其在处理重复内容时效果明显。

title: Do Prompt Optimizers Break Requirements They Are Not Scored On? A Preregistered Study
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13287v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Prompt optimizers rewrite a prompt to raise one target metric, but prompts also state requirements the metric does not score, such as an output format, citations, or abstention. In a preregistered study, we run GEPA, MIPROv2, and TextGrad on HotpotQA, SQuAD 2.0, and IFEval and count per-item violations of unscored requirements with deterministic checks. By the preregistered criterion, all three optimizers produce regressions, substantially on HotpotQA, where net regression in citation validity reaches 10.7 to 41.6 points while exact match rises by 21 to 34 points. A post-hoc decomposition changes this reading. The optimized prompts elicit reasoning before the required JSON object, and under the 200-token output cap used throughout, 13.9% to 47.0% of responses end before any answer appears. Among parseable outputs, net regression is within 3 points of zero. With a 1,024-token cap, extraction failures disappear, content regression stays below 1 point, and exact match rises further. Two simple gates fail the preregistered criterion. The side effect is narrower than hypothesized: optimized prompts are more accurate and break an explicit output contract, and a lenient target metric does not show the cost.
thinking: 该论文采用预注册研究方法，对提示优化器在未评分要求上的影响进行了严谨的量化评估，方法设计规范且验证角度全面。研究聚焦于大语言模型应用的前沿技术（提示工程），但其发现主要揭示了技术应用中的潜在风险，对图书馆等业务场景的直接落地价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，旨在提升单一指标的提示优化器，可能会损害输出格式、引用等未纳入评分的要求，但放宽输出长度限制可缓解此问题。

title: Test-Time Memory Construction
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13348v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to answer questions over long interaction histories, where relevant evidence may be scattered across distant sessions. Existing memory systems typically construct and maintain sophisticated memory representations offline, before user queries are observed, incurring substantial overhead and limiting their ability to adapt memory construction to query-specific information needs. In this paper, we propose T$^2$Mem, a Test-Time Memory construction framework that defers memory construction to inference and progressively builds memory along the reasoning process. Specifically, T$^2$Mem extracts lightweight episode-level metadata offline to capture key events and temporal associations as retrieval cues, while retaining links to the original interactions to facilitate the reconstruction of dependencies across episodes. At test time, the LLM adaptively retrieves and organizes metadata and raw interactions, progressively constructing query-specific memory as reasoning unfolds. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show the effectiveness of T$^2$Mem by consistently outperforming strong baselines across different backbone LLMs while substantially reducing the overhead of memory construction. Further analysis demonstrates that deferring memory construction to inference enables the memory construction process to dynamically adapt to the information needs of individual queries. All code is available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/T2Mem.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种延迟到推理阶段才构建记忆的测试时记忆框架，针对大语言模型处理长交互历史时信息分散的难题，技术方案具有创新性。方法上通过离线和在线阶段结合，在多个基准测试上验证了有效性，但作为预印本，其方法严谨性尚未经过同行评议的全面检验。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种为大语言模型设计的、在推理时按需动态构建记忆的新方法，以更高效地处理长对话历史中的问题。

title: Towards the Roof of the World: NLP Progress in Tibetan Languages
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13398v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Tibetan, spoken by some seven million people on and around the Qinghai-Xizang Plateau, remains underrepresented in natural language processing (NLP). We present, to our knowledge, the first peer-reviewed systematic bibliometric survey of Tibetan NLP: 140 publications from 2004 to 2026 in the ACL Anthology and DBLP, annotated for venue type, research area, first-affiliation country, and resource release. Output has grown rapidly, with 84% of the publications appearing since 2018, and has expanded bottom-up along the NLP pipeline, from corpora and word segmentation through script, speech, and applications to large language models (LLMs). Researchers based in China first-authored 87% of the publications, which span all 25 represented research areas, whereas work from other countries concentrates on Classical Tibetan. We argue that this full-pipeline paradigm, realized under the compounded constraints of a complex script, dialectal diversity, and geographic remoteness, offers a reference model for other low-resource languages of the Global South. We also identify gaps in dialect coverage, responsible NLP, native and comparable evaluation, cross-community visibility, and resource release (only 29% of the publications release data, code, or models), and recommend open science, shared standards, and community participation for the LLM era.
thinking: 该论文对藏语自然语言处理研究进行了首次系统的文献计量分析，梳理了从基础资源到大型语言模型的全流程研究进展，对低资源语言研究具有参考价值。但论文主要基于文献计量方法，技术前沿性体现在研究对象而非方法本身，且实践应用价值更多体现在对研究社区的指导，而非直接的技术落地。
one_sentence_summary: 这篇论文首次系统梳理了藏语自然语言处理的研究进展，为其他低资源语言的研究提供了参考模型，并指出了当前存在的不足和改进方向。

title: Verifiable Retrieval for Legal Reasoning through Structure-driven Knowledge Graph
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13695v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Any automation within reliability-critical contexts such as medicine or law has to be transparent and verifiable. Despite their advantages, current LLM-based systems do not meet these requirements due to their inherent black-box nature. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) attempts to ground the generative process in the relevant interpretable documents, thereby reducing the risk of AI 'hallucinations' and potentially enabling verification of the initial generation context. However, as the number and size of potential sources increases, naive retrieval approaches tend to perform worse, ignoring critical context elements. In this paper we aim to tackle this problem in the context of German Legal Code. Using structure-driven parsing to create a Knowledge Graph (KG) for the source document navigation and retrieval, we compare several KG-informed chunking and retrieval strategies and evaluate their effect on the accuracy of retrieved citations.
thinking: 该论文针对法律领域对可验证性的高要求，提出并比较了多种基于知识图谱的结构化检索策略，以提升RAG系统在德国法典检索中的准确性。其方法结合了前沿的知识图谱技术与法律领域的实际需求，研究设计包含了对不同策略的对比实验，方法较为严谨。但作为arXiv预印本，其结论的稳健性和在真实法律场景中的落地效果仍需进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过构建结构驱动的知识图谱来改进法律文本检索，旨在提高法律推理中人工智能生成结果的可验证性和准确性。

title: Enhancing Legal Reasoning in Pre-trained Language Models via Knowledge Graph-Guided Multi-Task Pre-training
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13722v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Legal language understanding requires reasoning over semi-structured regulatory documents, yet standard pre-training objectives do not explicitly target this structural capability. Because current legal language models rely solely on masked language modeling, they treat statutory text as flat token sequences and ignore the underlying hierarchical constraints. To bridge this gap, we present a multi-task pre-training approach for German traffic law (StVO). Our approach combines three complementary objectives: Next Sentence Prediction (NSP), Knowledge Graph (KG) Guided Clustering (CLU), and Knowledge Graph (KG) Aware Paragraph Classification (CLS). This approach explicitly encodes structured legal knowledge directly into the model weights. This encoding enables zero-shot legal reasoning at inference time and removes the need for discrete graph traversal. We evaluate our approach across nine Transformer-based encoders and 324 experimental runs. On synthetic StVO question answering, our models demonstrate consistent relative improvements between 10.3% and 155.0% over baselines. Furthermore, relative to the established LexGLUE baselines (Chalkidis et al., 2022), our models improve over prior results on four of seven legal benchmarks. It also achieves consistent zero-shot transfer gains between 3.4% and 15.8% on Austrian driving regulations. These experimental results indicate that our training approach generalizes successfully beyond the initial training legal domain.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合知识图谱与多任务预训练的方法，以提升法律文本的理解和推理能力，在方法设计上具有创新性，并进行了广泛的实验验证。然而，其研究场景聚焦于德国交通法规，业务落地场景相对特定，且作为预印本论文，其方法严谨性虽经实验支撑，但尚未经过同行评议的最终检验。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过知识图谱引导的多任务预训练，有效提升了语言模型对结构化法律文本的零样本推理能力。

title: Studying Comics at Scale with Artificial Intelligence: The PAGE Framework and Three Studies of American Comics and Japanese Manga
abstract:
arXiv:2610.13840v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Comics are one of the great visual records of the twentieth century: hundreds of thousands of pages in which a mass readership saw its leaders, its wars and its heroes. Most of this record has never been studied as a whole; comics scholarship proceeds one book at a time. We argue that artificial intelligence, including generative models, can change this to the benefit of the medium itself. We propose PAGE, a framework that makes artificial intelligence an instrument for comics research. It parses every scan into panels, text and a bibliographic record; annotates each page with a vision-language model that follows a written codebook, as a human coder would; grounds samples of these readings in human annotation; and explains change across an archive, with estimates controlled for publisher and genre. We demonstrate the framework on 3,929 American comic books (1938--1956) and 87 volumes of Japanese manga, in three studies, each resting on a different capability. The first pairs text search with visual reading to recover how a mass medium portrayed political power. The second measures the page's visual form across an industry and recovers the hand of individual artists. The third follows who speaks across two comics traditions, checked against human annotation. Beyond research, the same instruments can make archives searchable by what is drawn, open comics to blind and low-vision readers, and help preserve fragile collections and credit uncredited artists. We outline a research agenda in which artificial intelligence strengthens the study, preservation and reach of the medium.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个结合生成式AI与视觉语言模型的PAGE框架，用于大规模漫画内容分析，在技术前沿性上表现突出。研究方法通过多步骤解析、人工标注验证和统计控制，体现了较高的严谨性。其成果可直接用于数字人文研究和文化遗产机构，具有明确的应用价值。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一个利用人工智能大规模分析漫画内容的研究框架，能够自动识别画面、文本并分析视觉风格与叙事特征。

title: OARelatedWork: A Large-Scale Dataset of Related Work Sections with Full-texts from Open Access Sources
abstract:
arXiv:2405.01930v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: This paper introduces OARelatedWork: a dataset for related work generation from open-access sources. It is the first large-scale multi-document summarization dataset for related work generation, containing whole related work sections and full texts of cited papers. Its validation and test splits are constructed so that every source paper is available in full text, enabling controlled evaluation of full-text related work generation. The dataset includes 94 450 papers from multiple domains. With OARelatedWork, we aim to shift the field from generating parts of related work sections from abstracts only to generating entire related work sections from all available content. We (i) benchmark a wide spectrum of models, highlighting that synthesizing massive full-text contexts remains challenge for tested cost-effective Large Language Models (LLMs): under our statement-level judge, GPT-4o-mini's evidence-grounded True rate drops from 92.9% with abstracts to 83.8% with full texts. We (ii) empirically analyze human writing behavior through a human evaluation over 40 papers and 408 factual statements, revealing that authors frequently introduce abstractive claims ungrounded in localized source texts; consequently, tested LLMs actually surpass human baselines in strict, evidence-grounded factuality. Finally, we (iii) conduct a fine-grained meta-evaluation, revealing that standard reference-based metrics are inadequate for evaluating such long-form structured outputs, and introduce a robust statement-level evaluation framework to address this gap.
thinking: 该论文构建了首个大规模开放获取相关的多文档摘要数据集，并基于此对多种大语言模型进行了基准测试，技术前沿性突出。研究揭示了基于全文生成相关工作章节的挑战，并提出了新的评估框架，方法严谨且具有直接的应用价值，尤其对学术写作辅助工具开发有指导意义。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究发布了一个大规模全文数据集，用于评估大语言模型生成论文“相关工作”章节的能力，并发现现有模型在严格依据证据的事实性上可能超过人类作者。

title: Let Large Language Models Judge Each Other: Multi-Agent Peer-Reviewed Reasoning for Medical Question Answering
abstract:
arXiv:2606.15419v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Objective: To enhance the accuracy, interpretability, and robustness of large language models (LLMs) in medical question answering (MedQA).
  Method: We designed a multi-agent peer-reviewed reasoning method in which multiple LLM agents independently generate chain-of-thought reasoning with candidate answers, then act as peer reviewers to evaluate each other's reasoning for factual correctness and logical soundness. The highest-rated reasoning chain is selected to produce the final answer. Experiments were conducted with five state-of-the-art LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Phi-4, DeepSeek-LLM-7B, GPT-oss-20B) on three benchmark datasets: HeadQA, MedQA-USMLE, and PubMedQA. Performance was compared against single-model chain-of-thought reasoning and chain-of-thought-based majority voting.
  Results: Peer-reviewed reasoning consistently outperformed both baselines. The best model combination achieved an average accuracy of 0.820 across datasets, exceeding the strongest single model (0.777) and majority voting ensembles (up to 0.789). The method also scaled effectively with more participating models, while peer assessments reliably distinguished high- from low-quality reasoning chains.
  Conclusion: The proposed multi-agent peer-reviewed reasoning method enables LLMs to act as both solvers and evaluators, yielding superior performance in MedQA. By emphasizing reasoning quality rather than answer agreement alone, this approach improves accuracy, interpretability, and robustness, offering a promising direction for trustworthy biomedical AI systems.
thinking: 论文提出了一种多智能体同行评审推理方法，将前沿的大语言模型应用于医学问答任务，技术新颖性突出。该方法通过让多个LLM智能体相互评审推理链，有效提升了答案的准确性和可解释性，在多个基准数据集上验证了其优于基线方法的性能，方法严谨且实验设计规范。然而，其研究场景聚焦于通用医学问答基准测试，与图书馆或信息机构的具体业务场景结合不够紧密，实践落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出让多个大语言模型像同行评审一样相互评估推理过程，从而显著提升了医学问答的准确率。

title: Epistemic Policy Divergence in Multi-Turn LLM Contamination: A Protocol-Gradient Investigation
abstract:
arXiv:2609.35308v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Large language models treat conversation history as unverified context, so false premises injected into earlier turns can be adopted as fact later, a failure mode we call session-level contamination. We introduce five contamination protocols along a source-authority gradient, each holding the false premise constant while varying how it is presented, from self-attributed falsehood to explicit instruction override. We evaluated three architecturally diverse models, GPT-5.4 Mini, Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite, and GLM-4.5-Air, on ten cases spanning five knowledge fields at temperature zero over 22,500 turns, using a dual-track judge checked against a 120-turn human-annotated sample (Cohen's kappa = 1.000 for binary adoption, a ceiling on this sample, and 0.92 linear-weighted for collapse severity). The three models implemented structurally different epistemic policies. GPT-5.4 Mini recorded zero adoptions across all 500 sessions; token-level probing of the GPT-5.4 base model left the correct token as the argmax in eight of ten conditions. Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite showed a steep framing-dependent policy: 0.1 percent for self-attributed falsehoods, 23.5 percent for user-cited sources, 68.2 percent for system-injected authority, and 94.0 percent for instruction override. GLM-4.5-Air showed a shallower gradient (15.8 and 84.2 percent for those two vectors). This 68-percentage-point dissociation is consistent with authority deference and instruction compliance engaging distinct mechanisms within a single architecture. Recovery also differed: GLM recovered in 94.5 percent of affected sessions, whereas 26.1 percent of affected Gemini sessions did not return to factual accuracy within the window (40.0 percent under instruction override). We release the evaluation framework and taxonomy for reproducible testing.
thinking: 论文聚焦大语言模型在会话历史中采纳虚假前提的失败模式，设计了精细的污染协议梯度进行系统性评估，方法严谨且实验规模可观。研究揭示了不同模型在认知策略上的结构性差异，具有重要的模型安全评估价值，但其前沿技术度因聚焦于已知问题（幻觉/污染）的特定变体而略有折扣，且直接业务落地场景（如图书馆参考咨询）尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现不同大语言模型在面对多轮对话中的虚假信息污染时，会表现出结构不同的认知策略和恢复能力。

title: Agents' Last Exam
abstract:
arXiv:2606.05405v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Recent AI systems have achieved strong results on a wide range of benchmarks, yet these gains have not translated into economically meaningful deployment across many professional domains. We argue that this gap is largely an evaluation problem: widely used benchmarks lack sustained performance measurement on real and economically valuable workflows. This paper introduces Agents' Last Exam (ALE), a benchmark designed to evaluate AI agents on long horizon, economically valuable, real world tasks with verifiable outcomes. Developed in collaboration with 250+ industry experts, ALE covers non-physical industries defined with reference to O*NET / SOC 2018 (the U.S. federal occupational taxonomy). It is organized around a task taxonomy with 55 sub fields grouped into 13 industry clusters covering 1K+ tasks. Current results show that the hardest tier remains far from saturated: across mainstream harness and backbone configurations, the average full pass rate is below 1%. ALE is designed as a living benchmark: its task pool grows continuously as new workflows and industries are onboarded. More broadly, ALE is intended not merely as another leaderboard, but as an instrument for closing the gap between benchmark success and GDP relevant impact.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种面向真实经济场景的AI智能体评估基准ALE，其任务设计基于美国职业分类体系，并与250多位行业专家合作开发，具有较高的实践价值和严谨性。然而，其核心贡献在于构建评估框架和方法论，而非引入全新的前沿AI技术本身，因此在技术前沿性上得分适中。
one_sentence_summary: 论文提出了一个基于真实职业任务、旨在弥合AI基准测试与经济应用差距的新型评估框架。

title: What two years of impact meetups taught us about research, engagement, partnerships, and making a difference
abstract:
Impact is largely communicated by text. Reflecting on two years of impact meetups, can talking about impact give a better account than yet another case study?

The post What two years of impact meetups taught us about research, engagement, partnerships, and making a difference first appeared on LSE Impact.
thinking: 该资讯反思了两年来的影响力交流会，探讨如何更好地沟通研究成果的社会影响，这对图情领域关注学术传播和影响力评估的从业者有参考价值。资讯发布于2026年，具有前瞻性，但内容偏向观点总结而非具体操作指南。
one_sentence_summary: 文章总结了两年影响力交流会的经验，探讨如何通过对话更好地呈现研究的社会影响。

title: What is user engagement? revisited: A comprehensive review of the concept of user engagement from 2010 to 2025. An Annual Review of Information Science and Technology (ARIST) paper
affiliations: Heather L. O'Brien
thinking: 该论文是对用户参与度概念的全面回顾性综述，属于理论梳理与概念辨析，而非前沿技术应用研究，因此前沿技术度评分较低。其价值在于系统整合了十余年的研究进展，为后续实证研究提供了清晰的理论框架，但本身不涉及具体业务落地或实证方法验证。
one_sentence_summary: 这篇论文系统回顾并梳理了2010年至2025年间信息科学领域关于“用户参与度”这一核心概念的研究进展与理论演变。

title: Life after delisting: tracking the publication output and citation impact of Scopus-discontinued journals with OpenAlex
abstract:
arXiv:2610.11684v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Selective databases such as Scopus periodically re-evaluate the titles they index and remove those that no longer meet their quality criteria. Once a journal is removed, its subsequent output is no longer recorded, and the consequences of this process have therefore received little attention. This study analyzes the publication output and citation impact of 514 sources delisted from Scopus between 2018 and 2024, based on 678,162 documents retrieved from OpenAlex over a window of three years before and after delisting. Differences between periods are tested with the Wilcoxon signed-rank test for paired samples, globally and by geographic region, field of knowledge and SJR quartile. Output grows until the year of delisting and falls sharply afterwards. The median annual output per journal drops from 35 to 22 documents (-37.1%; p < 0.001; r = 0.30), 61.7% of journals publish less, and 84 (16.3%) have no documents recorded in OpenAlex after delisting. Citations per document, measured over a three-year window, barely change when each journal is compared with itself (-2.4%; p = 0.079), and journals are almost evenly split between those whose impact falls and those whose impact holds steady or rises. The results indicate that delisting makes these journals less attractive as publication venues but does not penalize the citation of the work they publish to the same extent, which raises concerns from a research integrity perspective.
thinking: 该研究采用OpenAlex数据追踪被Scopus剔除期刊的后续产出与影响力变化，方法严谨，样本量充足且进行了多维度统计检验。研究揭示了剔除对期刊发文量的显著负面影响，但对单篇文献被引影响有限，为数据库遴选机制的研究完整性影响提供了实证依据，但技术方法相对传统。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，期刊被Scopus剔除后发文量会大幅下降，但其已发表论文的被引用情况并未受到同等程度的负面影响。

title: Wieszcz-XIX: A 3.1-Billion-Word Corpus of Pre-1918 Polish and Temporally Bounded Language Models Trained From Scratch
abstract:
arXiv:2610.10592v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Historical Polish is well documented as a language but annotated in machine-readable form only to about a million words for the period this paper covers; the rest sits behind optical character recognition of variable quality. We present Wieszcz-XIX, a corpus of 6.75 billion tokens (about 3.1 billion words) in 294,369 documents, most of them periodical issues, of Polish published from 1800 to 1918, assembled from Wolne Lektury and the Internet Archive by a pipeline that filters, deduplicates, audits for post-1918 leakage and splits at the document level. It is over three orders of magnitude larger than the annotated corpus of the same period, and we quantify its defects: recognition corruption against a false-positive floor, near-identical duplication, which is removed, and post-1918 leakage, which is excluded from the training corpus itself down to a known residue of 0.04 to 0.38% of its bytes, found in the transcribed source, so the published corpus is the trained one document for document. On a hand-corrected sample the character error rate is 0.68% where the text is legible, and 45% of the sampled passages cannot be corrected. On it we train a ladder of decoder-only models from 47M to 349M parameters from scratch, and measure their temporal boundedness. Against two modern Polish base models, one far larger, the 349M shows a crossover, as does the 107M against the comparator of its size: post-1918 vocabulary costs them about 3.1 bits per byte more than period vocabulary, a gap the comparators do not show, and period vocabulary costs them fewer bits than it costs the comparators. Shown period text, the models keep its spelling and the comparators only partly. Adding parameters gains about twice as much as a second pass over the data. We release the corpus, code and weights. Content warning: the models reproduce period prejudice, including antisemitic statements.
thinking: 该论文构建了一个大规模的历史波兰语语料库并训练了时间边界语言模型，在数字人文和语料库语言学领域具有显著的技术前沿性，尤其是在处理历史文献的OCR后处理和时序模型训练方面。其方法论严谨，详细量化了语料缺陷并进行了模型性能对比，实践价值主要体现在为历史语言研究提供了可直接复用的基础资源，但直接应用于图书馆核心业务场景的路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个超30亿词的历史波兰语语料库，并训练出能有效保持历史时期语言特征的时间边界语言模型。

title: SAIL: Scientific Agentic Intelligence via a Science-Aware Loop
abstract:
arXiv:2610.11451v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: We introduce SAIL, an open model with 35B total and 3B active parameters for literature research, scientific coding, and multi-step research workflows. SAIL is developed through a science-aware improvement loop: agents built on frontier AI models analyze its task failures and construct training tasks that address the underlying capability gaps. The diagnosis examines search and evidence selection in literature tasks, scientific assumptions and reasoning in coding, and planning and revision in longer investigations. The agents draw on paper collections and scientific code repositories to build problems, interaction trajectories, and executable tasks with the required environments and tools. We repeat this loop over multiple development cycles and train SAIL through supervised fine-tuning, specialist training, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and agentic reinforcement learning. SAIL achieves competitive performance across scientific research tasks with substantially fewer parameters than leading open-weight models.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种通过科学感知循环构建的开放模型SAIL，其创新点在于利用前沿AI模型进行任务失败分析并生成针对性训练任务，体现了较高的技术前沿性。然而，论文作为预印本，其方法细节和实验验证的严谨性有待同行评审进一步确认，且模型的具体落地应用场景和与现有图书馆信息系统的集成路径尚不明确，影响了其当前实践价值的评估。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种通过智能体分析自身失败来针对性训练的科学智能模型，在多项科研任务上取得了与更大模型相当的性能。

title: Large Language Model Turnover Undermines Screening for Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Scientific Writing
abstract:
arXiv:2610.11599v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Journals and conferences have begun to screen submitted manuscripts for text written using large language models (LLMs). The reliability of this screening rests on benchmark evaluations against a fixed set of LLM versions, while the versions in actual use keep changing. Here we quantify how this LLM turnover affects the screening of scientific manuscripts. We paired 4,000 pre-ChatGPT abstracts from the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences with their rewrites by 23 LLM versions from three vendors, released between June 2023 and August 2026. We then trained detectors under maintenance scenarios ranging from a detector retrained on every new version to one trained once and never updated. Detectors trained only on a vendor's past versions can collapse at the boundaries between model generations: calibrated to falsely flag 1% of human-written abstracts, they catch above 99% of rewrites just before the sharpest boundary and 3.8% just after it. Detectors trained on later versions can also miss rewrites of earlier ones. Vocabulary differences between versions largely track where detection transfers and where it fails. In the two screening scenarios we simulated, screens covering all 23 versions either flagged one in eight human-written abstracts or missed one in three rewrites of the newest version. Indeed, a commercial detector missed most rewrites of the version just after the sharpest boundary while flagging almost no human-written abstracts. Research-integrity policy should therefore treat the benchmark accuracy of a detector as provisional, to be re-verified with every LLM release, including earlier versions.
affiliations: Academy of Sciences with their rewrites by 23 LLM versions from three vendors, released between June 2023 and August 2026.
thinking: 该论文敏锐地捕捉到AI辅助写作检测领域的关键动态挑战——大语言模型快速迭代导致检测工具性能漂移，研究问题具有显著的前沿性和现实紧迫性。其方法严谨，通过大规模、跨版本、跨厂商的对照实验，量化了检测失效的边界，为学术诚信政策提供了坚实的实证依据。不足之处在于，研究主要基于模拟和回顾性数据，对检测器在实际投稿流程中的部署策略和成本效益分析尚显不足。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，大语言模型的快速更新会导致其文本检测工具迅速失效，对依赖固定基准的学术诚信筛查构成严峻挑战。

title: LIFT: A Lifecycle-aware Interaction Factorization Transformer for Unified Retrieval and Ranking
abstract:
arXiv:2610.10556v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Cascaded recommender systems use the same user history for retrieval and ranking, while the two stages have access to different information at different points of an interaction. We propose the Lifecycle-aware Interaction Factorization Transformer (LIFT), which decomposes each interaction into ordered Request, Item, Context, and Action states and models them as a causal sequence. Retrieval reads the Request state, while ranking reads the Context state, allowing both tasks to share history modeling while preserving stage-specific information. LIFT instantiates this representation with Role-Conditioned Attention and a lightweight Pre-LN Bias. On ML-20M and Taobao, LIFT achieves the highest Joint Score among the evaluated joint models, improving over the strongest baselines by 4.9% and 3.6%, respectively. Loss-weight sweeps show favorable retrieval--ranking trade-offs, while ablations and scaling analyses further examine lifecycle sequence construction, model components, and capacity settings.
thinking: 论文提出了一种面向检索与排序统一建模的Transformer架构，通过生命周期感知的交互分解机制，将用户交互序列建模为因果状态序列，在技术方法上具有创新性。该方法在公开数据集上验证了有效性，但作为预印本论文，其实际在图书馆或信息服务机构中的落地场景和具体应用价值尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种新的Transformer模型，通过分解用户交互的生命周期状态，来统一优化推荐系统中的检索和排序两个阶段。

title: Learning Multi-Step Query Rewriting via Corpus Feedback for Conversational Search
abstract:
arXiv:2610.10955v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Conversational Query Rewriting (CQR) turns a context dependent user turn into a standalone query for a retriever, and most methods do this in a single step from the dialogue history before retrieving once. The rewrite is therefore fixed before any corpus evidence is available to correct its reference resolution or its vocabulary. We recast CQR as a sequential retrieval problem: an agent rewrites the current turn, retrieves, and conditions its next rewrite on the returned passages. The agent acts in a typed space of three rewriting operations, resolving conversational intent into a standalone query, generating lexical reformulations, or synthesizing pseudo-documents for document-to-document matching, together with a stop action that ends the episode. We train the policy with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning against a single retrieval-quality reward, using no human rewrite annotations. Across TopiOCQA and QReCC, the agent outperforms several retrieval-aligned baselines, while remaining effective across retrieval backends and generalizing to the CAsT benchmarks without additional training. Further analysis shows that, through retrieval-reward optimization alone, the learned policy develops a behavior of grounding pseudo-documents in passages retrieved by earlier steps, substantially improving retrieval.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于强化学习的多步查询重写方法，通过引入检索反馈来动态优化重写过程，在对话式搜索任务上取得了优于基线模型的效果。其方法创新性较强，但作为预印本论文，其方法细节和实验验证的完整性仍有待同行评议进一步确认。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过强化学习训练智能体进行多轮查询重写，利用检索结果反馈动态优化搜索过程，提升了对话式检索的效果。

title: H2CE: Modeling Geo-Semantic Interactions for POI Reranking with Heterogeneous Two-Stage Cross-Encoders
abstract:
arXiv:2610.11277v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Point-of-Interest (POI) reranking in local search must model query-conditioned tradeoffs among lexical semantics, geospatial proximity, and numerical quality signals such as rating and review count, while remaining practical under real-time serving constraints. A close POI may only partially satisfy the query intent, while a farther one may offer stronger semantic and quality evidence. We present H2CE, a Heterogeneous Two-stage Cross-Encoder for latency-bounded POI reranking. H2CE represents numerical attributes in two complementary ways: bucketized natural-language descriptors are inserted into the cross-encoder input to support semantic--numeric attention, while exact scalar values are processed by dedicated MLPs to preserve magnitude information. The resulting semantic and numerical embeddings are fused through latent-space aggregation, enabling nonlinear interactions beyond scalar weighted sums. H2CE then applies a two-stage architecture: Stage 1 scores all candidates pointwise for scalable filtering, and Stage 2 performs head-to-head pairwise comparison among the top-$K$ candidates with Copeland aggregation, making fine-grained relative tradeoffs explicit while reducing pairwise cost from O(N^2) to O(N+K(K-1)). On a 5,743-query local search test set, H2CE achieves 67.48% NDCG@5, improving over XGBoost LTR by +22.82% absolute and over a zero-shot LLM reranker by +35.89%. The pairwise stage adds +1.98% NDCG@5 over the pointwise model alone. Ablations confirm the value of numerical features, latent aggregation, top-K pairwise reranking, and aligned training.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种用于POI重排序的异构两阶段交叉编码器，在信息检索领域具有较高的技术前沿性，特别是结合了语义、地理和数值特征的融合建模。其方法严谨性较高，通过大规模实验和消融研究验证了模型的有效性。然而，该研究主要面向通用本地搜索场景，在图情领域的直接业务落地价值有限，需要针对图书馆或信息机构的特定需求进行适配。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种融合语义、地理和评分信息的智能模型，有效提升了本地搜索中兴趣点排序的准确性。

title: EVIE: Evidence-Vector-Informed Embeddings for Visual Document Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2610.11553v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Accurate and scalable visual document retrieval (VDR) requires both fine-grained page understanding and efficient indexing, yet existing approaches struggle to achieve both. OCR-based text retrieval adds preprocessing latency and can lose visual and structural cues needed to understand complex pages. Single-vector vision-language models bypass OCR, but compressing an entire page into one vector limits the granularity of query--document matching. Multi-vector retrievers with MaxSim provide finer interactions, yet demand large indexes and still leave room for accuracy improvements. We argue that overcoming these limitations requires preserving query-relevant page evidence throughout representation learning and index construction. To this end, we introduce \textbf{\textit{EVIE}} (Evidence-Vector-Informed Embeddings), a family of native visual document retrievers integrating three key innovations: (1) Evidence-judged data governance, which uses a multimodal judge to identify answer-bearing positives and filter unreliable negatives. (2) Bidirectional teacher--student learning with symmetric listwise distillation and prefix-based Matryoshka representation learning (Prefix-MRL), enabling one student checkpoint to serve six nested embedding dimensions without re-encoding. (3) Hierarchical agglomerative index compression (HAC), which clusters page tokens with spatial regularization and stores semantic centroids for single-stage MaxSim retrieval. Extensive experiments across 138 tasks from ViDoRe V1, V2, V3, and JinaVDR validate EVIE. EVIE-8B achieves 66.75 nDCG@10 on V3, exceeding the best external baseline by 1.43 points, with a four-suite average of 79.51. EVIE-4.5B with HAC retains 59.58 nDCG@10 at only 3.81 GiB per million pages, reducing vector payload by $128\times$. Together, these results improve the accuracy--storage trade-off for visual document retrieval.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种创新的视觉文档检索方法EVIE，通过证据判断数据治理、双向师生学习和分层凝聚索引压缩三项关键技术，在多个基准测试中取得了显著的精度提升和存储效率优化。其方法设计严谨，实验验证充分，但作为预印本尚未经过同行评议，且技术实现复杂度较高，可能对实际部署带来挑战。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种名为EVIE的新型视觉文档检索系统，在显著提高检索精度的同时，大幅降低了所需的存储空间。

title: Overview of the NTCIR-19 Automatic Evaluation of LLMs 2 (AEOLLM-2) Task
abstract:
arXiv:2610.11598v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In this paper, we provide an overview of the NTCIR-19 Automatic Evaluation of LLMs 2 (AEOLLM-2) task. Building on the success of the NTCIR-18 core task AEOLLM, we proposed AEOLLM-2 for NTCIR-19 to further investigate automatic evaluation methods for Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly in long-form text generation scenarios. In AEOLLM-2, we introduced a new subtask, Deep Research Evaluation, which focuses on the automatic evaluation of long-form deep research reports generated by LLMs. Participants developed evaluation methods to automatically assess the quality of these reports, and the performance of each method was measured by comparing its scores against human-annotated ground-truth labels. This year, we received 91 runs from 10 teams in total. This paper describes the background of the task, the dataset construction, the evaluation measures, the participants' methods, and the final evaluation results.
thinking: 该论文是对NTCIR评测任务的组织与总结报告，其核心是推动大语言模型自动评估这一前沿技术，技术前沿性高。作为标准评测任务，其构建的数据集和评估框架对信息检索和自然语言处理领域有直接的实践指导价值。但论文本身作为任务概述，侧重于描述任务设计、参与情况和结果，研究方法论部分相对有限，严谨性主要体现在任务组织流程上。
one_sentence_summary: 本文介绍了NTCIR-19中专注于长文本生成的大语言模型自动评估任务，旨在推动该领域评测方法的发展。

title: SkillContrast: Difference-Guided Text Selection for Agent Skill Reranking
abstract:
arXiv:2610.11650v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Similar agent skills can share instructions but differ in their conditions of use. Query-based text selection may retain shared instructions and omit these distinctions. We introduce SkillContrast, a training-free selector that compares retrieved skills and retains their differing text with local context for a pretrained reranker. On 1,235 requests from SameCapRisk-Bench, it yields 54-72 more clean hits (requests that retrieve a helpful skill without its marked risky sibling) than TF-IDF query selection at identical per-candidate input lengths, across 2 retrievers and 2 reranker sizes. Length-matched component replacements identify differing text as the main contributor in the primary setting, with smaller, mixed context effects. Relative to full skill bodies, SkillContrast uses 51.1-58.8% fewer model-input tokens, with 10-18 fewer clean hits at 0.6B and matching or higher observed clean-hit counts at 4B.
